chapters.title: Chapter 451: This Is All Fake
paragraphs: Ma Huainan could not understand.
Wasn’t the Divine Kingdom War all about profit?
His Divine Kingdom Core could only bring the opponent an expansion in area, but what was that compared to his staggering fixed assets?
Why did the opponent want to destroy all of these things?
Could it be... really just to save time?
In just ten short years, the opponent’s zombie army had advanced all the way to the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Over eighty percent of the entire Divine Kingdom had been completely destroyed.
Looking around now, the once prosperous Divine Kingdom had become devastated, and Ma Huainan felt as if his heart were bleeding.
He had already graduated from the Primordial Academy and had long passed the stage of enjoying the investment dividends from the Sima Family.
Everything in the future would need to be developed bit by bit on his own.
And now, this battle by the opponent had almost destroyed his future.
It would at least significantly impact his development speed for the next hundred, or even thousand years.
This was digging his grave!
Ma Huainan stared fixedly at the zombie army in the distance.
He desperately wanted to know when exactly he had provoked such a crazy Corpse Cultivator god.
However, it was a pity that Yang Fan naturally could not respond to him.
“Are... are you really sent by Yang Fan!” Ma Huainan questioned loudly again.
However, the entire Divine Kingdom remained silent.
No deity appeared or responded.
Seeing this, a look of regret appeared on Ma Huainan’s face.
If he could confirm the opponent’s identity, he might still be able to use the Real World to apply pressure on them.
After all, he was not an ordinary god.
As a Genius of the Sima Family with a different surname, and even more so as a Peerless Prodigy figure highly regarded by the Federal Government.
Since he had not yet truly grown up, he was still protected by the Federal Government’s rules.
As long as he knew who the opponent was, he would have a chance to find a breakthrough in the Real World.
Unfortunately, the opponent did not give him this chance at all.
Moreover... the current Ma Huainan had long lost his initial confidence.
Even though he currently commanded an army of 50 billion and still had cards in his Divine Kingdom that he had not yet used.
But facing this eerie zombie legion before him, he always felt a sense of unease in his heart.

During this period, the opponent had continuously sent new believers into his Divine Kingdom, and the number of A-Rank war weapons, the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, had already neared ten million.
With such a terrifying Divine Kingdom foundation, even he dared not underestimate them in the slightest.
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan took a deep breath.
Since he could not know the opponent’s identity, he could only give it his all and win this final battle.
“I, Ma Huainan, am a Genius of the Sima Family and a Peerless Prodigy recognized by the Federal Government!”
“War is not just about the strength of believers, but also about the foundation of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Today, I will let you see what kind of trump cards the Sima Family has given me!”
Ma Huainan roared, raised his right hand high, and then swung it down violently.
“Believers!”
“If the enemy takes one more step forward, it will be our Divine Kingdom Core!”
“Behind you are your parents, your wives, and your children!”
“This is our home!”
“Now is the final battle of the Divine Kingdom defense!”
“Annihilate these invaders and protect our home!”
“For the Divine Kingdom!”
“For the god!”
“Kill!”
As Ma Huainan’s voice fell, the 50 billion-strong army erupted simultaneously.
A terrifying blood-colored aura soared into the sky, instantly enveloping the entire world.
The army, like a sea of blood, advanced crazily toward the zombie legion ahead.
At this moment, Yang Eleven, located at the command center, watched this scene, a cold smile slowly appearing on the corner of his mouth.
“Pass the order: deploy ten billion Zombie Generals and five billion Zombie Kings!”
“In this battle, there is no need to continue hiding our strength.”
“Smart Weapons, open at full power.”
The order was issued.
The next moment, a large number of zombie believers walked out from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Their aura was incomparably cold, and they came to the very front of the army in perfect unison.
Without any military Formation, all the zombie believers just slowly raised their right hands.
Mechanical prompts sounded one after another simultaneously.
“Energy charging.”
“Fire!”
Boom!
In an instant, countless energy beams soared into the sky.
Like a destructive storm, they smashed fiercely toward Ma Huainan’s army.
The first round of attacks ended, and the front row of the zombie army retreated half a step.
Subsequently, the zombie believers in the middle area raised their arms again.
“Energy charging.”
“Fire!”
The second round of attacks descended again.
And this time, the quantity was even more terrifying.
Energy cannons filled the sky like a rainstorm, completely covering the entire battlefield.
Whether in the sky or on the ground, there were almost no blind spots.
Watching this destructive scene before him, Ma Huainan froze completely.
His pupils kept contracting, and his heart felt as if it were being fiercely gripped by an invisible giant hand.
“Impossible...”
“How is it possible...”
“How could he possibly possess so many Smart Weapons?”
“Fake! This is all fake!”
At this moment, Ma Huainan completely lost his composure.
Back in the battle on the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom, those zombie believers equipped with Smart Weapons were only around ten million.
But what about now?
What did he see?
Tens of billions!
A full tens of billions of zombie army equipped with Smart Weapons!
Such a number had completely exceeded his understanding.
“What kind of Divine Kingdom route are you taking? Why do you have so many Smart Weapons!”
Ma Huainan couldn’t help but roar.
He could not understand; apart from gods of the Mechanical Path, other gods would simply not cultivate believers in this way.
For gods of other routes, Smart Weapons were mostly for auxiliary purposes.
The reason was simple: they were too expensive!
These weapons could not directly enhance the Divine Kingdom foundation like special buildings.
Purchasing a large amount of Resources to strengthen the believers themselves yielded higher returns.
Normal gods would at most equip their elite forces with them.
It was absolutely impossible to be like this before his eyes, having tens of billions of believers all equipped with Smart Weapons.
This was no longer luxury in the ordinary sense, but a development method that completely defied common sense.
Under the crazy bombardment of countless energy cannons, the army of believers under Ma Huainan had now fallen into an extremely difficult situation.
Blood-colored barriers emerged above the army, and countless Martial King and Martial Master level believers exerted their Internal Energy to the limit to maintain the Formation.
However, facing the overwhelming rain of energy cannon fire, even the B-Rank Formation began to tremble continuously.
Cracks gradually appeared.
“Hold on for me!”
“Their Smart Weapons consume a huge amount of energy; they can’t last long!”
“As long as we hold on, their firepower will inevitably have a gap!”
Ma Huainan continuously issued Divine Decrees, encouraging his believers.
It had to be said that as a Peerless Prodigy with an SS-Rank Divine Kingdom Talent, his combat power was indeed far superior to ordinary gods.
Not only was the fighting will of his believers extremely strong, but their physical fitness and endurance were also far superior to those of the same rank.
Even when facing this kind of nearly crushing firepower coverage, there was still no large-scale collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 452: A Chance to Turn the Tide!
paragraphs: One volley, two volleys, three volleys, ten volleys!
Terrifying energy cannons continued to bombard without pause.
Ma Huainan’s army, braving the sky-filling artillery fire, continued to advance slowly.
Although energy cannons constantly pierced through the blood-colored barrier and detonated inside the Formation, causing heavy casualties.
Overall, however, this army of 50 billion still maintained a complete combat system.
There was no collapse, no fleeing; they were even continuously closing in on Yang Eleven’s zombie army.
Yang Fan, from the Divine Kingdom Core, watched this scene on the battlefield, a trace of greed flashing in his eyes.
“If he were given another ten years to develop... and let the overall Realm of his believers rise by another level.”
“This battle, I fear, would truly not be this simple.”
Yang Fan said in a low voice.
He had to admit that this Ma Huainan indeed had the potential to become a High-Order God.
“Master, there is actually no need to worry.”
Yang Da said while bowing.
“With the opponent’s current combat power alone, they still have no chance of winning.”
“They won’t even get a real chance for melee combat before being completely wiped out by our long-range firepower.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
“With his current Divine Kingdom combat power, it is not enough to make me worry.”
“I am just a bit curious...”
“What kind of talent it will bring me after absorbing his Divine Kingdom Core.”
Speaking of this, a trace of anticipation flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
He was even more aware of the value of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core.
One must know that these Smart Weapons were all third-grade and fourth-grade Smart Weapons.
If they were entirely controlled by intelligent lifeform, the combat power they exerted could even rival that of Core Formation Realm and Nascent Soul Cultivators.
If the opponent’s believers simply lacked special talents, even with an army of 100 billion, it would be nothing more than a one-sided slaughter.
But now... he was actually able to rely on his own talent to give these believers such powerful combat resilience.
One has to say, this Martial God Body talent is truly powerful.
Yang Fan’s gaze remained on the battlefield, and he immediately gave the order:
“Aside from the zombie army, arrange for Yang Yi to begin preparations immediately.”
“Transport all the war Resources purchased during this period to the frontline on a large scale.”
“In addition, excluding the 100 S-rank war building [Flesh Scourge Mother Nest] already deployed, take all the remaining 212 in the Divine Kingdom as well.”
Yang Fan’s voice was cold.
“After wiping out the opponent’s army, I want the supporting gods from the Sima Family to feel fear, so as to end the battle quickly.”
Being currently too weak to face the Sima Family, one of the Five Great Families, Yang Fan did not want to go too far.
It would be best to demonstrate overwhelming power while they had only dispatched their vanguard, forcing them to give up.
If he caused the other gods of the Sima Family to suffer heavy losses and blew the matter out of proportion, that was not the result Yang Fan wanted.
“This subordinate understands.” Yang Da bowed respectfully.
On the battlefield.
As time passed, Ma Huainan’s expression became increasingly ugly.
“This isn’t right...”
“Why?”
“Why hasn’t the energy of these Smart Weapons been exhausted yet?”
“Why has it lasted so long this time?”
He stared fixedly at the energy cannons falling from the distance, his eyes filled with disbelief.
Judging by the experience from last time, the energy reserves of the Smart Weapons should have long since been exhausted.
But now, the opponent’s attacks had not only not stopped, they were becoming increasingly dense.
His believers were suffering increasing casualties, and the originally impregnable Formation began to show more and more gaps.
A trace of fear finally rose in Ma Huainan’s heart.
“Master, according to database analysis, the endurance of third-grade Smart Weapons cannot possibly be as short as it appeared last time.”
The intelligent lifeform suddenly reminded.
“The opponent must have been deliberately hiding it before.”
“This is information warfare.”
“His goal was to make us misjudge the endurance of the Smart Weapons.”
“And then launch the real attack after our main combat forces were all committed.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s face turned livid.
“Damn it!”
“Who exactly is this god following the path of a Corpse Cultivator?”
“To possess a trump card of this level, yet still be so cautious?”
He could not figure out why the opponent, clearly possessing overwhelming strength, had been hiding their trump cards all along.
“There’s no other way... the trump card must be used.”
Ma Huainan took a deep breath.
The next moment, he waved his hand abruptly.
Boom!
Two massive blood-colored stone steles fell from the sky, slamming heavily into the center of the believer army, and a terrifying aura instantly spread.
This object was none other than the S-Rank Building — [Immortal Army Soul Stele].
As the two buildings landed within the army.
In an instant, a terrifying power spread out.
The Martial Artist believers under Ma Huainan felt as if infinite power were surging within their bodies.
Their Physical Body, which had already reached its limit, underwent another transformation at this moment.
Their muscles began to bulge rapidly, their bodies expanded, and their originally ordinary physiques became even more burly.
The Qi and blood on every Martial Artist believer were like burning flames, rising crazily.
Boom!
The power of the army soul covered the entire army, and the blood-colored Formation, which had already begun to show cracks, actually stabilized once again.
Furthermore, under the reinforcement of this power, Ma Huainan’s army began to push forward.
Facing the bombardment of sky-filling energy cannons, they actually withstood the pressure and launched a charge toward Yang Eleven’s zombie army.
Seeing this scene, a crazed smile appeared on Ma Huainan’s face.
“Hahahaha!”
“These are the two S-rank war building that the Sima Family invested in me when I reached the God Realm!”
“You didn’t expect this, did you?”
“Even if you possess more Divinity Points, without the channels, it is impossible to buy this level of war building!”
Ma Huainan’s voice was full of smugness.
This was his true trump card.
In fact, during the battle on the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom, he had originally intended to use these two [Immortal Army Soul Stele]s.
But the development of that battle had completely exceeded his expectations.
Yang Fan’s Smart Weapons suddenly erupted, directly disrupting all his plans.
Furthermore, at the time, his believers lacked equipment, and a large number of believers were infected with corpse poison during the battle, causing their overall combat power to drop significantly.
Therefore, in the end, Ma Huainan chose to hide his trump card.
But now, it was the moment to truly decide life and death.
These two S-rank war building were finally brought out by him.
S-rank war building, even for a Peerless Prodigy like Ma Huainan, were not something one could buy just because one wanted to.
At the Primordial Academy, there was an annual purchase quota limit.
And after arriving at the frontline, although there was an additional channel to exchange for them using military merits.
Ma Huainan had already poured all of those military merits into the Cultivation of his believers, purchasing large amounts of Resources to enhance their strength.
The most important of which was exchanging for the [War God Codex].
After all, he had never thought that he would break out into a Divine Kingdom War in the short term.
Ma Huainan was very confident at this moment.

In his view, the opponent was following the path of a Corpse Cultivator and could possess such a Divine Kingdom foundation because they had likely survived for tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands of years.
By relying on time to accumulate terrifying wealth, the opponent therefore possessed a large number of A-Rank War Structure(s), as well as a terrifying quantity of Smart Weapons.
But S-Rank Building(s) were simply not things that could be bought with money alone, and they almost never circulated on the market.
This was his chance to turn the tide!

“Block their charge for me.”
“Yes!”
The White Zombie commander responded respectfully.
Subsequently, a large number of White Zombie believers began to act.
Twenty massive Flesh Scourge Mother Nests slowly appeared on the battlefield.
On the battlefield, a thick, nauseating scent of rotting blood suddenly wafted from the rear of the zombie army.
The next moment.
Rumble!
The earth began to tremble as twenty massive flesh spheres slowly rolled forward, their enormous bodies crushing the ground and leaving trails of flesh behind.
They arrived at the very front of the zombie army, like twenty mobile war fortresses, exuding a heart-palpitating aura.
Immediately after, the Flesh Scourge Mother Nests began to operate.
“Hiss—”
Thick green poisonous mist spewed out from the hives and spread rapidly.
At the same time, cracks opened at the bottom of the hives, and a large amount of pitch-black, viscous corrosive liquid flowed out.
As this liquid hit the ground, it instantly hissed.
The hard earth began to be corroded.
In just a moment, the originally flat battlefield was forcibly altered by this acidic liquid.
Streams of toxic liquid, resembling small rivers, appeared between the two armies.
They flowed slowly, completely separating Ma Huainan’s army from the zombie legion.
Seeing this scene, Ma Huainan’s expression changed instantly.
“What is this thing?”
He immediately asked his intelligent lifeform.
He had never seen this flesh structure before.
But just by feeling the terrifying aura emanating from it, he understood that this was by no means an ordinary war structure.
A moment later, the voice of the intelligent lifeform sounded.
But this time, the voice carried a hint of undisguisable trembling.
“Master, this is an s-class war structure—the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.”
“It possesses extremely strong defensive and mobility capabilities.”
“This structure has a very high compatibility with gods who follow the Corpse Cultivator path.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s pupils contracted sharply.
“S... s-class war structure?”
“How is this possible?”
“Twenty of them?”
“Twenty S-rank war building?”
“Impossible! What kind of joke is this!”
At this moment, even Ma Huainan, who possessed an SS-class Divine Kingdom Talent, completely lost his composure.
His consciousness fluctuated wildly.
He could not understand why the opponent possessed such a terrifying war foundation.
S-rank war building were something even he had to rely on the Sima Family’s channels to obtain.
But now, the opponent had actually brought out twenty of them all at once!
“There is no way back...” Ma Huainan gritted his teeth.
By now, he had no other choice.
No matter what was in front, he had to charge through.
Otherwise, it was just waiting for death.
“My believers! Charge, entire army!”
“At all costs, break through their defensive line!”
“Kill!”
As the Divine Decree descended, countless Human race believers roared and charged forward.
Under the blessing of the Immortal Army Soul Steles, they erupted with astonishing fighting will.
Even though countless energy cannons were still raining down from the sky, they did not retreat in the slightest.
Step by step, they continued to push forward.
Soon, they arrived before the river of poison formed by the corrosive liquid.
A large number of Martial Master-Level believers at the very front stepped into it first, and the advanced protective equipment on their bodies activated instantly.
“Sizzle, sizzle—”
The piercing sound of corrosion rang out continuously, and white smoke began to rise from the surface of their equipment.
Clearly, even though the Level of this protective equipment was not low, it still could not completely withstand the poison released by the Flesh Scourge Mother Nests.
As for some believers with ordinary equipment, their toes merely touched a bit of the toxic liquid.
The next second, their bodies began to convulse violently.
Their skin rotted rapidly, their flesh mutated, and signs of zombification actually began to appear.
The terrifying nature of this toxic liquid even far exceeded ordinary corpse poison.
The toxins released by the Flesh Scourge Mother Nests fused a large amount of corrosive substances with corpse poison.
Even advanced protective equipment would be gradually destroyed after prolonged contact.
“Ah!” one believer screamed. His body had already begun to show clear signs of zombification.
Just at this moment.
“Swish!” A flash of sword light streaked by.
His head flew off instantly.
The one who struck was the Martial Master Realm officer behind him.
That officer’s eyes were cold, without any hesitation.
“Everyone, listen to my command!”
“Build a human bridge!”
“Brothers with advanced protective equipment, all enter the poison river!”
“Let the brothers behind pass!”
After saying this, he was the first to step into the poison river.
Then, with his hands supporting himself on the ground, he lay directly in the corrosive liquid.
“Step on my body and cross!”
“Continue advancing!”
“Don’t stop!”
At this moment, military orders were as heavy as mountains.
Countless high-Level believers acted one after another.
They did not choose to protect themselves, but instead voluntarily entered the poison river, using their own bodies to pave a path for the army behind them.
Just at this moment.
Boom!
An energy cannon suddenly broke through the blood-colored Formation.
It landed precisely in the poison river, and a terrifying explosion detonated instantly.
“Boom!”
The Martial Master officer lying on the ground didn’t even have time to react before his entire body was blown into a mist of blood.
A large amount of toxic liquid was kicked up by the shockwave and splashed everywhere.
Many believers without protective equipment were instantly contaminated.
In just a few breaths, their bodies began to undergo zombification.
“Do not let the Formation fall into chaos! Block these attacks for me!”
“Our home is behind us!”
“For the Divine Kingdom! For the gods!”
“Hold the line for me!”
At the center of the Formation, a Martial King-Level believer roared.
Terrifying Qi and blood power erupted, forcibly stabilizing the Formation that had become chaotic due to the charge.
“Charge through!”
“Kill these invaders!”

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Suicide Squad
paragraphs: The fighting spirit of Ma Huainan’s followers far exceeded that of an ordinary god’s army.
Soon, more and more Martial Master-level followers charged into the poisonous river.
They used their own bodies to fill in these highly toxic rivers, and the army behind them stepped on their bodies to continue moving forward.
One step, then another, charging toward the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.
“General! The officer’s protective suit is damaged, and there are already signs of zombification!” one person shouted.
“This is the antidote prepared for us by the God!”
A medical follower rushed over, “Inject it immediately!”
“All medical teams, move out!”
“Anyone showing signs of zombification, inject the antidote immediately!”
“If they can no longer be saved...”
The general fell silent for a moment, then gritted his teeth and said:
“Kill them immediately! We cannot let them lose their final dignity!”
“Everyone, hold the line! We must defend our homeland!”
“For the Divine Kingdom! For the God! Keep moving forward!”
Finally, after suffering heavy casualties.
Ma Huainan’s army finally succeeded in crossing the river formed by corrosive poison.
At this moment, they were only one final line of defense away from the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.
“Kill!”
Following a roar from a Martial King-level follower, countless followers erupted simultaneously.
Terrifying power of Qi and blood shot into the sky, condensing in mid-air into streaks of blood-colored Dragons.
These Dragons roared, carrying destructive power, and slammed fiercely into the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest ahead.
Boom!
A massive roar resonated across the heavens and earth.
The massive bodies of the twenty S-rank war building were actually forcibly pushed back under the impact of this terrifying power.
The giant meat spheres slid across the ground, moving backward by a full half-meter.
However, what made Ma Huainan’s expression turn ugly was this:
Even after such a terrifying attack landed, although cracks appeared on the surface of the Flesh Scourge Mother Nests, they soon began to squirm and recover.
“Keep attacking! Don’t stop!”
Ma Huainan roared.
His followers frantically channeled the power of the Formation, and streaks of blood-colored attacks continuously bombarded the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.
At the same time, the White Zombie followers also began to act.
A large number of corpse pills were thrown into the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.
The next moment, the interior of the hive began to operate crazily.
Dense black poisonous gas was released outward once again, and the entire battlefield seemed to transform into a death zone.
However, Ma Huainan had been prepared for this.
While attacking the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest, a large number of followers continuously took out glass bottles.
These glass bottles were filled with a pale blue liquid.
Then, they smashed them onto the ground without hesitation.
Smash!
The glass shattered, and the pale blue liquid quickly spread.
The corpse poison that had originally permeated the air actually began to be rapidly neutralized.
For a moment, the concentration of poisonous fog on the battlefield decreased significantly.
Even the poisonous gas released by the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest was suppressed to a certain degree.
However, Ma Huainan, watching this scene from high above, felt no joy on his face; instead, he revealed a hint of heartache.
These special agents were not ordinary Resources.
They were war supplies he had purchased from various shops at the frontline, costing nearly ten billion Divinity Points.
As more and more zombie armies sent by Yang Fan entered the Divine Kingdom, the sense of crisis in Ma Huainan’s heart grew stronger.
Therefore, everything he purchased was high-quality Resources.
Originally, according to his plan, if this war didn’t require them.
These items could have been returned at a discount, at least allowing him to recover a portion of the cost.
But now it seemed... he had underestimated the difficulty of this war.
Even these pre-prepared Resources were far from enough.
“A full twenty S-rank war building...”
Ma Huainan’s eyes were complex.
“Who on earth are you?”
“To possess such a foundation in a Divine Kingdom, you could never be just an ordinary god.”
One possibility after another flashed through his mind.
Which of the Five Great Families could it be?
“Could it be the Gu Family? Or the Lu Family?”
“Among them, who is following the path of a Corpse Cultivator?”
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan even felt his head beginning to ache faintly.
He could never have imagined that the opponent possessed such terrifying Resources.
On the other side of the battlefield, Yang Eleven watched as the twenty Flesh Scourge Mother Nests retreated continuously under the attacks of the Formation.
A hint of coldness gradually appeared in his eyes.
“Number 2,” he said softly.
A White Zombie follower behind him immediately stepped forward, “Marshal.”
“Reinforcements have not yet arrived, so it is not convenient to reveal too many trump cards right now.”
Yang Eleven’s voice was calm.
“Execute the suicide squad plan.”
The White Zombie follower’s expression became solemn, “Yes!”
Then he retreated quickly.
A moment later, one Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers slowly opened.
A large number of Zombie Generals walked out from within.
The flesh on these Zombie Generals had long since rotted away.
But what was different was that they were all equipped with fourth-tier Smart Weapon.
Cold Mechanical armor covered their entire bodies.
In their eyes, there was not a trace of fear, but rather excitement and determination.
“By the Marshal’s order, execute the suicide squad plan.”
The lead White Zombie snapped his fingers.
Afterward, several Zombie Generals brought over a few huge boxes.
The boxes were opened, and inside were row upon row of pitch-black iron spheres.
On top of every iron sphere was a simple activation button.
“One for each of you, head to the frontline immediately!”
The White Zombie’s voice was cold.
“Yes, Officer!”
A large number of Zombie Generals responded in unison.
“For the Divine Kingdom!”
“For the God!”
The next moment, they all loaded the black iron spheres into the storage space on their chests.
Then, driving the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, they rushed rapidly toward the very front of the battlefield.
High above, Ma Huainan’s conscious projection had been watching the entire battlefield.
As the battle continued, his expression grew increasingly ugly.
Although the overall front line was still advancing, the situation was not developing according to his expectations at all.
The defensive capabilities of those twenty S-rank war building were simply too terrifying.
Even though his followers relied on the power of the battle Formation to continuously launch attacks against them, they could only cause limited damage.
What was even more troublesome was that these Flesh Scourge Mother Nests possessed extremely strong self-recovery capabilities.
The injuries just inflicted would soon recover.
If this continued, the longer the time dragged on, the smaller his advantage would become.
Because as the battle continued, the pressure borne by the grand Formation would become greater and greater, and there would be more and more loopholes.
And once the Formation collapsed, the energy cannons of those Smart Weapon would bring indiscriminate slaughter to his followers.
“What to do...”
Ma Huainan clenched his fists tightly.
“There is no turning back now.”
His eyes gradually became crazed.
“If this battle is lost...”
“I will only have one final path left.”
That choice was the one he was least willing to face.
Because in this world, no god is willing to voluntarily disclose the coordinates of their own Divine Kingdom.
The Divine Kingdom coordinates are a god’s greatest secret.
Although handing the coordinates over to the Sima Family could exchange for protection.
It also meant that from this day forward, his life would be completely bound to the Sima Family.
Even if he became a High-Order God in the future, it would be very difficult to truly stand on an equal footing with the Sima Family again.
He would no longer be a partner to the Sima Family, but would become a vassal of the Sima Family.
“Unless it is the very last step... I must never take that path.”

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Admiration
paragraphs: Just as Ma Huainan was caught in a dilemma, a strong, ominous premonition suddenly welled up in his heart.
It was an instinctive perception of danger that came with being a god.
“Boom!”
The next moment, a heaven-shaking explosion erupted from within his army Formation.
Terrifying flames surged instantly, and starting from the center of the explosion, the ground for hundreds of meters around was blasted into a massive, deep crater.
Countless believers did not even have time to scream before they were reduced to ashes by this terrifying force.
The shockwave generated by the explosion slammed fiercely against the entire bloody Formation.
Boom!
The Formation shuddered violently, and countless Formation runes flickered wildly.
Even the Martial King-level believers who were maintaining the Formation could not help but turn pale.
“What is happening?”
Ma Huainan looked sharply toward the direction of the explosion.
However, before he could figure out the situation, black shadows suddenly shot over from the distant Zombie Kingdom army.
They streaked across the sky with astonishing speed, like artillery shells being fired.
Ma Huainan’s pupils contracted sharply, “What is that?”
At this moment, the Zombie Kings on the frontline had the Smart Weapon on their bodies shift rapidly.
The Mechanical armor that originally covered their entire bodies reorganized quickly under the control of the System.
A large amount of Mechanical structure extended outward, eventually transforming into a massive Mechanical arm.
And what was being grasped were none other than the Zombie General wearing the fourth-tier Smart Weapon.
Boom!
The Mechanical arm exerted force suddenly.
The next moment, one Zombie General after another was hurled out like a real artillery shell.
The target was Ma Huainan’s army position.
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Before Ma Huainan could even react, a series of terrifying explosions rang out one after another.
A Zombie General landed directly into the Human race army.
The next second, a destructive force erupted instantly.
Tens of thousands of believers were swallowed up in an instant.
One Zombie General even landed precisely near the poisonous river.
Boom!
The terrifying explosion instantly blew apart the connected poisonous river.
Large amounts of corrosive poison splashed everywhere, directly cutting through Ma Huainan’s army Formation.
“This...”
“What on earth is this?”
Ma Huainan’s complexion changed completely.
He could not understand why these zombies would suddenly self-destruct.
Even less could he understand why the power of this self-destructive attack was so terrifying to this extent.
The next moment, the voice of the intelligent lifeform sounded urgently.
“Master! This is a micro-nuke!”
“The opponent is using a suicide attack!”
“The army must retreat immediately!”
“Continuing to stay here will only cause more casualties!”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s face looked terrible to the extreme.
“Retreat?”
“How can we retreat now?”
He looked at the battlefield before him, his voice low.
If he retreated now, it meant he was giving up his last chance to attack.
And the army, having lost the protection of the Formation, would be directly exposed to the artillery fire of those Smart Weapon.
By then, his army of believers would simply become moving targets.
More importantly... he did not dare to gamble.
He did not dare to gamble on how much longer the energy of those Smart Weapon of the opponent could last.
Just then, Ma Huainan suddenly felt his consciousness weaken by another fraction.
He looked sharply at the battlefield, and then his face turned deathly pale in an instant.
The believers who were merely injured around the locations where the micro-nukes exploded were undergoing terrifying changes at this moment.
Their bodies began to rot, and their flesh began to mutate.
Even some believers who were further away from the center of the explosion showed obvious signs of turning into zombies.

What shocked Ma Huainan even more was that the advanced protective equipment he had spent a huge price to purchase now had some tiny holes that were difficult to detect with the naked eye, as if they had been pierced by countless fine needles.
“This is...” Ma Huainan’s pupils contracted.
The intelligent lifeform analyzed it quickly.
“Master!”
“The opponent is not simply using micro-nukes.”
“They have covered the surface of the bombs with a layer of special diffusing agents.”
“Once they explode, these substances will further expand the lethal range.”
“Besides that...”
The intelligent lifeform paused for a moment.
“These diffusing agents should also be soaked in high-concentration corpse poison.”
“Using the shockwave generated by the explosion, it spreads the corpse poison to the entire area.”
After hearing the analysis, Ma Huainan fell silent.
Then, he suddenly laughed maniacally.
“Hahahaha!”
“Good! Very good!”
“You are ruthless! And poisonous enough!”
“Is this what a god who has lived for tens of thousands of years is like? I have truly learned something new today!”
Looking at that incredibly cruel scene on the battlefield, a trace of morbid admiration actually sprouted in Ma Huainan’s heart.
This method of warfare had already exceeded his understanding of war.
With such methods, how could one not admire them?
The next moment, more black shadows flew out from the Zombie Kingdom army again.
One, ten, a hundred, a thousand...
A large number of Zombie General began to use the same method to rush into the Human race army.
They did not have any hesitation.
The moment they landed, they pressed the activation button of the micro-nuke on their chests.
“For the Divine Kingdom, for the god.”
Boom!
The terrifying explosion descended once again.
Every explosion took away the lives of tens of thousands of believers, not even leaving behind complete corpses.
And what was even more terrifying was that death was not the end.
As the corpse poison continued to spread after the explosion, more and more surviving believers began to show abnormalities.
Even Martial Master-level powerhouses, after being affected by the micro-nuke, did not take more than a quarter of an hour to complete the zombie transformation process.
Their bodies gradually lost control.
Their eyes turned blood-red, and their consciousness gradually dissipated.
Eventually, they became new zombies.
For a time, more and more “neutrals” appeared on the front line of Ma Huainan’s army.
They were once comrades who fought side by side.
Now, they began to pounce crazily at their companions beside them.
The entire battlefield fell into complete chaos.
And this war also began to develop in the most cruel direction.
At this moment, Yang Fan, who was in the core area of the Divine Kingdom Core, looked at this scene on the battlefield, and a strange look could not help but flash in his eyes.
“Did Yang Eleven do this?”
Yang Fan asked.
“Reporting to Master, that is correct.”
Yang Da nodded.
“The inspiration for this combat method originated from a Black Armored Beetle Race Insectoid Demigod that Master encountered during your demigod period.”

“Back then, when the opponent was in a desperate situation, he had his subordinate believers perform self-destruction through a special secret technique, in exchange for massive casualties on our side.”
“In that battle, our believers suffered heavy losses.”
“Therefore, after taking over the Zombie Kingdom, Yang Eleven proposed a similar idea.”
“Using a small number of believers to carry out suicide attacks in exchange for large-scale casualties of the enemy, thereby reducing the overall war attrition.”
“Before this Divine Kingdom War, Master procured a large amount of disposable war supplies, which just happened to make this suicide squad he specially trained useful.”
Yang Da explained.
“A suicide squad?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Endless Enmity
paragraphs: “These Zombie Generals are not ordinary zombies.”
“They already possess independent thinking abilities; won’t doing this cause problems?”
Yang Fan’s tone carried a hint of caution.
He did not oppose sacrifices in war, but these Zombie Generals were different from the initial zombies that lacked consciousness.
Once wisdom is generated, it means they already possess thoughts of their own.
The Zombie Kingdom had once experienced a protest because of this issue.
Yang Fan did not wish for such a thing to happen again.
“Rest assured, Master.”
Yang Da said immediately.
“Nowadays, the breeding and cultivation of the entire Zombie Kingdom are all completed through Cloning Nutrient Pods.”
“Newly born Zombie believers do not have memories from their human period.”
“As for these suicide squads, Yang Eleven has long since designated a special area in the Eternal Corpse Mine, where all members are under fully enclosed management.”
“Furthermore, any believer who breaks through to the Zombie General level will no longer be allowed to continue to Cultivate.”
“Every month, intelligent lifeform will organize collective meetings.”
“To conduct ideological education regarding dedication, sacrifice, protecting the Divine Kingdom, loyalty to the gods, and so on.”
“At the same time, this matter has already obtained the unanimous consent of the current high-level White Zombie believers in the Zombie Kingdom.”
“According to the simulation calculations of intelligent lifeform, the risk of this plan is close to zero.”
Yang Da said earnestly.
After hearing this explanation, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
“Yang San... ahem, this guy Yang Eleven, he really always manages to come up with some new tricks for me.”
“This suicide squad is quite interesting.”
Yang Fan said after contemplating for a moment.
“After this Divine Kingdom War ends, reward Yang Eleven with one billion Divinity Points in Resources.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da responded respectfully.
For Yang Fan, what he needed to consider was never the fairness of a certain portion of believers, but the development of the entire Divine Kingdom.
As a god, the position he stood in determined his way of thinking.
As long as something could make the entire Divine Kingdom become stronger, he would support it.
In this world, absolute fairness does not exist.
Those ordinary Zombie believers born in Cloning Nutrient Pods, the moment they were selected into the suicide squad, could only be said that such was their fate.
In Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, there were some lives that, when born, had parents who were Martial Emperor powerhouses, or possessed the bloodline of Nascent Soul level powerhouses.
Others were merely descendants of entry-level lives.
Even though Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had sufficient Resources nowadays, believers of different statuses still enjoyed different treatment.
The heights they could reach in the future also had a high probability of having huge disparities.
And those ordinary zombies born from Cloning Nutrient Pods, their starting point was far lower than other lives from the very beginning.
This was not caused by Yang Fan, nor was it the fault of any one person; it was the rules of the world itself.
As a god, Yang Fan would not forcefully change this disparity.
His Divine Kingdom was not some utopian world of equality for all.
As long as life exists, there will be desires.
With desires, there will be disparities.
With disparities, classes will form.
The Divine Kingdom is like this, so how is the Real World where he resides any different?
Someone once yearned for a world of absolute fairness, but the Real World would never operate according to ideals.
Lives have strengths and weaknesses, Resources have amounts, talents have levels, and backgrounds are different.
This is the rule by which all things operate.
The weak ask the heavens, why is fate different?
The strong tread upon the world, carving out their own paths.
Birth and status are determined by heaven, yet heights are followed by the paths of the world.
The Divine Kingdom has been thus for ten thousand years, all states of sentient beings entering the cycle.
Yang Fan looked at the cruel scenes of war, his eyes calm.
The path of a god is inherently a path of constant competition, constant devouring, and constant ascension.
At this moment on the frontline battlefield, as more and more suicide squads charged into Ma Huainan’s army.
One micro-nuclear bomb after another was detonated.
The terrifying explosions, like the scythe of the Grim Reaper, continuously harvested the lives of the Human race believers.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Each explosion represented the death of tens of thousands or even more believers.
The great Formation that had been barely maintained by relying on the [Immortal Army Soul Stele] finally began to show irreparable cracks.
One, two, more and more cracks appeared.
Rumble!
The entire blood-colored Formation completely collapsed.
After losing the protection of the Formation, the Smart Weapon on the zombies once again revealed its ferocious side.
Countless energy cannons, like a torrential downpour, poured down crazily from the sky.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The sounds of explosions rang through the entire Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, the once mighty 500 billion-strong Human race army began to usher in true destruction.
“Oh God...”
“We have tried our best...”
“The enemy is truly too strong...”
A severely injured Martial Master believer who had fallen to the ground looked at the energy cannons falling from the sky, his eyes filled with despair.
“My child...”
“Father cannot protect you anymore...”
The voice fell.
The next moment, the terrifying explosion completely swallowed his body.
The entire battlefield had completely turned into a living hell.
The earth was completely soaked in blood; those low-lying areas gathered into patches of blood-colored lakes.
Looking around, there were severed limbs and broken arms everywhere.
Shattered armor, broken weapons, and those corpses lying in pools of blood.
Screams, wails of grief, desperate howls, and roars before death.
Constantly echoed between this heaven and earth.
And just at this moment.
“Rumble!”
The Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the distance slowly opened, and a large number of ordinary zombies surged out from within.
They had no consciousness, only the most primitive instinct for infection.
Countless severely injured Human race believers who had fallen to the ground and lost the ability to resist quickly became their targets.
Sharp fangs tore through flesh and blood, cold claws pierced through bodies.
A large number of wounded were dragged into the zombie horde in despair.
Subsequently, the bodies of these believers began to change.
Flesh rotted, pupils became gray and dim.
In just a short moment, these Human race believers who had once fought side by side became new ordinary zombies.
They turned around, joined the camp of their former enemies, and continued to pounce toward the remaining Human race believers.
The entire battlefield seemed to have formed a death cycle that could not be stopped.
In the sky, the consciousness phantom of Ma Huainan was becoming fainter and fainter.
His aura was also rapidly weakening.
The 500 billion-strong army was the most powerful force in his Divine Kingdom.
It was also the core foundation he had cultivated by expending countless Resources since becoming a god.
And now, it was all buried here.
As for the remaining believers stationed in the Divine Kingdom Core area, most were ordinary believers without high combat power.
They simply could not resist an invasion of this level.
At this moment, Ma Huainan finally understood.
Relying on his own power, he could no longer protect his Divine Kingdom.
He had lost, completely lost.
But even so, there was still no fear in his eyes.
He looked toward the location of Yang Fan’s zombie army in the distance, his voice slowly spreading across the entire Divine Kingdom.
“No matter who you are...”
“I, Ma Huainan, hereby swear.”
“As long as I am still alive, one day, I will definitely trample your Divine Kingdom!”
“Between you and me... it is to the death!”
As his voice fell, his consciousness instantly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Slacking Off at Work
paragraphs: In the Real World, Ma Huainan opened his eyes.
Without the slightest hesitation, he immediately disclosed his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family through a special channel.
But this was not the end.
The next moment, his consciousness entered the Virtual World, and he directly contacted the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, “One”.
This was a special privilege belonging to Peerless Prodigy-level geniuses.
When one’s own Divine Kingdom encounters an irresistible crisis, one can apply for emergency support from the Federation.
As long as a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius does not fall, they are almost certain to step into the High-Order God level in the future.
And for any race, a High-Order God is an immeasurable strategic asset.
Therefore, the Federal Government had long established a comprehensive emergency plan.
Once the Divine Kingdom of such a Genius encounters a crisis, other gods will enter their Divine Kingdom to coordinate the defense.
One day in the outside world is one year in the Divine Kingdom.
Just as Ma Huainan disclosed his Divine Kingdom coordinates, his Divine Kingdom space suddenly fluctuated violently.
The next moment, a large number of spatial passages opened.
Countless Human race believers walked out from within.
In just a moment, an army of tens of billions descended, and the number was still increasing.
Ten billion, thirty billion, fifty billion, one hundred billion!
The entire sky and land of the Divine Kingdom were completely occupied by the Human race army.
Among these reinforcements were legions of intelligent lifeform under the command of Mechanical gods.
They were lined up neatly, their arms already transformed into terrifying artillery turrets.
Dense muzzles of guns simultaneously locked onto the direction of Yang Fan’s army.
There were also gods of the Cultivation Path, with tens of thousands of Nascent Soul-level believers standing in mid-air.
Terrifying spells were continuously condensing in their hands.
Above the sky, spiritual power surged, as if ten thousand immortals had descended upon the world.
And at the very front was a powerful army of the Martial Route.
Their Qi and blood soared to the heavens, their bodies as if cast from steel.
Martial King-level believers stood at the very front, actively taking on the role of meat shields, forming an unbreakable defensive line.
Three completely different development routes were perfectly fused at this moment.
Disciplined and coordinated with tacit understanding.
At the core of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan slowly stood up.
Looking at the suddenly appearing Human race army, a hint of solemnity finally appeared in his eyes.
“So fast...”
He said in a low voice.
He naturally knew what it meant for Ma Huainan’s consciousness to leave the Divine Kingdom.
As long as the other party wasn’t stupid, they would disclose the coordinates immediately.
It was just that he hadn’t expected the speed of the support to be this fast.
Furthermore, the strength of this reinforcement army also exceeded his expectations.
One Mechanical god, two Cultivation gods, and two Martial Arts gods.
A full five gods had descended to provide support.
“It seems...”
“I still underestimated the status of a Peerless Prodigy.”
“These supporting gods don’t look like ordinary characters.”
Yang Fan sat back on his throne, his voice carrying a hint of seriousness.
“Master.”
Yang Da analyzed:
“Based on the combat power configuration displayed by the other side, this is likely a support team composed of five Tier 3 Gods.”
“And judging from the coordination between them.”
“They should be a professional team that has long been responsible for Divine Kingdom support missions.”
Yang Fan nodded; he naturally realized this.
The real Divine Kingdom War had only just begun.
The next moment, five powerful projections of divine consciousness descended simultaneously into Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
At the same time, Ma Huainan, who had originally left, also had his consciousness return to the Divine Kingdom.
He hurriedly stepped forward and bowed respectfully, “Seniors, thank you all for your support.”
“You’re welcome,” one of the gods replied indifferently.
Looking at the vast army of one hundred billion Human race believers before him, Ma Huainan felt an unprecedented sense of peace of mind.
He had already disclosed his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family and had contacted the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
No matter how strong this god who followed the Corpse Cultivator route was, how could they possibly contend with the Sima Family?
In Ma Huainan’s view, he was finally safe.
Although from now on he would fully join the Sima Family and even need to obey arrangements for many matters.
But looking at it from another perspective.
With the Sima Family as a backer, at least he wouldn’t have to worry about safety issues regarding his future Divine Kingdom development.
“Not an Foreign Deity?”
The leading Mechanical god looked at the zombie army in the distance, his brows furrowing slightly.
His tone carried a hint of confusion.
In his expectation, when the Divine Kingdom of a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius was invaded, it was basically an attack launched by an Foreign Deity.
However, these zombie believers before him, who were exuding corpse aura, although they looked extremely evil.
But as gods, they could see the essence of these life forms at a glance; they still belonged to the Human race.
That is to say...
The enemy in this war was also a Human race god.
After Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom coordinates were disclosed.
Inside the Human Federation government, the highest level of alert immediately sounded.
The invasion of a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius’s Divine Kingdom was an extremely serious incident within the Federal Government.
Almost the first moment the news was received.
The Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, “One”, issued a support order.
And this set of procedures had already been rehearsed countless times by the Federal Government.
These gods were not powerhouses gathered temporarily, but official staff members within the Federal Government system.
In their daily lives, they had a fixed salary of Divinity Points.
And after every Divine Kingdom support mission executed, they would also receive extra rewards.
Especially for a Peerless Prodigy like Ma Huainan.
As long as they assisted in successfully defending the Divine Kingdom, the rewards obtained would even be enough to equal several years of their normal income.
However, in the past, the missions they executed were all facing invasions by Foreign Deitys.
So, seeing this scene before them now, they were so surprised.
“It seems...”
“This is much simpler.”
The Mechanical god said in a low voice.
He did not immediately order an attack.
The next moment, his projection of divine consciousness instantly arrived above the zombie army.
“This Fellow Daoist, I am a Federal Government staff member, Weng Chonghe.”
The voice was vast, instantly spreading throughout the entire battlefield.
“The god you are invading is a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius.”

“According to Article 30,064 of the Federal Constitution, if the Divine Kingdom of a Peerless Prodigy encounters an external invasion within one hundred years of their breakthrough to godhood, the Federal Government is obligated to coordinate the defense.”
“This is the Human race’s protection mechanism for geniuses.”
“Nowadays, Foreign Deitys are eyeing us covetously; the future of our Human race requires more High-Order Gods to hold the fort.”
“Therefore, as fellow members of the Human race.”
“Even in the Divine Kingdom world, I hope that you, Fellow Daoist, can abide by federal law.”
Weng Chonghe’s voice resounded across the heavens and earth.
At the core of the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow upon hearing these words.
“There is such a law?”
Yang Da nodded.
“Reporting to Master, it does exist.”
Yang Fan sneered.
“According to what he means, do I have to go back to the Real World and wait for one hundred years?”
Yang Da shook his head.
“That is not the case; even after one hundred years, if Master launches a Divine Kingdom War again.”
“These Federal Government staff members will not take action, but the Sima Family’s support forces will still appear.”
“The other party is doing this now more to try to persuade a truce.”
“If Master is willing to withdraw the troops, their mission will be over.”
“The Divinity Points reward obtained will still be issued by the Federal Government.”
“After all, these staff members also do not wish for their own armies of believers to suffer too great a loss.”
Yang Da analyzed.
Hearing this, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched.
“So that’s it, they are trying to slack off at work.”

Without the slightest hesitation, he immediately disclosed his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family through a special channel.
But this was not the end.
The next moment, his consciousness entered the Virtual World, and he directly contacted the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, “One”.
This was a special privilege belonging to Peerless Prodigy-level geniuses.
When one’s own Divine Kingdom encounters an irresistible crisis, one can apply for emergency support from the Federation.
As long as a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius does not fall, they are almost certain to step into the High-Order God level in the future.
And for any race, a High-Order God is an immeasurable strategic asset.
Therefore, the Federal Government had long established a comprehensive emergency plan.
Once the Divine Kingdom of such a Genius encounters a crisis, other gods will enter their Divine Kingdom to coordinate the defense.
One day in the outside world is one year in the Divine Kingdom.

The next moment, a large number of spatial passages opened.
Countless Human race believers walked out from within.

Ten billion, thirty billion, fifty billion, one hundred billion!
The entire sky and land of the Divine Kingdom were completely occupied by the Human race army.
Among these reinforcements were legions of intelligent lifeform under the command of Mechanical gods.
They were lined up neatly, their arms already transformed into terrifying artillery turrets.
Dense muzzles of guns simultaneously locked onto the direction of Yang Fan’s army.
There were also gods of the Cultivation Path, with tens of thousands of Nascent Soul-level believers standing in mid-air.
Terrifying spells were continuously condensing in their hands.
Above the sky, spiritual power surged, as if ten thousand immortals had descended upon the world.
And at the very front was a powerful army of the Martial Route.
Their Qi and blood soared to the heavens, their bodies as if cast from steel.
Martial King-level believers stood at the very front, actively taking on the role of meat shields, forming an unbreakable defensive line.
Three completely different development routes were perfectly fused at this moment.
Disciplined and coordinated with tacit understanding.

Looking at the suddenly appearing Human race army, a hint of solemnity finally appeared in his eyes.

One Mechanical god, two Cultivation gods, and two Martial Arts gods.
A full five gods had descended to provide support.

“I still underestimated the status of a Peerless Prodigy.”
“These supporting gods don’t look like ordinary characters.”
Yang Fan sat back on his throne, his voice carrying a hint of seriousness.
“Master.”

“And judging from the coordination between them.”
“They should be a professional team that has long been responsible for Divine Kingdom support missions.”
Yang Fan nodded; he naturally realized this.

In Ma Huainan’s view, he was finally safe.
Although from now on he would fully join the Sima Family and even need to obey arrangements for many matters.
But looking at it from another perspective.
With the Sima Family as a backer, at least he wouldn’t have to worry about safety issues regarding his future Divine Kingdom development.

chapters.title: Chapter 458: We Won't Lose Money, Right!
paragraphs: Yang Fan shook his head and chuckled.
But the next moment, his eyes gradually turned cold.
“Pass the order to Yang Eleven, the main army reinforcements have arrived.”
“S-class war weapons and disposable war supplies—let him deploy them at will.”
“I want to see... whether these so-called support teams can withstand the true power of my Zombie Kingdom.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da nodded earnestly.
At this moment, Yang Fan realized in his heart that he had seemingly underestimated the importance of a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius to the entire Human race.
Five Tier 3 Gods arrived as reinforcements immediately, and there was even the power of the Sima Family behind them.
Not to be underestimated.
But even so, Yang Fan did not retreat in the slightest.
Because... his Zombie Kingdom had not truly revealed its full strength from beginning to end.
The current war weapon, the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, was only a part of his foundation.
His Divine Kingdom possessed a hundredfold time acceleration, and with Yang Da constantly expanding the Cloning Nutrient Pods.
Nowadays, there was absolutely no shortage of troops for his zombie believers.
During this period, he had spent a large amount of Divinity Points to purchase various disposable war supplies, and the S-rank war building had also not been truly committed to the battlefield.
The one hundred billion-strong Human race army before him was indeed not weak.
But wanting to stop him with this strength was far from enough.
Just as Ma Huainan’s consciousness left his Divine Kingdom to seek support from the Sima Family and the Federal Government.
The zombie armies within the Eternal Corpse Mine had long since marched to the frontline.
A large number of Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers opened, and countless zombie believers walked out from them.
Now, the number of troops on both sides had reached one hundred billion.
On one side was the elite Human race army sent by the Federal Government as reinforcements.
On the other side was the Zombie Kingdom legion under Yang Fan’s command.
Two terrifying forces stood in a standoff within Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Looking at the dense zombie army in the distance, Weng Chonghe couldn’t help but frown.
Especially when he saw the rows of neatly arranged Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, his expression became even more solemn.
Looking out, the number of A-Rank War Structures was so vast that he couldn’t see the end at a glance.
This terrifying war foundation made even him feel a trace of pressure.
“It seems... Fellow Daoist’s strength is even stronger than we imagined.”
Weng Chonghe sighed softly.
“It is our duty, since Fellow Daoist is unwilling to withdraw the troops.”
“Then we can only fight it out.”
As his voice fell, the phantom of Weng Chonghe’s consciousness dissipated, returning to the sky above his own army.
In fact, Divine Kingdom Wars occurring between members of the same race were not a rare occurrence.
After all, the world of gods was essentially still a competitive world.
For the sake of Resources, development, and the future, wars would likewise erupt between Human race gods.
It was just that Ma Huainan had a special status and was almost destined to become a High-Order God in the future.
That was why the Federal Government would activate a special protection mechanism and dispatch personnel to provide support.
Otherwise, how could a Divine Kingdom that had just achieved a breakthrough as a god have five Tier 3 Gods providing support?
But looking at it now...
This reward for support, I’m afraid, was not as easy to obtain as imagined.
The god before them who followed the Corpse Cultivator route had an exaggerated Divine Kingdom foundation.
Hundreds of millions of A-Rank War Structures, twenty S-rank war building, and that terrifying number of White Zombie believers.
Such power, even if the five of them joined forces, had to be taken seriously.
“Brother Weng.”
At this moment, a god who followed the Cultivation Path couldn’t help but speak up.
“The opponent possesses such a scale of war weapons, they are definitely not an unknown person.”
“Is there any relevant record in the Federal database?”
His tone carried a hint of doubt.
Although the opponent followed the Corpse Cultivator route, which had very weak individual combat strength among the many Divine Kingdom development routes.
But the problem was that the number of war buildings was simply too large.
These completely compensated for the shortcomings of the Corpse Cultivator route.
Now seeing those overwhelming Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, everyone couldn’t help but feel fearful in their hearts.
If they could pass Federal laws in the Real World to avoid a major war between the two sides, that would naturally be best.
After all, no one wanted their own believers to die in large numbers.
Weng Chonghe shook his head.
“No, when I just arrived here, I had already started searching.”
“Based on a comprehensive analysis of the opponent’s army configuration, formation information, war building types, and believer strength.”
“There is no matching Corpse Cultivator god in the Federal database.”
Hearing this, the expressions of the few became even more solemn.
At this moment, a burly, middle-aged god with a face full of flesh suddenly spoke up.
“Damn, my intelligent lifeform just transmitted data.”
“These are all A-Rank War Structures.”
“And those twenty at the very front... are S-rank war building!”
Speaking of this, the expression on his face was somewhat ugly.
“After this battle is fought.”
“We brothers won’t lose money, right?”
He spoke without any reservation, even saying it directly in front of Ma Huainan.
At this moment, Ma Huainan finally reacted. He looked at the boundless zombie army in the distance, and his whole person was somewhat dazed.
He never expected that in such a short time after leaving his Divine Kingdom.
The opponent’s troop strength had actually skyrocketed from the previous scale of ten billion to one hundred billion.
What was even more exaggerated was that among these armies, the A-Rank War Structures had increased proportionally.
At this moment, Ma Huainan truly realized just how large the gap between the two sides was.
The previous war was simply not evenly matched; rather, the opponent had been suppressing their strength all along.
If Yang Fan had dispatched all his forces from the beginning.
His 50 billion-strong army would likely not even have the qualification to hold out.
“If I had known this earlier...”
“I should have just announced the coordinates from the start.”
A trace of regret welled up in Ma Huainan’s heart.
“Fourth brother.”
Weng Chonghe raised his hand to stop him.
“Watch your words.”
“We are Federal Government personnel.”
“Our duty is to protect Human race geniuses and maintain Federal order.”
“Everything must prioritize serving the Federal people.”
“This is all what we should do.”
He spoke with righteous indignation.
However, the next moment, Weng Chonghe shifted his gaze to Ma Huainan, and a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
“Weng... Senior Weng?”
Looking at the other party’s expression, a bad premonition suddenly arose in Ma Huainan’s heart.
“Why call me Senior?”
Weng Chonghe smiled and waved his hand.
“Young Master Ma is a Peerless Prodigy, destined to become a High-Order God in the future.”
“We can just call each other by name.”
“Young Master Ma...”
Saying this, a look of embarrassment appeared on his face.
“The strength of this invader is simply too strong.”
“Although the few of us are willing to help.”
“But I’m afraid... we are somewhat incapable of doing so.”
Boom!
Hearing this sentence, Ma Huainan’s mind instantly went blank.
He suddenly looked up, his eyes filled with disbelief.
“What does that mean?”
“Weren’t they reinforcements sent by the Federal Government?”
“Weren’t they here to protect the safety of his Divine Kingdom?”
“Now... are they preparing to retreat just because they saw the opponent’s strength is too strong?”
Ma Huainan opened his mouth, and for a moment, he didn’t know what to say.

chapters.title: Chapter 459: The Heart is Full of Business
paragraphs: “Y-you... what do you mean by this?”
At this moment, Ma Huainan’s voice actually began to stutter.
If he were to lose the support of the people before him...
Then, given the terrifying strength the opponent had displayed.
It would only be a matter of time before his Divine Kingdom Core was seized.
At that point, he wouldn’t even have a final chance to turn the tables.
“Young Master Ma.”
Weng Chonghe sighed.
“It’s not that we aren’t willing to help you.”
“It’s just that to block an army of this scale, the losses for the five of us brothers would be truly too great.”
“The subsidies provided by the Federal Government are simply not enough to cover our consumption.”
Speaking up to this point, a smile appeared on Weng Chonghe’s face.
“I have heard that Peerless Prodigy-level Geniuses receive extra military merits subsidies during their first ten years at the frontline.”
“Look...”
His voice was meaningful.
Although there was a smile on his face, beneath that smile hid a hint of an indescribable intention.
Ma Huainan’s expression stiffened.
He was not a fool, so he naturally understood the meaning behind the other party’s words.
“H-how much?”
“20 million military merits.”
Weng Chonghe stated directly.
“Fine.”
Ma Huainan did not hesitate at all.
At this moment, he was truly afraid.
Compared to having his Divine Kingdom destroyed, what was a mere 20 million military merits?
As long as he could survive, there would be opportunities for everything in the future.
“Wait.”
Weng Chonghe added suddenly.
“For the five of us brothers, 20 million military merits each will suffice.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s face couldn’t help but twitch.
But in the end, he gritted his teeth and nodded, “Fine.”
“What kind of bullshit Federal Government staff.”
“What kind of bullshit serving the people of the Federation?”
Ma Huainan’s expression showed no change, but inside he was cursing up a storm.
“Their mouths are full of principles.”
“Their hearts are full of business.”
He was once one of the dazzling Geniuses of the Primordial Academy.
Countless people took the initiative to curry favor with him, major companies competed to invest in him, and later he even became a husband to Sima Yurao.
Throughout his journey, almost everything he saw was goodwill and flattery.
So he had always thought.
His own status and his own talent represented everything.
But until now, when he fell from the peak to the bottom.
When his Divine Kingdom faced destruction, he finally saw the world clearly.
It turned out that many people approaching him were not because of appreciation, but because they valued his worth.
Investing in him was for profit.
Following him was for profit.
Even marriage was just an exchange of benefits.
Now, these so-called reinforcements taking action were also because of benefits.
Only when a person has truly experienced despair can they see the things that were once covered by a halo.
And only after falling would they understand that this world never revolves around any single person.
“Hahahaha!”
Weng Chonghe suddenly burst into laughter.
“Everyone, Young Master Ma is a future Peerless Prodigy of our Human race.”
“Since he hasn’t grown up yet, how could we watch such a Genius fall?”
“Furthermore, the opponent is illegally invading the Divine Kingdom of a fellow clansman.”
“Today, no matter what, we must expel them!”
After saying this, Weng Chonghe waved his large hand.
“Form ranks to face the enemy!”
“Drive the enemies out of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Yes!”
The army behind him responded in unison, and the deity with a fleshy face from earlier also revealed a smile.
“Rest assured, Young Master Ma, with the five of us brothers here.”
“Your safety is absolutely not a problem.”
20 million military merits was not a small amount.
It was enough to purchase quite a few precious Resources, or even exchange for several S-rank war building.
This support mission was simply a huge profit.
As for whether Ma Huainan would break the agreement later, they were not worried at all.
Although Ma Huainan possessed an SS-Class Divine Kingdom Talent with huge future potential.
He was, after all, only someone who had just achieved a breakthrough to deityhood not long ago.
Now that the five of them knew his Divine Kingdom coordinates, if Ma Huainan dared to renege on the debt, they naturally had ways to make him pay the price.
Directly invading the Divine Kingdom carried too much risk.
But there were many ways to find a way to restrict the development of a deity.
At that point, what Ma Huainan would lose would not just be as simple as 100 million military merits.
A great battle was imminent.
As Weng Chonghe’s army began to advance forward.
On the other side, a large number of high-tier zombie believers also walked out from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
They stepped onto the battlefield, cold Mechanical armor covering their entire bodies.
The next moment, countless Smart Weapons started simultaneously.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Energy cannons filled the sky, instantly tearing through the air and blasting toward the Human race army.
“Fourth Brother!”
“Fifth Brother!”
Weng Chonghe’s expression changed.
“Immediately set up the defensive formation! Block these attacks!”
“Yes!”
The two Martial Arts deities acted immediately, and streaks of blood-colored barriers rose rapidly to withstand the artillery fire filling the sky.
However, looking at the densely packed Smart Weapons in the distance.
Weng Chonghe’s expression became increasingly grave.
“50 to 60 billion sets of Smart Weapons?”
“And the lowest grade is a third-tier Smart Weapon?”
A trace of shock flashed in his eyes.
“This is impossible.”
For Smart Weapons of this scale, even a Mechanical deity would need to expend huge Resources and time to forge them.
Moreover, the opponent was a deity who walked the path of a Corpse Cultivator.
Suddenly, a thought appeared in Weng Chonghe’s mind.
“Could it be... that behind this person, there stands a Mechanical deity?”
The manufacturing cost of a set of third-tier Smart Weapons was extremely expensive in itself.
If sold in the Federal Mall, the price would even be two or three times the cost.
And now, the Corpse Cultivator deity before him actually possessed tens of billions of sets of Smart Weapons.
This simply could not be explained by just being rich.
Weng Chonghe quickly made a judgment; it was absolutely impossible for the opponent to have purchased them all through normal channels.
The greatest possibility was that behind this Corpse Cultivator deity, there was a Mechanical deity friend.
The relationship between the two was extremely deep, and the friend was even willing to hand over such a massive Smart Weapon army to the other party to use via leasing.
Just as Weng Chonghe was thinking, the sky of the entire Divine Kingdom was completely covered by countless energy beams.
Densely packed energy cannons, like a rainstorm, tore through the sky and blasted toward the location of the Human race army.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The moment the energy cannons landed on the defensive formation, terrifying explosions sounded one after another.
The originally extremely stable blood-Qi barrier began to vibrate violently under such dense attacks.
Under normal circumstances, after the formation withstood attacks, the Martial Arts believers could continuously mobilize their own blood-Qi power to repair it.
But this time it was different; the number of energy cannons was simply too large.
Before one round of attacks had ended, the next round of artillery fire had already followed.
The previous attack had just been neutralized, and new energy cannons had already blasted the same spot, not giving the formation any chance to recover.
“Boom!”
Finally, an energy cannon penetrated the defensive gap and landed directly inside the Human race army.
A violent explosion sounded, and tens of thousands of believers instantly turned into blood mist.

sentences.text: “Y-you... what do you mean by this?”
At this moment, Ma Huainan’s voice actually began to stutter.
If he were to lose the support of the people before him...
Then, given the terrifying strength the opponent had displayed.
It would only be a matter of time before his Divine Kingdom Core was seized.
At that point, he wouldn’t even have a final chance to turn the tables.
“Young Master Ma.”
Weng Chonghe sighed.
“It’s not that we aren’t willing to help you.”
“It’s just that to block an army of this scale, the losses for the five of us brothers would be truly too great.”
“The subsidies provided by the Federal Government are simply not enough to cover our consumption.”
Speaking up to this point, a smile appeared on Weng Chonghe’s face.
“I have heard that Peerless Prodigy-level Geniuses receive extra military merits subsidies during their first ten years at the frontline.”
“Look...”
His voice was meaningful.
Although there was a smile on his face, beneath that smile hid a hint of an indescribable intention.
Ma Huainan’s expression stiffened.
He was not a fool, so he naturally understood the meaning behind the other party’s words.
“H-how much?”
“20 million military merits.”
Weng Chonghe stated directly.
“Fine.”
Ma Huainan did not hesitate at all.
At this moment, he was truly afraid.
Compared to having his Divine Kingdom destroyed, what was a mere 20 million military merits?
As long as he could survive, there would be opportunities for everything in the future.
“Wait.”
Weng Chonghe added suddenly.
“For the five of us brothers, 20 million military merits each will suffice.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s face couldn’t help but twitch.
But in the end, he gritted his teeth and nodded, “Fine.”
“What kind of bullshit Federal Government staff.”
“What kind of bullshit serving the people of the Federation?”
Ma Huainan’s expression showed no change, but inside he was cursing up a storm.
“Their mouths are full of principles.”
“Their hearts are full of business.”
He was once one of the dazzling Geniuses of the Primordial Academy.
Countless people took the initiative to curry favor with him, major companies competed to invest in him, and later he even became a husband to Sima Yurao.
Throughout his journey, almost everything he saw was goodwill and flattery.
So he had always thought.
His own status and his own talent represented everything.
But until now, when he fell from the peak to the bottom.
When his Divine Kingdom faced destruction, he finally saw the world clearly.
It turned out that many people approaching him were not because of appreciation, but because they valued his worth.
Investing in him was for profit.
Following him was for profit.
Even marriage was just an exchange of benefits.
Now, these so-called reinforcements taking action were also because of benefits.
Only when a person has truly experienced despair can they see the things that were once covered by a halo.
And only after falling would they understand that this world never revolves around any single person.
“Hahahaha!”
Weng Chonghe suddenly burst into laughter.
“Everyone, Young Master Ma is a future Peerless Prodigy of our Human race.”
“Since he hasn’t grown up yet, how could we watch such a Genius fall?”
“Furthermore, the opponent is illegally invading the Divine Kingdom of a fellow clansman.”
“Today, no matter what, we must expel them!”
After saying this, Weng Chonghe waved his large hand.
“Form ranks to face the enemy!”
“Drive the enemies out of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Yes!”
The army behind him responded in unison, and the deity with a fleshy face from earlier also revealed a smile.
“Rest assured, Young Master Ma, with the five of us brothers here.”
“Your safety is absolutely not a problem.”
20 million military merits was not a small amount.
It was enough to purchase quite a few precious Resources, or even exchange for several S-rank war building.
This support mission was simply a huge profit.

Although Ma Huainan possessed an SS-Class Divine Kingdom Talent with huge future potential.
He was, after all, only someone who had just achieved a breakthrough to deityhood not long ago.
