chapters.title: Chapter 460: The Defensive Power of the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest
paragraphs: Upon seeing this, a Tier 3 God who was presiding over the Formation could finally no longer hold back and cursed out loud.
“Fuck!”
“Boss, is this motherfucker a Corpse Cultivator god?”
“Are you kidding me?”
“Are you sure this guy didn’t go off the rails on the Mechanical Path?”
His voice was filled with disbelief.
After just one round of shelling, the Formation they had painstakingly set up was almost shattered, and quite a few energy cannons even broke through their defenses.
In this one round, at least nearly one hundred thousand believers had fallen directly.
“Shut up!”
“Stabilize the Formation first!”
Weng Chonghe’s expression was equally ugly.
“Second, Third!”
“Arrange for the believers to counterattack with full force!”
“Bring out the S-rank war building, the God-Slaying Tower. Don’t hold back; the opponent is strange!”
He had already sensed that something was wrong at this moment.
That amount of A-Rank War Structure would have been one thing.
After all, some gods who are good at management can indeed accumulate terrifying wealth over long years.
But the problem is... these zombie believers of the opponent are all equipped with Smart Weapon, which is completely unreasonable.
The Corpse Cultivator route should rely on numbers and viruses to win.
But the god before them looks like a Mechanical god disguised as a Corpse Cultivator, no matter how you look at it.
Receiving the order.
The next moment, two huge black towers slowly rose from within the Human race army.
A terrifying pressure instantly swept across the entire battlefield.
It was the S-rank war building—the God-Slaying Tower!
A large number of Core Formation and Nascent Soul level believers quickly entered them.
The next second, the God-Slaying Tower began to operate.
Under the amplification of the tower body, powerful techniques erupted with strength far exceeding their own Realm.
Boom!
One of the God-Slaying Tower erupted with sky-filling crimson flames, and the terrifying high temperature instantly swept across the world.
The entire sky seemed to be ignited, turning into a sea of crimson.
The other God-Slaying Tower released streaks of huge golden Sword Qi.
Each streak of Sword Qi was hundreds of meters long.
Incredibly sharp and carrying a destructive aura, it headed straight for the center of the zombie army.
Seeing this scene.
Yang Eleven in the rear command center narrowed his eyes slightly.
“Flesh Scourge Mother Nest, activate stage two defensive mode.”
“Block their attacks.”
“Yes, Marshal.”
Upon receiving the order, a large number of White Zombie believers quickly burrowed into those twenty Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.
The hives, which were originally like huge balls of flesh, began to undergo drastic changes.
Countless tentacles retracted, large amounts of flesh began to reorganize, and thick venom flowed constantly; the volume of the hives actually began to shrink.
In just a short moment, those twenty Flesh Scourge Mother Nest had all transformed into huge zombie forms.
Each one was hundreds of zhang tall, like terrifying giants from the abyss.
Under the control of the White Zombie believers, the twenty huge zombies simultaneously soared into the air, directly meeting the sky-filling Sword Qi and flames.
Boom!
The first streak of golden Sword Qi fell, ruthlessly hacking into the chest of a huge zombie.
Terrifying power erupted instantly.
A huge crater was blasted directly into the chest of the huge zombie.
However, the next moment, large amounts of flesh squirmed, and the wound actually began to heal at a speed visible to the naked eye.
That terrifying Sword Qi, which was enough to cleave mountains, could not destroy it.
On the other side, the sky-filling flames descended.
The terrifying high temperature completely engulfed a huge zombie.
A nauseating, burnt stench permeated the air.
But in the end, the terrifying flames were still forcefully blocked by the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.
“Boss!”
Seeing this, a god could not help but exclaim.
“The opponent also has S-rank war building! And there are twenty of them!”
“More than the five of us combined!”
“The God-Slaying Tower simply cannot suppress them!”
Weng Chonghe’s expression was gloomy, but he did not panic.
“Continue the attack. Other Cultivation Believer, use the power of the Formation to carry out area-of-effect bombardment.”
“Although Smart Weapon are powerful, every attack requires recharging.”
“This period of time is our chance to counterattack.”
As the order was given, a large number of Cultivation Believer began to use the power of the Formation to release techniques.
At the same time, the Mechanical believers also began to set up artillery batteries.
Sky-filling attacks erupted once again, like a flood, pouring down toward Yang Fan’s army.
Looking at the countless attacks coming from the sky.
Yang Eleven stood in the command center, his eyes calm.
“The combat style, the coordination of the believers, and the timing control are all not bad.”
“It’s a pity... your foundation is only this much.”
A cold sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth.
“All Flesh Scourge Mother Nest, move out!”
“Block their large-scale attacks.”
“If there are any leaks, the believers can hide under the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and wait for the Smart Weapon to finish recharging.”
“In this war, we don’t need to engage in close-quarters combat with them.”
“Use long-range firepower to slowly grind them to death.”
“Their Formation... won’t be able to block many rounds!”
“Yes, Marshal!” The White Zombie believers responded in unison.
Almost at the same time, over three hundred Flesh Scourge Mother Nest underwent changes simultaneously.
Boom!
Accompanied by a dull roar, huge balls of flesh suddenly appeared throughout the zombie army, and then began to expand and reorganize crazily.
Countless flesh tentacles broke through the surface, and the massive bodies slowly stood up.
The next moment, over three hundred huge zombies, each a hundred zhang tall, rose into the air in unison.
This scene was like a group of flesh behemoths from the abyss descending into the world.
Facing the sky-filling artillery and technique attacks.
The Flesh Scourge Mother Nest directly unleashed the defensive capabilities belonging to an S-rank war building.
One of the flesh giants opened its huge mouth, and a large amount of pitch-black spores erupted from its body.
In just a short moment, the sky-filling spores covered the entire sky.
Those spores looked fragile, but the moment the energy cannon bombarded them, the originally soft spore shells instantly hardened, as if they had turned into a layer of special biological armor.
Boom!
The energy cannon exploded, and countless spores were shattered.
But the next moment, more spores flew back from afar, reintegrating into the bodies of the flesh giants.
Even the damaged areas began to repair rapidly.
The zombie giants on the other side opened the huge holes in their bodies, and a large amount of dark red liquid sprayed out like a torrential rain.
These liquids did not attack the enemy directly, but instead formed a special corrosive barrier in mid-air.
The Sword Qi, flames, and lightning techniques released by the Cultivation Believer.
Once they came into contact with this acidic barrier, the spiritual power structure contained within would be quickly destroyed.
Before the techniques had truly fallen, their power had already been weakened by more than half.
Others released large amounts of flesh fungal mats, which quickly spread in the sky, forming a huge web of flesh.
After the energy cannon bombarded them, it would be quickly dispersed by the entire fungal mat.
Unlike the God-Slaying Tower, an S-rank war building that purely pursues lethality.
The Flesh Scourge Mother Nest itself was born for war defense.
Its greatest characteristic is its powerful area defensive capability and terrifying self-healing ability.
Now, over three hundred Flesh Scourge Mother Nest had actually forcefully blocked nearly ninety percent of the attacks from the billion-strong army.
As for those sporadic energy cannons that broke through the defenses.
Some zombie believers retreated under the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, causing no major damage at all.
Seeing this scene, Weng Chonghe was completely stunned.
His consciousness floated above the army, looking at the three hundred plus terrifying flesh giants in the sky, and he seemed to have lost the ability to think.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Undercurrents Surging
paragraphs: “Bo... Boss.”
A God beside him spoke with a trembling voice.
“Did I see that wrong?”
“Are... are those all S-rank war building?”
Weng Chonghe did not answer, because he also hoped he had seen it wrong.
But the facts were right before his eyes.
Those three hundred-plus massive flesh giants each exuded the aura of an s-class war structure.
“How is this possible...”
“How could he possess so many S-rank war building?”
Just as they were in shock, the new round of energy cannon attacks had finished charging.
The next second, beams of light filled the sky and descended once more.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The terrifying sound of explosions instantly resounded throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
This time, the grand formation finally could not withstand it.
The originally stable grand formation began to shake violently, and cracks even appeared.
A large number of energy cannons broke through the defenses and landed directly among the Human race army.
“My God! Save us!”
“The grand formation is about to collapse!”
Countless believers began to let out desperate cries.
This round of attacks caused even heavier losses.
A large number of Martial Apprentice and Martial Master level believers perished directly.
Even many Cultivation Believers floating in the sky were blasted to death by the energy cannons.
Quite a few intelligent lifeform were blown into Mechanical fragments.
Watching the army constantly collapsing before him, Weng Chonghe’s expression finally changed.
He knew he could not keep dragging this out.
If this continued, the elite believers of the five of them would likely all be lost here.
The next moment, his gaze fell sharply upon Ma Huainan.
“Ma Huainan!”
“Return to the Real World immediately and seek help from the Sima Family!”
“Otherwise, your Divine Kingdom will not be saved!”
His voice was extremely stern.
“If you dare to delay any further! I will retreat immediately!”
“These are the most core combat forces of our Divine Kingdoms!”
“I will absolutely not let them all die here!”
At this moment, Weng Chonghe’s mindset had completely changed.
He even felt it was outrageous to the extreme.
He had been responsible for this job for ten thousand years; what kind of Divine Kingdom War had he not seen?
But today, for the first time, he felt he had fallen into a huge trap.
Over three hundred S-rank war building?
What kind of joke is this!
Is this a wholesale market for S-rank war building?
And those Smart Weapons, a large number of A-Rank War Structures.
Such a terrifying war foundation, how could it be possessed by a Low-rank Deity?
Just now, when extorting Ma Huainan, Weng Chonghe was simply bullying someone inexperienced.
Actually, Federal Government staff like him had extremely strict management regulations and could not retreat easily.
But now, he regretted it.
“This guy... who exactly is he?”
Weng Chonghe developed the thought of retreating.
“More than 300 S-rank war building...”
“This is not a simple support mission at all; could it be that I’ve intervened in the struggle between the Five Great Families?”
The more Weng Chonghe thought about it, the more he felt it was possible. He was just an ordinary Federal Government worker and did not want to become cannon fodder in someone else’s game.
Ma Huainan naturally dared not delay in the slightest.
He had seen with his own eyes the terror of this zombie army and naturally understood that the current situation had reached a point of life and death.
The next moment, his consciousness quickly exited the Divine Kingdom and returned to the Real World.
Subsequently, he did not have any hesitation.
He immediately transmitted the real-time footage of the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, as well as all combat data, to the Sima Family and the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
“Survive...”
“I must survive!”
In the Virtual World, Ma Huainan’s body was trembling slightly.
“As long as I can survive...”
“I am willing to pay any price.”
At this moment, he could no longer care about so-called dignity.
The Divine Kingdom was everything to a God.
As long as the Divine Kingdom remained, he still had a chance in the future.
If the Divine Kingdom Core were seized.
Then everything he had would vanish like bubbles.
Meanwhile, inside the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, the war was still continuing.
The armies of Weng Chonghe and the other four had fallen into an extremely difficult situation.
In the short span of less than a month in the Divine Kingdom, Weng Chonghe had already changed over a hundred combat plans.
The goal was only one: to drag out time and wait for support!
But even though they had tried their best, the overall losses were still getting larger and larger.
The number of fallen believers now approached ten billion.
“Big Brother...”
A God looked grim.
“Why hasn’t that kid returned yet?”
“To get the full attendance bonus from the Federal Government, I brought over the most elite batch of believers from my Divine Kingdom!”
“If these believers are all lost here, the future development of my Divine Kingdom will be delayed by at least several decades!”
Speaking of this, his face was almost black.
“What a huge loss!”
“This time, it’s truly a huge loss!”
“One should never casually accept a support mission for a Peerless Prodigy’s Divine Kingdom!”
The faces of the few people beside him were equally ugly.
They had originally thought that since Ma Huainan had just achieved a breakthrough to become a God less than a year ago, this would be a simple support mission.
But who could have imagined they would encounter a monster.
“Enough!”
Weng Chonghe shouted in a deep voice.
“Everyone, hold on!”
“If we retreat now, the careers of the five of us will likely be affected!”
“I have already uploaded all the battlefield recordings to the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.”
“So many S-rank war building... and hundreds of millions of Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers!”
“I don’t believe there are no transaction records in the Real World!”
Speaking of this, Weng Chonghe’s eyes were cold.
He no longer hoped to win; he only hoped that the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence could investigate the opponent’s background as soon as possible.
However, Yang Fan, who was currently observing the battlefield from the Divine Kingdom Core, did not know this.
Because of this war, undercurrents had already begun to surge among the entire upper echelons of the Human race.
Real World.
At the Han Family grounds, a robotic figure slowly descended.
“I am a ninth-order intelligent lifeform.”
“On the orders of the supreme intelligent lifeform ‘One’, I have come to investigate the Han Family’s transaction data from the last thousand years.”
Upon hearing these words, the intelligent lifeform responsible for receiving guests at the Han Family was silent for a moment, then shook its head.
“Sorry, this action involves the core business information of the Han Family.”
“According to the Federal Constitution, we cannot provide it directly.”
“Your request has seriously violated the Information Protection Regulations.”
The robot had no emotional change.
“This is a highest-level investigation order from the Federal Government, not a request for all transaction data.”
“This time, we are only investigating the transaction records related to the S-rank war building Flesh Scourge Mother Nest, and the A-Rank War Structure Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.”
As the voice fell, a more powerful intelligent robot slowly walked out from inside the Han Family.
“I am the Han Family’s ninth-order legal-type intelligent lifeform.”
“The actions of the supreme intelligent lifeform ‘One’ are suspected of violating Article 3, Article 156, and Article 7023 of the Information Protection Law.”
“The Han Family refuses to cooperate.”
“Please leave.”
Almost at the same time.
A similar scene also occurred at the Gu Family, the Lu Clan, and the Qin Family.

sentences.text: Boss.”
A God beside him spoke with a trembling voice.
“Did I see that wrong?”
“Are... are those all S-rank war building?”
Weng Chonghe did not answer, because he also hoped he had seen it wrong.
But the facts were right before his eyes.
Those three hundred-plus massive flesh giants each exuded the aura of an s-class war structure.
“How is this possible...”
“How could he possess so many S-rank war building?”
Just as they were in shock, the new round of energy cannon attacks had finished charging.
The next second, beams of light filled the sky and descended once more.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
The terrifying sound of explosions instantly resounded throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
This time, the grand formation finally could not withstand it.
The originally stable grand formation began to shake violently, and cracks even appeared.
A large number of energy cannons broke through the defenses and landed directly among the Human race army.
“My God!
Save us!”
“The grand formation is about to collapse!”
Countless believers began to let out desperate cries.
This round of attacks caused even heavier losses.
A large number of Martial Apprentice and Martial Master level believers perished directly.
Even many Cultivation Believers floating in the sky were blasted to death by the energy cannons.
Quite a few intelligent lifeform were blown into Mechanical fragments.
Watching the army constantly collapsing before him, Weng Chonghe’s expression finally changed.
He knew he could not keep dragging this out.
If this continued, the elite believers of the five of them would likely all be lost here.
The next moment, his gaze fell sharply upon Ma Huainan.
“Ma Huainan!”
“Return to the Real World immediately and seek help from the Sima Family!”
“Otherwise, your Divine Kingdom will not be saved!”
His voice was extremely stern.
“If you dare to delay any further!
I will retreat immediately!”
“These are the most core combat forces of our Divine Kingdoms!”
“I will absolutely not let them all die here!”
At this moment, Weng Chonghe’s mindset had completely changed.
He even felt it was outrageous to the extreme.
He had been responsible for this job for ten thousand years; what kind of Divine Kingdom War had he not seen?
But today, for the first time, he felt he had fallen into a huge trap.
Over three hundred S-rank war building?
What kind of joke is this!
Is this a wholesale market for S-rank war building?
And those Smart Weapons, a large number of A-Rank War Structures.
Such a terrifying war foundation, how could it be possessed by a Low-rank Deity?
Just now, when extorting Ma Huainan, Weng Chonghe was simply bullying someone inexperienced.
Actually, Federal Government staff like him had extremely strict management regulations and could not retreat easily.
But now, he regretted it.
“This guy... who exactly is he?”
Weng Chonghe developed the thought of retreating.
“More than 300 S-rank war building...”
“This is not a simple support mission at all; could it be that I’ve intervened in the struggle between the Five Great Families?”
The more Weng Chonghe thought about it, the more he felt it was possible.
He was just an ordinary Federal Government worker and did not want to become cannon fodder in someone else’s game.
Ma Huainan naturally dared not delay in the slightest.
He had seen with his own eyes the terror of this zombie army and naturally understood that the current situation had reached a point of life and death.
The next moment, his consciousness quickly exited the Divine Kingdom and returned to the Real World.
Subsequently, he did not have any hesitation.
He immediately transmitted the real-time footage of the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, as well as all combat data, to the Sima Family and the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
“Survive...”
“I must survive!”
In the Virtual World, Ma Huainan’s body was trembling slightly.
“As long as I can survive...”
“I am willing to pay any price.”
At this moment, he could no longer care about so-called dignity.
The Divine Kingdom was everything to a God.
As long as the Divine Kingdom remained, he still had a chance in the future.
If the Divine Kingdom Core were seized.
Then everything he had would vanish like bubbles.

The armies of Weng Chonghe and the other four had fallen into an extremely difficult situation.
In the short span of less than a month in the Divine Kingdom, Weng Chonghe had already changed over a hundred combat plans.
The goal was only one: to drag out time and wait for support!

The number of fallen believers now approached ten billion.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Investigation by Various Families
paragraphs: Qin Family Territory.
The staff member responsible for reception looked apologetic.
“My Qin Family takes the incident where a Human race Peerless Prodigy was attacked very seriously.”
“We express our deepest regrets regarding this matter.”
“However... as this involves the Clan’s commercial privacy, it must be handled strictly according to procedure; the relevant application must at least be reviewed by the Elder council.”
“It is estimated... that it will take about twenty years to complete.”
“Please wait patiently.”
Outside the Gu Family Territory, an intelligent lifeform robot spoke in a calm tone.
“According to the investigation, the Gu Family does not have a large volume of relevant transactions; there are only a small number of purchase records for S-rank war building.”
“And all of them were used for internal research purposes.”
“Please report the truth to Lord ‘One’.”
After speaking, the robot turned and left.
At this moment, in the core area of the Gu Family Territory, Gu Xuanting was sitting in the main hall.
Before him, the screen was playing the scene of the Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Looking at the dense Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and the more than three hundred Flesh Scourge Mother Nests.
The expression on Gu Xuanting’s face was quite colorful.
“Xuanting.”
Lu Qinglan, who was beside him, frowned.
“This matter... was it all done by that girl Le and the others?”
Gu Xuanting was silent for a moment, then gave a bitter smile.
“It’s highly likely.”
“The over two hundred million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers that Yang Fan previously purchased through the Gu Family channels.”
“I’m afraid they were gifted to this Corpse Cultivator God.”
Speaking of this, he couldn’t help but shake his head.
“Our son-in-law... really has a grand approach.”
“To deal with such an enemy.”
“He was actually willing to spend so many Resources during the early development phase of his Divine Kingdom.”
Lu Qinglan looked at the battlefield scene, her eyes also filled with a complex expression.
“Fortunately, you personally approved this matter and rejected the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence’s request immediately.”
“In this way... they shouldn’t be able to find them.”
“It’s not that simple.” Gu Xuanting shook his head.
“The other Families will most likely just go through the motions.”
“The real trouble... lies with the Lu Clan.”
“What do you mean?” Lu Qinglan frowned slightly.
Gu Xuanting pondered for a moment, then spoke slowly.
“600 years ago, a Human Race Prodigy who walked the path of a Corpse Cultivator appeared in the Lu Clan.”
“Although, looking at the performance in this war, the opponent’s fighting style is completely different from that person’s.”
“But... do you think the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence wouldn’t have any suspicions?”
“Now that such a terrifying Corpse Cultivator army has appeared, and it also possesses a large number of S-rank war building.”
“I’m afraid the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence has already personally headed to the Lu Clan at this moment.”
Hearing this, Lu Qinglan’s expression changed, and she stood up instantly, “I’m going back to the Lu Clan now!”
Gu Xuanting looked at her, somewhat helplessly, “What are you going back for?”

“The Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence has descended in person; if the high-level members of the Clan don’t know the full sequence of events, they might actually allow it to conduct a deep investigation,” Lu Qinglan said anxiously.
Gu Xuanting waved his hand.
“What are you worried about?”
“Do you think your Lu Clan’s Human Race Prodigy would dare to take such a big risk to act without considering the consequences?”
“Do you think Yang Fan and that girl Lu Wan alone could make him act?”
Lu Qinglan was startled, “You mean...”
“It must have been Lu Yanran who spoke.”
A hint of a smile flashed in Gu Xuanting’s eyes.
“Since it was her doing, there’s no need to worry.”
“Given her status and ability, since this matter has started, she will definitely have made subsequent arrangements.”
“Even if the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence investigates in person, it won’t be able to find anything.”
Hearing this, Lu Qinglan’s tense nerves finally relaxed.
“That’s true, Lu Yanran has always been meticulous in everything she does.”
Speaking of this, she couldn’t help but laugh.
“Our son-in-law is truly lucky.”
“These two girls, each more outstanding than the other, yet they both have him completely wrapped around their fingers.”
“He only had his Divine Kingdom information investigated, and it was stopped in time with no losses, yet he was still so ruthless.”
Thinking of this, Lu Qinglan was also somewhat amused and helpless.
Gu Xuanting shook his head.
“Alright, go see that girl Gu Le in a while.”
“Since she has already acted, make sure the aftermath is handled cleanly; don’t leave any loose ends.”
“Understood.”
Lu Qinglan curled her lips.
“This girl, it seems she is really close to a breakthrough to becoming a God, and thinks she has grown up.”
“Such a big matter, and she didn’t even tell her mother in advance.”
Meanwhile, at the Lu Clan Territory.
At this moment, a large number of Mid-tier Gods were standing neatly outside the main hall.
Their expressions were serious, and no one dared to show the slightest contempt.
Although it was just an ordinary-looking robot in front of them.
But everyone knew that the existence truly descending here was not this Mechanical body, but the Human Federation’s Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence “One”.
Even High-Order Gods had to maintain sufficient respect.
“Lord ‘One’.”
A High-Order God from the Lu Clan responsible for reception stepped forward.
“The Lu Clan agrees to cooperate with this investigation.”
“But as it involves the Clan’s core transaction information, the query process must be accompanied by our Lu Clan’s High-Order Mechanical God throughout.”
“And... you are only allowed to view transaction records related to the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest and the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.”
“As for other data, please forgive the Lu Clan for not being able to open it.”
The robot was silent for a moment, then a mechanized voice came out.
“Agreed. The target of this investigation is limited to the relevant war structures.”
The Lu Clan God nodded slightly, then continued:
“As for the matter of Lu Mingshi, the Lu Clan has already sent people to inquire about it.”
“It can be confirmed that this matter has nothing to do with him.”

“Even if you have descended in person, the Lu Clan cannot allow, without evidence, for our Clan’s Heavenly Pride to be forced to hand over his Divine Kingdom coordinates and have it entered for investigation.”
“We hope you can understand.”
The robot’s eyes flashed.
“Understood, but if the investigation finds anomalies in the transaction records.”
“Lu Mingshi will need to accept mandatory isolation.”
Hearing this, the expressions of the Lu Clan members changed slightly.
But in the end, the High-Order God still nodded.
“My Lord, please follow me.”
As the words fell, the Formation of the Lu Clan Territory opened slowly.
And that ordinary robot, under the gaze of many Gods, walked into it step by step.
There was no pressure, yet it made the entire Lu Clan stand in battle Formation.
Under the guidance of the Lu Clan God.
The carrier of the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence “One” soon arrived at the Lu Clan’s most core transaction database.

This was one of the Lu Clan’s most important commercial secrets; countless data light screens floated in the the void, and vast amounts of transaction information flowed continuously like a waterfall.
Almost at the same time, a figure stepped through the air from afar.
The person who arrived was none other than the Lu Clan’s High-Order Mechanical God.
His appearance was not much different from an ordinary Human race, but his skin shone with a cold metallic texture, as if every inch of flesh had undergone special Mechanical modification.
A pair of eyes shone with a faint blue light.
Just by standing there, a powerful divine pressure naturally spread out, causing the surrounding space to tremble faintly.

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Who the hell did this?!
paragraphs: However, when facing the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, his attitude remained extremely polite.
“Lord ‘One’, next, I will show you the source code for the Lu Clan’s transaction data.”
“Of course, this data will be encrypted with my spiritual power. You will only be able to view the transactions related to the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.”
“Accepted.” The robot emitted a cold, synthesized Mechanical voice.
The next moment. Boom! A massive amount of data suddenly surged in from all directions.
Densely packed code and information transformed into a gigantic torrent of data, instantly enveloping both of them.
Meanwhile, “One”, who was controlling the robot, simply raised its Mechanical arm, extended a single finger, and lightly touched one of the data streams.
Hum! Almost the instant it touched, that vast torrent of data seemed to lose all its secrets entirely.

Countless pieces of information flashed crazily. In just an instant, all transaction records related to the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest had been completely read by “One”.
Seeing this, the Lu Clan’s High-Order Mechanical God slowly spoke.
“Lord One, I trust you now understand that this matter has nothing to do with the Lu Clan?”
“The transaction data is correct.” “One”‘s voice still lacked any emotional fluctuation.
“However, a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius is of vital importance to the entire Human race.”
“I hope the Lu Clan will cooperate and temporarily detain Lu Mingshi.”
Hearing this, the Lu Clan’s High-Order Mechanical God shook his head.
“I apologize, but although you are acting in the interest of the entire Human race, I am a High-Order Mechanical God of the Lu Clan, and I naturally need to uphold the Lu Clan’s interests.”
“Furthermore, that Peerless Prodigy is a Genius invested in and cultivated by the Sima Family.”
“Without concrete evidence, the Lu Clan cannot restrict a clansman’s freedom based solely on suspicion.”
The robot fell silent.
A moment later, the Lu Clan’s High-Order God spoke again:
“The meaning of the law is to ensure that everyone can receive the most basic fairness and protection.”

“Even if the other party is a Peerless Prodigy, and even if it concerns the future of the entire Human race, we cannot sacrifice the rights of another innocent person without evidence just because of one person’s importance.”
“Because if we can sacrifice one person’s legal rights today for the so-called greater good of the Human race,”
“Tomorrow, we might sacrifice a group of people for even greater interests.”
“If even the legal rights of every individual cannot be guaranteed, then the so-called interests of the Human race are nothing more than a slogan that can be exploited at any time.”
“What the law protects is never just one person, but everyone.”
“Agreed.”
As the synthesized Mechanical voice faded, the robot’s body suddenly trembled.
Crack! Cracks instantly spread across the entire Mechanical body.
The next second, the robot suddenly fell apart, countless metal parts scattering across the floor, completely turning into a heap of scrap metal.
The consciousness belonging to the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence “One” also quietly departed at this moment.
Meanwhile, at the Lu Clan grounds, inside a detached villa.
A middle-aged man wearing dark green robes was pacing back and forth anxiously in the courtyard.
“Damn it! Who the hell is impersonating me?”
“I haven’t launched a Divine Kingdom War for nearly a hundred years, so how did such a huge pot of blame suddenly land on my head?”
This person was none other than Lu Mingshi. He was also one of the very few Gods in the entire Human Federation who followed the Corpse Cultivator path.
During this time, he felt even more wronged than Dou E.
He hadn’t done anything, yet inexplicably became the object of suspicion for the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
Just then, beep—the sound of the combination lock suddenly rang out.
The villa door slowly opened, and two figures walked in from outside.
A man and a woman, who looked to be about the same age as Lu Mingshi.
The man had an upright build and a composed expression, with his brows bearing a slight resemblance to Lu Mingshi’s.
The middle-aged woman beside him had a gentle temperament, and her eyes were full of helplessness as she looked at Lu Mingshi.
Seeing the two of them, Lu Mingshi immediately acted as if he had seen a savior.
“Dad! Mom!”
“What is going on right now?”
“I shouldn’t need to cooperate with the investigation, right?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Lu Mingshi actually dropped to his knees in a slide, hugging their legs, his face full of grievance.
“I really didn’t do anything!”
Seeing this, the couple exchanged a glance, both unable to help but show expressions of helplessness.
“Mingshi, you’re already over six hundred years old, why are you still acting like a child?”
The middle-aged woman helped Lu Mingshi up from the ground, then said earnestly:
“In the future, when doing business, you still need to pay more attention to risk control.”
“The Clan has just blocked it for you; even the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence cannot enter your Divine Kingdom to investigate based solely on a mandatory order.”
“That’s good, that’s good!” Lu Mingshi immediately patted his chest.
But the next moment, he froze for a second.
“Wait...”
“Mom, what did you mean just now when you said I need to pay attention to risk control when doing business in the future?”
“I’ve said it so many times already, this matter really has nothing to do with me!” Lu Mingshi immediately became anxious.
“Enough!” His father beside him snorted coldly.
“What? You think you’ve grown up, huh?”
“Still hiding things from your mother?”
“You’ve been stuck at the Tier 3 God Realm for two hundred years; instead of properly preparing for your own Divine Kingdom War, why are you meddling in nonsense all day?”
“No..., Dad, why don’t you believe me either?” Lu Mingshi’s face was full of grievance.
“This kind of thing can happen once, but not twice.”
“If you go too far, even the Clan won’t be able to help you clean up the mess when the time comes.”
“After all, the other party is a Peerless Prodigy.”
“If you walk by the river often enough, you’re bound to get your shoes wet.”
“Reflect on yourself properly; your mother and I came over just to put your mind at ease.”
“I...” Lu Mingshi opened his mouth, looking like he wanted to cry but had no tears.
Who the hell did this?
Why don’t even his own parents believe him now?
Just as Lu Mingshi was preparing to continue explaining, his father suddenly helped him up from the ground, then patted his shoulder with a face full of gratification.
“Some things are better left understood between Clan members.”
“Not admitting it is correct.”
“But there’s no need to keep denying it either.”
“Also, I have already watched the video of the Divine Kingdom War.”
The expression on the man’s face finally became serious.
“You brat, you’re not bad. Your mother and I are both proud of you.”
“Among the Gods who follow the Corpse Cultivator path, only one has become a High-Order God since this era began.”
“My son, you also have the potential to become a High-Order God!”
After saying this, he turned his head and glanced at his wife beside him. The couple smiled at each other, then left the villa together.
Leaving Lu Mingshi standing alone in place. Watching his parents’ departing backs, Lu Mingshi fell into silence.
A moment later, he couldn’t help but roar at the sky.
“No!”
“Who the hell did this?!”

sentences.text: However, when facing the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, his attitude remained extremely polite.
“Lord ‘One’, next, I will show you the source code for the Lu Clan’s transaction data.”
“Of course, this data will be encrypted with my spiritual power.
You will only be able to view the transactions related to the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest.”
“Accepted.” The robot emitted a cold, synthesized Mechanical voice.
The next moment.
Boom!
A massive amount of data suddenly surged in from all directions.
Densely packed code and information transformed into a gigantic torrent of data, instantly enveloping both of them.
Meanwhile, “One”, who was controlling the robot, simply raised its Mechanical arm, extended a single finger, and lightly touched one of the data streams.
Hum!
Almost the instant it touched, that vast torrent of data seemed to lose all its secrets entirely.
Countless pieces of information flashed crazily.
In just an instant, all transaction records related to the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest had been completely read by “One”.
Seeing this, the Lu Clan’s High-Order Mechanical God slowly spoke.
“Lord One, I trust you now understand that this matter has nothing to do with the Lu Clan?”
“The transaction data is correct.” “One”‘s voice still lacked any emotional fluctuation.
“However, a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius is of vital importance to the entire Human race.”
“I hope the Lu Clan will cooperate and temporarily detain Lu Mingshi.”
Hearing this, the Lu Clan’s High-Order Mechanical God shook his head.
“I apologize, but although you are acting in the interest of the entire Human race, I am a High-Order Mechanical God of the Lu Clan, and I naturally need to uphold the Lu Clan’s interests.”
“Furthermore, that Peerless Prodigy is a Genius invested in and cultivated by the Sima Family.”
“Without concrete evidence, the Lu Clan cannot restrict a clansman’s freedom based solely on suspicion.”
The robot fell silent.
A moment later, the Lu Clan’s High-Order God spoke again:
“The meaning of the law is to ensure that everyone can receive the most basic fairness and protection.”

“Even if the other party is a Peerless Prodigy, and even if it concerns the future of the entire Human race, we cannot sacrifice the rights of another innocent person without evidence just because of one person’s importance.”
“Because if we can sacrifice one person’s legal rights today for the so-called greater good of the Human race,”
“Tomorrow, we might sacrifice a group of people for even greater interests.”
“If even the legal rights of every individual cannot be guaranteed, then the so-called interests of the Human race are nothing more than a slogan that can be exploited at any time.”
“What the law protects is never just one person, but everyone.”
“Agreed.”

Crack!

The next second, the robot suddenly fell apart, countless metal parts scattering across the floor, completely turning into a heap of scrap metal.
The consciousness belonging to the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence “One” also quietly departed at this moment.

This person was none other than Lu Mingshi.

During this time, he felt even more wronged than Dou E.
He hadn’t done anything, yet inexplicably became the object of suspicion for the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
Just then, beep—the sound of the combination lock suddenly rang out.
The villa door slowly opened, and two figures walked in from outside.
A man and a woman, who looked to be about the same age as Lu Mingshi.
The man had an upright build and a composed expression, with his brows bearing a slight resemblance to Lu Mingshi’s.
The middle-aged woman beside him had a gentle temperament, and her eyes were full of helplessness as she looked at Lu Mingshi.
Seeing the two of them, Lu Mingshi immediately acted as if he had seen a savior.

Mom!”

chapters.title: Chapter 464: Not Yang Fan At All?
paragraphs: After walking for a distance, the middle-aged woman finally couldn’t help but ask in a low voice: “Old Lu... did our son really do this?”
The man paused, a look of matter-of-factness appearing on his face.
“Nonsense!”

“Among Low-rank Deitys, those who follow the Corpse Cultivator path are already pitifully few. Besides this kid, can you find a second person who might possess this kind of Divine Kingdom foundation?”
As he said this, the pride on the man’s face could no longer be concealed.
He didn’t look at all like a father worried about whether his son would be taken away for investigation by the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
He looked exactly like a father whose son, who usually only scraped by with passing grades, had suddenly brought home a perfect score.
“That’s true...”
The middle-aged woman also gradually realized.
“I didn’t expect that for these past few hundred years, this kid had hidden so deeply.”
“During festivals and holidays in the past, he would whine about being poor in front of us every day.”
“When asking for red envelopes, he was more enthusiastic than any of his brothers.”
“This brat, as his mother, I was actually fooled by his honest and simple appearance for so many years.”
As she said this, a smile gradually appeared on her face.
“Alright.”
The man waved his hand.
“The child has made something of himself; you should be happy.”
“Although he is only evaluated as a Human Race Prodigy, based on the strength and foundation he has displayed in this Divine Kingdom War, his value is in no way inferior to a Peerless Prodigy.”
“As his parents, we naturally have to support him more.”
He pondered for a moment.
“After this matter passes, let’s transfer the shares of that startup company in Primordial City to Mingshi.”
“Although that company is small in scale right now, its future potential is not weak.”
“This kid has been hiding for so many years; it’s time he truly possessed his own Clan assets.”
“Alright.” The middle-aged woman nodded.
The couple looked at each other, unable to hide the smiles on their faces.
Clearly, in their eyes, their son, who usually seemed so honest and simple, had brought them great glory this time.
Meanwhile.
Virtual World.
The Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence “One” had already arrived at the Sima Family’s ancestral grounds.
A massive figure composed of countless data points floated silently in the the void.
“According to federal law, I cannot continue to conduct an in-depth investigation into this matter.”
“However, I still hope the Sima Family can support Ma Huainan as soon as possible.”
The Mechanical voice was calm and waveless.
“Peerless Prodigy-level geniuses are the most important combat power for the future of the entire Human race.”
“According to federal historical records, the vast majority of Peerless Prodigies, as long as they can grow up smoothly, have the potential to step into the High-Order God level in the future.”
“Therefore, I hope the Sima Family will immediately mobilize Gods to assist Ma Huainan in defending his Divine Kingdom.”
“Everything is for the sake of the entire Human race.”
After speaking, “One” fell into a brief silence.
As the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, he possessed the most terrifying computing power of the entire Human race and also possessed nearly infinite data Resources.
However, every one of his actions was also firmly bound by the rules established by the Human Federation.
The rules granted him powerful authority, but they also limited the power he could use.
He could not forcibly mobilize more power to support Ma Huainan.
Notifying the Sima Family was already the last thing he could do for Ma Huainan at the moment.
“My Sima Family’s support team is already prepared.”
The Sima Family’s intelligent lifeform responded slowly.
“We can depart at any time.”
“Very good.” The figure of “One” gradually dissipated.
The next moment.
In the Virtual World, Ma Huainan, who was still waiting for news, finally saw that familiar data figure appear.
He hurriedly stepped forward.
“Lord One, how is it?”
There was a trace of unconcealable fear in Ma Huainan’s voice.

In the past, he had always believed that as long as he made his Divine Kingdom coordinates public, with his Peerless Prodigy-level potential, no matter how strong the enemy was, the Sima Family would never sit idly by.
As long as reinforcements arrived, his Divine Kingdom would be completely safe.
However... after he saw those three hundred-plus S-rank war building with his own eyes, this confidence had completely collapsed.
S-rank war building are different from resource buildings; some originate from the Evolution of Secret Realms in the Divine Kingdom, and others come from High-Order Gods’ Divine Kingdoms.
Their numbers are scarce to a shocking degree.
It can even be said that for an ordinary God, being able to possess one or two S-rank war building is already considered having a deep foundation.
It is not only a trump card in war, but also a symbol of a God’s status.
Because most ordinary Gods don’t even have the qualifications to purchase S-rank war building.
But now... what did Ma Huainan see?
More than three hundred!
A full three hundred-plus S-rank war building!
At this moment, he even felt that his worldview had been completely overturned.
If he had only seen those first few, he could still tell himself that the opponent might be some Corpse Cultivator God who had lived for a very long time.
But when more than three hundred S-rank war building appeared on the battlefield at the same time, Ma Huainan immediately overturned this guess.
Impossible!
How could an ordinary Corpse Cultivator God possess such terrifying foundation?
Even if they had lived for tens of thousands of years, even if they had lived for hundreds of thousands of years, it would be impossible to have such a foundation!
A terrifying thought had already surfaced in Ma Huainan’s mind.
Could it be... that it wasn’t Yang Fan at all?
Could it be one of the other Four Great Families secretly targeting the Sima Family?
And he, an outsider Genius with an SS-class Divine Kingdom War Talent, just happened to become the target they used to attack the Sima Family?
Once this thought appeared, Ma Huainan could no longer shake it off.
He even felt it was more and more possible the more he thought about it.
After all, besides the Five Great Families, he really couldn’t think of any other power that could bring out such terrifying war foundation.
And if it really was one of the other Four Great Families... then the nature of this war would be completely different.
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan’s palms began to tremble slightly.
“Reinforcements will arrive soon.” The Mechanical voice of “One” rang out.
Hearing this answer, Ma Huainan’s long-tense nerves finally relaxed a little.
“Good... good, as long as reinforcements arrive, I will be safe.”
After speaking, his consciousness immediately exited the Virtual World, and then his consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom again.
At this moment, he could only pin his last hope on the Sima Family’s reinforcements.
In another villa of the Sima Family, Sima Yurao’s consciousness was currently in her Divine Kingdom.

In front of her, a large number of intelligent lifeform were constantly reporting data, while she examined it and simultaneously readjusted the investment distribution of various Resources in her Divine Kingdom.
“Reallocate this portion of Resources; temporarily reduce the investment in the Spirit Vein area by 30%.”
“Also, put all of these Divinity Points into believer cultivation.”
Sima Yurao was currently completely immersed in the development of her Divine Kingdom.
Just at this moment.
Beep—
In the Real World, a call request suddenly came through on the smart watch on her wrist.

chapters.title: Chapter 465: Young Master Lu!
paragraphs: Sima Yurao frowned slightly, her consciousness instantly withdrawing from the Divine Kingdom and returning to reality.
She opened Feixun, saw who was calling, and immediately answered.
“Brother, what’s wrong?” Sima Yurao asked in confusion.
“Yurao.”
Sima Zhao’s voice came from the other end.
“I remember you fully own a material supply company under your name, right?”
“Which is mainly responsible for the procurement and sales of disposable war supplies?”
Sima Yurao was stunned for a moment. “There is indeed such a company.”
“A God’s Divine Kingdom within the Clan has been invaded.”
“Now the reinforcement group has entered his Divine Kingdom and needs to purchase a large amount of disposable war supplies.”
“You suffered heavy losses in All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical before.”
“This time the Clan happens to have a large centralized procurement demand, which can also help you digest some inventory and recover some funds.”
Sima Zhao explained.
“Thank you, Brother.”
Sima Yurao was overjoyed.
But soon, she showed a bit of curiosity.
“Right, which Clan member’s Divine Kingdom was invaded?”
“Do I know them?”
On the other end of the communication, Sima Zhao said, “You know him.”
“Who?”
“Your ex-husband. I have already sent the relevant battlefield video to your Feixun.”
Sima Zhao’s tone noticeably turned solemn.
“The Clan has already made a judgment on this matter.”
“Although there is no exact evidence at present.”
“It is almost certain that it should be related to his previous investigation of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom information.”
“What? Yang Fan?” Sima Yurao instantly stood up from her chair.
During this period of time, she had been fully running her own Divine Kingdom and didn’t pay attention to external news at all.
At this moment, she immediately opened the video in Feixun.
A huge virtual projection instantly appeared on the wall.
The next moment, that tragic Divine Kingdom Battlefield came into view.
Artillery fire filled the sky, along with an endless army of zombies.
And... those more than three hundred Flesh Scourge Mother Nests.
Seeing this scene, Sima Yurao’s pupils shrank sharply, and a chill surged from the soles of her feet straight to the top of her head without warning.
“This... how is this possible?”
“More than three hundred S-rank war building?”
“And... it has only been a little over a month since the investigation incident!”
Without even realizing it, a layer of fine cold sweat had seeped out from her forehead at this moment.
“Alright.”
Sima Zhao reminded in a deep voice, “There is a High-Order God acting behind this.”
“High-Order God?” Sima Yurao’s expression changed again.
“Lu Wan’s mother, Lu Yanran.”
Sima Zhao said slowly.
“This is the Clan’s current judgment. As for the executor behind this matter, it is very likely the Human Race Prodigy of the Lu Clan—Lu Mingshi.”
“This person has a withdrawn personality and barely interacts with others on weekdays. I heard he is a ‘mama’s boy’.”
“I didn’t expect... he hid so deeply.”
Sima Zhao’s expression became somewhat solemn when he said this.
“You are already divorced, so don’t get involved in this matter.”
“Transfer all the disposable war supplies under your name to me, and the Clan will purchase them at a price 10% higher than the market price.”
“Oh... okay, I... I’ll arrange it right away.”
After hanging up the communication, Sima Yurao stood in place and didn’t move for a long time.
She never expected that such a huge event would happen outside in such a short period of time.
She expected even less that a High-Order God would be involved behind that matter.
For some reason, Yang Fan, who always wore a gentle smile and looked courteous at the banquet, suddenly appeared in her mind.
That gentle appearance, appearing in her mind at this moment, inexplicably made her feel a chill.
“These people... who climbed up step by step from a small place.”
“Are they all so ruthless?”
Sima Yurao muttered to herself.
On the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, the situation indeed changed again.
Almost at the same time Ma Huainan’s consciousness returned to the Divine Kingdom.
Huge spatial fluctuations appeared once more.
“Boom!”
Spatial channels opened one after another above the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, a large number of reinforcement legions poured out like a tide.
Martial arts armies, Cultivation believers, Mechanical legions, and all kinds of war weapons.
Elite legions descended one after another in an endless stream.
In a short period of time, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom completely turned into a doomsday scene.
The remaining tens of billions of believers in his Divine Kingdom Core had all retreated to the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Each of them looked terrified, not even daring to breathe loudly in front of the Gods.
The number of reinforcing troops from the Sima Family reached an astonishing 500 billion!
Moreover, the equipment of these armies was even more sophisticated than the legions of Weng Chonghe and the other five.
A large number of intelligent lifeform forms in the Mechanical legions lined up neatly, and quite a few of them were directly piloting A-Class war weapons.
Seeing this scene, Weng Chonghe and the other five finally breathed a complete sigh of relief.
“Retreat!”
Weng Chonghe immediately gave the order.
“Withdraw our main force from the periphery of the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Begin the rotation of defense.”
A large number of Federal Government legions quickly retreated until the Sima Family’s army completely took over the defense line.
Weng Chonghe couldn’t help letting out a long breath of relief.
“Fuck! They’re finally here!”
“As expected of a Peerless Prodigy.”
“I didn’t expect the Sima Family to actually organize such a luxurious rescue group!”
He couldn’t help swallowing a mouthful of saliva.
Over the past few months, they had suffered all kinds of hardships.
Up until now, the overall losses of their believer armies were approaching thirty percent.
If they relied solely on the Federal Government’s subsidies, this mission would definitely result in losing everything down to their underwear.
“Big Brother.”
The God beside him asked in a low voice:
“What should we do now?”
“The Sima Family’s reinforcements have arrived. Can we withdraw now?”
At this moment, the Sima Family had officially taken over the battlefield.
For them, the Federal Government personnel, there was no longer any reason to stay here.
Procedurally speaking, retreating was completely compliant.
Weng Chonghe pondered for a moment, then lowered his voice:
“Withdraw what withdraw? Play guerrilla warfare a bit and help them out with a small favor.”
“After all...”
Saying this, a meaningful smile appeared on his face.
“Young Master Ma promised us 20 million military merits each. We can’t take this money for free.”
The people beside him suddenly showed a look of realization.
“Big Brother is still wise. We mustn’t leave any handles for others to gossip about.”
The few of them looked at each other, and a bad smile appeared on the corners of their mouths one after another.
The next moment, ten powerful divine consciousness phantoms descended upon this world almost simultaneously.
The terrifying divine coercion intertwined, causing the entire Divine Kingdom space to tremble faintly.
The leading figure stepped forward.
“I am Sima Jin, a Tier 3 God of the Sima Family.”
“Young Master Lu, Ma Huainan, an out-of-Clan Genius of our Sima Family, previously investigated the Divine Kingdom information of others, which indeed constitutes a serious violation of the law.”
“Regarding this, our Sima Family is willing to give Yang Fan sufficient compensation.”
“Look, let this matter rest here, how about that?”
Sima Jin’s tone was very polite, without the slightest intention of calling them to account.

sentences.text: Sima Yurao frowned slightly, her consciousness instantly withdrawing from the Divine Kingdom and returning to reality.
She opened Feixun, saw who was calling, and immediately answered.
“Brother, what’s wrong?” Sima Yurao asked in confusion.
“Yurao.”
Sima Zhao’s voice came from the other end.
“I remember you fully own a material supply company under your name, right?”
“Which is mainly responsible for the procurement and sales of disposable war supplies?”
Sima Yurao was stunned for a moment.
“There is indeed such a company.”
“A God’s Divine Kingdom within the Clan has been invaded.”
“Now the reinforcement group has entered his Divine Kingdom and needs to purchase a large amount of disposable war supplies.”
“You suffered heavy losses in All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical before.”
“This time the Clan happens to have a large centralized procurement demand, which can also help you digest some inventory and recover some funds.”
Sima Zhao explained.
“Thank you, Brother.”
Sima Yurao was overjoyed.
But soon, she showed a bit of curiosity.
“Right, which Clan member’s Divine Kingdom was invaded?”
“Do I know them?”
On the other end of the communication, Sima Zhao said, “You know him.”
“Who?”
“Your ex-husband.
I have already sent the relevant battlefield video to your Feixun.”
Sima Zhao’s tone noticeably turned solemn.
“The Clan has already made a judgment on this matter.”
“Although there is no exact evidence at present.”
“It is almost certain that it should be related to his previous investigation of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom information.”
“What?
Yang Fan?” Sima Yurao instantly stood up from her chair.
During this period of time, she had been fully running her own Divine Kingdom and didn’t pay attention to external news at all.
At this moment, she immediately opened the video in Feixun.
A huge virtual projection instantly appeared on the wall.
The next moment, that tragic Divine Kingdom Battlefield came into view.
Artillery fire filled the sky, along with an endless army of zombies.
And... those more than three hundred Flesh Scourge Mother Nests.
Seeing this scene, Sima Yurao’s pupils shrank sharply, and a chill surged from the soles of her feet straight to the top of her head without warning.
“This... how is this possible?”
“More than three hundred S-rank war building?”
“And... it has only been a little over a month since the investigation incident!”
Without even realizing it, a layer of fine cold sweat had seeped out from her forehead at this moment.
“Alright.”
Sima Zhao reminded in a deep voice, “There is a High-Order God acting behind this.”
“High-Order God?” Sima Yurao’s expression changed again.
“Lu Wan’s mother, Lu Yanran.”
Sima Zhao said slowly.
“This is the Clan’s current judgment.
As for the executor behind this matter, it is very likely the Human Race Prodigy of the Lu Clan—Lu Mingshi.”
“This person has a withdrawn personality and barely interacts with others on weekdays.
I heard he is a ‘mama’s boy’.”
“I didn’t expect... he hid so deeply.”
Sima Zhao’s expression became somewhat solemn when he said this.
“You are already divorced, so don’t get involved in this matter.”
“Transfer all the disposable war supplies under your name to me, and the Clan will purchase them at a price 10% higher than the market price.”
“Oh... okay, I...
I’ll arrange it right away.”
After hanging up the communication, Sima Yurao stood in place and didn’t move for a long time.
She never expected that such a huge event would happen outside in such a short period of time.
She expected even less that a High-Order God would be involved behind that matter.
For some reason, Yang Fan, who always wore a gentle smile and looked courteous at the banquet, suddenly appeared in her mind.
That gentle appearance, appearing in her mind at this moment, inexplicably made her feel a chill.
“These people... who climbed up step by step from a small place.”
“Are they all so ruthless?”
Sima Yurao muttered to herself.
On the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, the situation indeed changed again.
Almost at the same time Ma Huainan’s consciousness returned to the Divine Kingdom.
Huge spatial fluctuations appeared once more.
“Boom!”
Spatial channels opened one after another above the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, a large number of reinforcement legions poured out like a tide.
Martial arts armies, Cultivation believers, Mechanical legions, and all kinds of war weapons.
Elite legions descended one after another in an endless stream.
In a short period of time, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom completely turned into a doomsday scene.
The remaining tens of billions of believers in his Divine Kingdom Core had all retreated to the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Each of them looked terrified, not even daring to breathe loudly in front of the Gods.
The number of reinforcing troops from the Sima Family reached an astonishing 500 billion!
Moreover, the equipment of these armies was even more sophisticated than the legions of Weng Chonghe and the other five.
A large number of intelligent lifeform forms in the Mechanical legions lined up neatly, and quite a few of them were directly piloting A-Class war weapons.
Seeing this scene, Weng Chonghe and the other five finally breathed a complete sigh of relief.
“Retreat!”
Weng Chonghe immediately gave the order.
“Withdraw our main force from the periphery of the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Begin the rotation of defense.”
A large number of Federal Government legions quickly retreated until the Sima Family’s army completely took over the defense line.
Weng Chonghe couldn’t help letting out a long breath of relief.
“Fuck!
They’re finally here!”
“As expected of a Peerless Prodigy.”
“I didn’t expect the Sima Family to actually organize such a luxurious rescue group!”
He couldn’t help swallowing a mouthful of saliva.
Over the past few months, they had suffered all kinds of hardships.
Up until now, the overall losses of their believer armies were approaching thirty percent.
If they relied solely on the Federal Government’s subsidies, this mission would definitely result in losing everything down to their underwear.
“Big Brother.”
The God beside him asked in a low voice:
“What should we do now?”
“The Sima Family’s reinforcements have arrived.
Can we withdraw now?”
At this moment, the Sima Family had officially taken over the battlefield.
For them, the Federal Government personnel, there was no longer any reason to stay here.
Procedurally speaking, retreating was completely compliant.
Weng Chonghe pondered for a moment, then lowered his voice:
“Withdraw what withdraw?
Play guerrilla warfare a bit and help them out with a small favor.”
“After all...”
Saying this, a meaningful smile appeared on his face.
“Young Master Ma promised us 20 million military merits each.
We can’t take this money for free.”
The people beside him suddenly showed a look of realization.
“Big Brother is still wise.
We mustn’t leave any handles for others to gossip about.”
The few of them looked at each other, and a bad smile appeared on the corners of their mouths one after another.
The next moment, ten powerful divine consciousness phantoms descended upon this world almost simultaneously.
The terrifying divine coercion intertwined, causing the entire Divine Kingdom space to tremble faintly.
The leading figure stepped forward.
“I am Sima Jin, a Tier 3 God of the Sima Family.”
“Young Master Lu, Ma Huainan, an out-of-Clan Genius of our Sima Family, previously investigated the Divine Kingdom information of others, which indeed constitutes a serious violation of the law.”
“Regarding this, our Sima Family is willing to give Yang Fan sufficient compensation.”
“Look, let this matter rest here, how about that?”
Sima Jin’s tone was very polite, without the slightest intention of calling them to account.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: How Am I Supposed to Live
paragraphs: At this moment, within the Divine Kingdom Core, hearing the other party’s form of address, Yang Fan couldn’t help but frown.
“Young Master Lu?”
“Did he... mistake me for someone else?”
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered.
It wasn’t strange that the Sima Family could guess that this Divine Kingdom War was related to him behind the scenes.
After all, the time he chose to start the war was too hasty.
As long as the Five Great Families investigated Ma Huainan’s previous actions slightly, they would suspect him.
But suspicion was, after all, just suspicion.
The current Yang Fan was no ordinary deity without any background.
Standing behind him were the Lu Clan and the Gu Family.
Moreover, he himself already had ties with the Qin Family, the Han Family, and even the Sima Family.
As long as there was no solid evidence, the other party had no way to put him on trial in the Real World.
Precisely because of this, Yang Fan dared to launch this Divine Kingdom War so decisively.
Having failed to receive a response for a long time, Sima Jin was not anxious, but simply continued:
“Young Master Lu Mingshi, we can wait a moment.”
“Please convey our opinions to that Senior behind you.”
“As long as this matter can be facilitated, my Sima Family is willing to produce one hundred S-rank resource-type buildings as personal compensation for Young Master Lu, just to make a friend.”
Ma Huainan at the side kept his head down the entire time, not saying a word.
Yet his expression twisted bit by bit at this moment.
Lu Mingshi!
He was no fool.
In the Real World, the Sima Family had already investigated the identity of this deity behind the scenes.
Yet even so, the Sima Family didn’t dare to apply strong pressure, and even took the initiative to compensate.
This meant that the other party’s identity was far from as simple as he had imagined.
Even the Sima Family had scruples!
“Damn it! Lu Mingshi! I’ll remember you!”
“I don’t even know you! Why are you doing this to me?”
Ma Huainan roared madly in his heart.
At this moment, he felt even more aggrieved than before.
He had inexplicably encountered a Divine Kingdom invasion, and now he had even figured out the enemy’s identity.
Yet he could do nothing against the other party.
After hearing Sima Jin’s words, Yang Fan’s heart completely relaxed instead.
“Very good.”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
“It seems... someone is taking the blame for me.”
He even felt somewhat like laughing.
He hadn’t figured out how to explain it yet, but someone in the Real World had already arranged an identity for him.
Moreover, this “Lu Mingshi” seemed to have quite a background.
“Achoo!”
Meanwhile, within the Lu Clan territory.
Lu Mingshi suddenly sneezed heavily.
“Damn it! Who is talking about me behind my back?”
He rubbed his nose.
Without the investigation from the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, Lu Mingshi completely relaxed.
At this moment, he was sitting comfortably in his room.
He opened the Divine Shop and began browsing various Resources.
“One billion physical bodies of Blood Spirit Monkeys? This is not bad, add to cart.”
“Yin-nether Corpse Tide? This Formation is a bit interesting, add to cart.”
“This A-Rank War Structure looks pretty good too, add it as well.”
In just a short while, the shopping cart was stuffed to the brim.
Looking at the continuously increasing Resources, Lu Mingshi’s face gradually showed a satisfied smile.
“This price... Mom should agree.”
He nodded, then clicked pay without hesitation.
Immediately afterward, the bill was sent directly to his mother.
According to past experience, his mother would basically help him settle the bill.
However, this time, Lu Mingshi waited for a long time without waiting for the familiar “Transaction Successful”.
Instead, he waited for a call from his mother first.
“Hmm?”
Lu Mingshi was stunned for a moment, then immediately connected.
“Mom, your son’s Divine Kingdom development recently needs—”
“Get lost! If you pretend to be miserable and poor to me again! Fooling me into paying your bills, I’ll hang you up and beat you!”
“Beep, beep, beep—”
The call was hung up directly.
Lu Mingshi sat stiffly in place.
He lowered his head to look at his watch, and his expression gradually became dull.
The next moment.
Thud!
Lu Mingshi sat flat on the ground with a plop.
“No... Mom!”
“You can’t treat me like this!”
“Without your intimate payment... How am I supposed to live...”
In the courtyard, the man’s despairing voice echoed for a long time.
“Yang Eleven, launch an active attack.” Yang Fan ordered.
“Yes, Master.”
The moment he received the order, a cold glint flashed in Yang Eleven’s eyes.
The next moment.
Boom, boom, boom!
Countless Smart Weapons activated simultaneously. Energy cannons poured down like a rainstorm all over the sky, and dense energy beams blotted out the sun, crazily bombarding the Sima Family army.
Seeing this scene, Sima Jin’s expression instantly turned extremely ugly.
“Form a Formation for defense!”
“Since Young Master Lu is unwilling to talk... then let’s see the real deal with our hands!”
“My Sima Family will never easily give up a Peerless Prodigy!”
“Today, let’s see... exactly who will fail to endure the consumption of this war first!”
As Sima Jin’s voice fell, the entire Human race army quickly changed its Formation.
The next moment, a huge light blue energy shield instantly rose.
The light curtain spanned across heaven and earth, almost enveloping the entire sky.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless energy cannons bombarded the shield one after another.
Terrifying explosions bloomed instantly, and the fire in the sky completely dyed it red.
Yet those energy cannons were ultimately unable to truly break through the defense.
Explosion after explosion could only whip up violent ripples on the surface of the light blue shield.
Yang Eleven merely glanced at it and immediately judged the battlefield situation.
“Suicide squad, target—the opponent’s war weapons.”
“Blow them all up for me!”
“Yes!”
The next moment, Zombie Generals were thrown out from the army one by one.
They quickly crossed the opponent’s believer army from below, heading straight for those war weapons.
Boom!
A Zombie General accurately landed on one of the war weapons holding up a golden giant club high and continuously releasing energy.
The next second, the micro-nuclear bomb activated instantly.
“Rumble!”
The terrifying explosion erupted at close range.
The dazzling fire instantly swallowed everything around.
Even A-rank war weapons could not withstand the terrifying power of a micro-nuclear bomb at such close range.
Boom!
The huge Mechanical body burst open with a bang, and countless parts scattered and flew in all directions.
That war weapon was directly blown into debris all over the sky.
One, two, three...
As more and more war weapons were destroyed by the suicide squad,
the light blue energy shield in the sky also began to dim rapidly.
Seeing this scene, Sima Jin immediately ordered,
“Front army! Block these zombies for me!”
“These believers are all carrying war supplies of immense power!”
“They must never be allowed to get close to the [Firmament Boundary-Suppressing Shield]!”
Upon receiving the command, the foremost Human race army immediately went up to meet them.
A large number of Martial Arts believers rushed to the very front.
Blade light, hammer shadows, and fist force all erupted in an instant.
As soon as a Zombie General approached, its neck was fiercely severed by a long blade.
Another Zombie General had just rushed into the crowd.
The next moment, a giant hammer smashed down heavily, directly caving in its chest.
Yet these suicide squad members did not retreat at all. At the very last moment when their bodies were about to completely lose mobility,
the micro-nuclear bomb directly detonated, and the terrifying shockwave instantly swept the surroundings.
A large number of Human race believers were swallowed up on the spot.
And more Zombie Generals rushed into the battlefield wave after wave.
They didn’t care about their own life or death at all.
Their sole target was to eliminate as many enemies as possible.
