chapters.title: Chapter 467: Fucking Rich
paragraphs: In the rear, Yang Eleven’s expression grew colder and colder.
“Release a large number of ordinary zombies!”
“Everyone, swallow corpse pills!”
“In addition, bring up all those volatile poisons refined by the Alchemy Spirit World!”
“Begin executing Plan B!”
“Yes!”
The command was quickly transmitted, and a large number of ordinary zombies surged out from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Bottles of poison were quickly opened, and a large amount of poisonous fog began to spread gradually with the war.
At this moment, Yang Eleven had pushed his own computing power to the limit.
Both sides’ armies, war weapons, believer losses, and Formation strength.
Every piece of information was within his calculations.
“Report to the Marshal!”
“The penetration of the energy cannons released by the enemy’s Smart Weapon is constantly increasing!”
“It is expected that it will soon exceed the current defense limit of the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest!”
“Five million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers! Push them all up for me!”
Yang Eleven gave the order without hesitation.
“Share the artillery pressure! Don’t be afraid of losses!”
“Use the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers to forcefully charge the enemy’s vanguard!”
“I want their Formation to be completely disrupted!”
“Yes!”
The next moment, a large number of Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers moved directly to the front of the battlefield.
One A-Rank War Structure after another, like extremely hard mobile fortresses, forcefully blocked the very front.
Energy cannons filled the sky, bombarding down one after another.
The sound of explosions was endless, and the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers began to be damaged one by one.
But at the same time, the Sima Family vanguard’s Formation also began to loosen.
“Report to the Marshal!”
“The enemy possesses a large amount of Holy Spirit Water!”
“It has seriously affected our army’s advance route!”
Yang Eleven frowned slightly.
“We will pour out decomposed corpse water!”
“Our God has long prepared a sufficient quantity of this war resource for us. Cover the entire route with it!”
“Yes!”
A large amount of decomposed corpse water was quickly poured out, and the area that had originally begun to be purified by the Holy Spirit Water once again turned into a dangerous corpse poison zone.
The entire battlefield began to completely get out of control.
“Report to the Marshal! The left army has suffered heavy losses and needs support!”
“White Zombie believers, go support them.”
Yang Eleven quickly gave the order.
“The enemy is mainly Cultivation believers, so everyone is equipped with spirit-breaking Talismans in advance.”
“Once their Spiritual Qi protective shields are shattered, they will be immediately infected by the corpse poison.”
“Understood!”
“Report to the Marshal!”
Battle reports came in one after another, but Yang Eleven never panicked in the slightest.
He was like a cold war machine, constantly adjusting his deployment according to changes on the battlefield.
At this moment, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had completely turned into a purgatory.

The casualties of both armies began to rise rapidly, especially as a large amount of corpse pills and special poisons were poured into the battlefield, the environment of the entire Divine Kingdom began to undergo drastic changes.
The air was filled with thick corpse poison, and the ground was covered with various corrosive liquids.
The Spiritual Qi structure in the sky also began to show disorder.
Except for those intelligent lifeform forms, whether believers of the Martial Route or believers of the Cultivation Path, they all began to feel obvious discomfort.
Difficulty breathing, obstructed circulation of Qi and blood, and decreased spiritual power recovery speed.
Combat effectiveness also began to decline bit by bit.
And all of this was still continuously spreading toward the Divine Kingdom Core area.
High above in the sky, Ma Huainan’s conscious phantom had become extremely weak.
His expression became increasingly ugly, and even a trace of fear faintly appeared.
Because he discovered that those corpse poisons had actually spread to his own Divine Kingdom Core!
The believers there were all elderly people, children, and a large number of Tiered Being who could not participate in such a war.
And now, these people who should have been hiding in the Divine Kingdom Core waiting for the war to end also began to show abnormalities.
Bloodshot eyes, rotting skin, and some people had already begun to undergo slight zombification.
“Lord Sima...”
Ma Huainan’s voice trembled.
“My believers... they can’t hold on much longer...”
At this moment, Sima Jin was trying his best to maintain the frontline battle situation.
Hearing this, he suddenly turned back, his eyes full of irritability.
“Think of a way to solve it yourself!”
“Go buy Resources like antidote potions or holy water!”
“Stop fucking bothering me!”
After speaking, Sima Jin poured his attention back into the battlefield.
At this moment, Sima Jin couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
There was no help for it.
This war was simply too ruthless.
It would be one thing if he were only facing these zombie armies.
After all, the individual combat strength of Corpse Cultivator believers was not considered strong to begin with.
Relying on the 500 billion army supported by their Sima Family, logically speaking, it should completely form an overwhelming momentum.
But as it happened... the opponent didn’t know where they got a large amount of disposable war supplies.
And what was most outrageous was that almost every zombie believer carried a large amount of war Resources on them.
Whenever a localized clash occurred between the two sides, the opponent didn’t consider the cost at all.
Bombs, Talismans, corpse pills, and all kinds of disposable war supplies were crazily thrown out as if they cost nothing.
As long as it could trade for enemy casualties, they didn’t care how much they consumed themselves.
Thus, an extremely bizarre scene appeared.
Clearly their overall force held an absolute advantage, and clearly the combat strength of the Corpse Cultivator believers was far inferior to theirs.
Yet when they actually fought, their losses were instead even greater!
“Bastard! The Lu Clan is fucking rich!”
“This is simply going too far!”
Sima Jin gritted his teeth.
In just this short while, he felt that the war Resources he had invested had already reached hundreds of billions of Divinity Points.
Is this fucking fighting a war?
This is simply burning money!
And throwing Divinity Points into the fire handful by handful!
“Is it necessary?”
“Is this really worth it?”
Sima Jin even had a feeling of doubting his life.
Thinking that a High-Order God might be standing behind the opponent supporting the battlefield, Sima Jin felt an urge to retreat rise in his heart.
Now that Ma Huainan had actively exposed the Divine Kingdom coordinates, the Sima Family should naturally protect him as much as possible.
But the problem was...
Everything in this world had a price tag.
If protecting Ma Huainan required all these elite believers under their command to die here, he would definitely be unwilling.
These believers were all the most core combat power within his own Divine Kingdom.
Once heavy losses were suffered, it would affect the development of the Divine Kingdom for the next few decades, or even a hundred years.
The subsidies given by the Clan were simply not enough!
Thinking of this, Sima Jin’s mood became increasingly irritable.
On the other side.
Yang Fan looked at the offensive and defensive forces constantly pulling back and forth on the frontline, and his originally somewhat tense emotions gradually relaxed.
Judging from the current situation, both sides had fallen into a war of attrition.
And this was precisely the situation Yang Fan was most willing to see.
“Yang Da, purchase a large amount of flesh energy and put it into the Life Essence Conversion Pool.”
“the frontline troop losses are severe. Continue to draw troops for me from the Eternal Corpse Mine and send them to the frontline in an endless stream.”
Yang Fan’s expression was calm.
“I have the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, so what if there are more than a dozen Tier 3 Gods?”
“I don’t believe they can outlast me. I am going to drag them down to their deaths alive!”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da responded immediately.
Yang Fan continued to give orders:
“Those Alchemists in the Alchemy Spirit World, refine poison pills with all your might, and continuously support the frontline.”
“Do not stop purchasing disposable war supplies either; continue to purchase heavily from major shops on the frontline.”
“As long as it’s useful for the war, buy as much as you can.”
A hint of coldness flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.
“If that is still not enough... then transfer all the Great Void Warship and Mechanical War Puppets over as well.”
“Anyway, these things weren’t produced by my own Divine Kingdom to begin with.”
“Even if they want to investigate, they won’t be able to pin it on me.”

“Release a large number of ordinary zombies!”
“Everyone, swallow corpse pills!”
“In addition, bring up all those volatile poisons refined by the Alchemy Spirit World!”
“Begin executing Plan B!”
“Yes!”
The command was quickly transmitted, and a large number of ordinary zombies surged out from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Bottles of poison were quickly opened, and a large amount of poisonous fog began to spread gradually with the war.
At this moment, Yang Eleven had pushed his own computing power to the limit.
Both sides’ armies, war weapons, believer losses, and Formation strength.
Every piece of information was within his calculations.
“Report to the Marshal!”
“The penetration of the energy cannons released by the enemy’s Smart Weapon is constantly increasing!”
“It is expected that it will soon exceed the current defense limit of the Flesh Scourge Mother Nest!”
“Five million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers!
Push them all up for me!”
Yang Eleven gave the order without hesitation.
“Share the artillery pressure!
Don’t be afraid of losses!”
“Use the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers to forcefully charge the enemy’s vanguard!”
“I want their Formation to be completely disrupted!”
“Yes!”
The next moment, a large number of Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers moved directly to the front of the battlefield.
One A-Rank War Structure after another, like extremely hard mobile fortresses, forcefully blocked the very front.
Energy cannons filled the sky, bombarding down one after another.
The sound of explosions was endless, and the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers began to be damaged one by one.
But at the same time, the Sima Family vanguard’s Formation also began to loosen.
“Report to the Marshal!”
“The enemy possesses a large amount of Holy Spirit Water!”
“It has seriously affected our army’s advance route!”
Yang Eleven frowned slightly.
“We will pour out decomposed corpse water!”
“Our God has long prepared a sufficient quantity of this war resource for us.
Cover the entire route with it!”
“Yes!”
A large amount of decomposed corpse water was quickly poured out, and the area that had originally begun to be purified by the Holy Spirit Water once again turned into a dangerous corpse poison zone.
The entire battlefield began to completely get out of control.
“Report to the Marshal!
The left army has suffered heavy losses and needs support!”
“White Zombie believers, go support them.”
Yang Eleven quickly gave the order.
“The enemy is mainly Cultivation believers, so everyone is equipped with spirit-breaking Talismans in advance.”
“Once their Spiritual Qi protective shields are shattered, they will be immediately infected by the corpse poison.”
“Understood!”
“Report to the Marshal!”
Battle reports came in one after another, but Yang Eleven never panicked in the slightest.
He was like a cold war machine, constantly adjusting his deployment according to changes on the battlefield.
At this moment, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had completely turned into a purgatory.

The casualties of both armies began to rise rapidly, especially as a large amount of corpse pills and special poisons were poured into the battlefield, the environment of the entire Divine Kingdom began to undergo drastic changes.
The air was filled with thick corpse poison, and the ground was covered with various corrosive liquids.
The Spiritual Qi structure in the sky also began to show disorder.
Except for those intelligent lifeform forms, whether believers of the Martial Route or believers of the Cultivation Path, they all began to feel obvious discomfort.
Difficulty breathing, obstructed circulation of Qi and blood, and decreased spiritual power recovery speed.
Combat effectiveness also began to decline bit by bit.
And all of this was still continuously spreading toward the Divine Kingdom Core area.
High above in the sky, Ma Huainan’s conscious phantom had become extremely weak.
His expression became increasingly ugly, and even a trace of fear faintly appeared.
Because he discovered that those corpse poisons had actually spread to his own Divine Kingdom Core!
The believers there were all elderly people, children, and a large number of Tiered Being who could not participate in such a war.
And now, these people who should have been hiding in the Divine Kingdom Core waiting for the war to end also began to show abnormalities.
Bloodshot eyes, rotting skin, and some people had already begun to undergo slight zombification.
“Lord Sima...”
Ma Huainan’s voice trembled.
“My believers... they can’t hold on much longer...”
At this moment, Sima Jin was trying his best to maintain the frontline battle situation.
Hearing this, he suddenly turned back, his eyes full of irritability.
“Think of a way to solve it yourself!”
“Go buy Resources like antidote potions or holy water!”
“Stop fucking bothering me!”
After speaking, Sima Jin poured his attention back into the battlefield.
At this moment, Sima Jin couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
There was no help for it.
This war was simply too ruthless.
It would be one thing if he were only facing these zombie armies.
After all, the individual combat strength of Corpse Cultivator believers was not considered strong to begin with.
Relying on the 500 billion army supported by their Sima Family, logically speaking, it should completely form an overwhelming momentum.
But as it happened... the opponent didn’t know where they got a large amount of disposable war supplies.
And what was most outrageous was that almost every zombie believer carried a large amount of war Resources on them.
Whenever a localized clash occurred between the two sides, the opponent didn’t consider the cost at all.
Bombs, Talismans, corpse pills, and all kinds of disposable war supplies were crazily thrown out as if they cost nothing.
As long as it could trade for enemy casualties, they didn’t care how much they consumed themselves.
Thus, an extremely bizarre scene appeared.
Clearly their overall force held an absolute advantage, and clearly the combat strength of the Corpse Cultivator believers was far inferior to theirs.
Yet when they actually fought, their losses were instead even greater!
“Bastard!
The Lu Clan is fucking rich!”
“This is simply going too far!”
Sima Jin gritted his teeth.
In just this short while, he felt that the war Resources he had invested had already reached hundreds of billions of Divinity Points.
Is this fucking fighting a war?
This is simply burning money!
And throwing Divinity Points into the fire handful by handful!
“Is it necessary?”
“Is this really worth it?”
Sima Jin even had a feeling of doubting his life.
Thinking that a High-Order God might be standing behind the opponent supporting the battlefield, Sima Jin felt an urge to retreat rise in his heart.
Now that Ma Huainan had actively exposed the Divine Kingdom coordinates, the Sima Family should naturally protect him as much as possible.
But the problem was...
Everything in this world had a price tag.
If protecting Ma Huainan required all these elite believers under their command to die here, he would definitely be unwilling.
These believers were all the most core combat power within his own Divine Kingdom.
Once heavy losses were suffered, it would affect the development of the Divine Kingdom for the next few decades, or even a hundred years.
The subsidies given by the Clan were simply not enough!

“Even if they want to investigate, they won’t be able to pin it on me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 468: I Know Nothing
paragraphs: “I will keep a close eye on this war the entire time and will not let any mistakes happen,” Yang Da assured.
Yang Fan nodded.
Afterwards, his consciousness slowly withdrew from the divine kingdom.
Although a fierce battle was breaking out in the divine kingdom at this moment, Yang Fan had no intention of continuing to watch the frontline.
Now that the battlefield had entered a stalemate stage, both sides were continuously investing troops and wildly competing in Resources and foundations.
Under these circumstances, even if Yang Fan personally took charge, it would be difficult for him to make more accurate judgments than intelligent lifeform.
When it came to war command, intelligent lifeform, which possessed a massive database and terrifying computing power, was inherently better at it than him.
If an emergency really occurred, Yang Da would naturally notify him at the first instance, so there was really no need to keep staring at it.
Such was life; no matter how important some things were.
If you did not have the ability to change the situation, continuing to stare at it was merely constantly consuming your own emotions.
Successful people did not remain in a tense state all the time; instead, they gave it their all when they were able to act.
When things could not be changed, they learned to maintain an ordinary state of mind.
Yang Fan shook his somewhat stiff neck.
“Clap!”
He snapped his fingers.
Soon, the door was pushed open, and a smart robot walked in.
“Master, what are your orders?”
Yang Fan leaned back in his chair, his expression returning to calm.
“Go prepare a hydrotherapy.”
“Also, arrange a few massage robots.”
“I should also relax a bit.”
“Yes, Master,” the smart robot respectfully nodded.
On the second floor of the Lu Family Villa.
Lu Wan was sitting in the study conducting a video conference.
“General Manager Lu, the company currently does not have a large reserve of divine kingdom deduction cards.”
“If we make temporary purchases now, I’m afraid we’ll have to pay a significant premium.”
On the other end of the video, a person in charge reported cautiously.
“Continue purchasing.”
Lu Wan’s expression was calm.
“Within two years, the deduction must succeed.”
“The company has already invested so many Resources; if it still fails two years later, those two Mechanical divine executives should prepare to resign to take the blame.”
“Yes, General Manager Lu.”
The person on the opposite side grew visibly more nervous.
“There is one more matter. The procurement quota for this war material is simply too large. Do we need to transfer a portion of the cash flow from the headquarters?”
“No need.”
Lu Wan shook her head.
“In a moment, I will directly transfer it to you through the divine kingdom. Do not route this portion of funds through the company’s public account.”
“Understood.”
The other end of the video responded immediately.
“There is another matter...”
Before the other party could finish speaking, the smart watch on Lu Wan’s wrist suddenly vibrated, and a new call request forcibly barged in.
Lu Wan lowered her head to glance at the caller, and a trace of doubt immediately appeared on her face.
“Continue advancing according to the original plan, I have other matters.”
Having said that, Lu Wan directly hung up the company’s communication.
“Cousin Gu Le, why are you calling me?”
“How much funds have you managed to gather?”
After connecting, Lu Wan directly asked.
There was a moment of silence on the other end of the communication.
A moment later, Gu Le only said one sentence: “Meet in the Virtual World.”
As her voice fell, the communication was directly cut off.
Beep beep beep—
Lu Wan furrowed her brows slightly.
Although she had some doubts, she did not delay.
Soon she put on her virtual helmet, and her consciousness followed the coordinates to enter Gu Le’s private virtual space.
Inside the pure white space, Gu Le was sitting upright behind a table.
“What do you want with me?”
“I’m very busy.”
As soon as Lu Wan sat down, she couldn’t help speaking out.
Gu Le did not answer, but instead raised her head and carefully observed Lu Wan’s expression.
After a moment, she slowly said:
“It seems... it really has nothing to do with you.”
“What do you mean?” Lu Wan’s brows furrowed even tighter.
The next moment, Gu Le raised her right hand.
A blue light flashed, and an electronic panel instantly materialized in her hand.
She placed the electronic screen on the table and then pushed it in front of Lu Wan.
“Take a look for yourself.”
On the electronic screen, a battlefield recording was playing.
It was impressively the battle scenes inside Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom.
After Lu Wan watched for only a few seconds, her expression gradually grew solemn.
“So strong...” she said in a low voice.
Smart Weapons, a large number of A-Rank War Structures, as well as more than three hundred S-rank war building.
Such a terrifying divine kingdom foundation caused even Lu Wan to involuntarily feel a trace of chill.
Lu Wan stared at the video for a long while.
“Where did this video come from? Do you know this Corpse Cultivator deity?”
“Could it be that you plan to invite him to make a move and help Husband deal with Ma Huainan?”
Speaking of this, her eyes suddenly lit up.
In order to deal with Ma Huainan, she had prepared I don’t know how many sets of plans these past few days.
She had even started screening deities who could make a move one by one.
If she could really pull over such a terrifying Corpse Cultivator deity, future matters would be much simpler.
Hearing this, Gu Le shook her head instead.
“Cousin, this is the battlefield inside Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom.”
“What?” Lu Wan was startled.
Gu Le continued:
“The other party has been forced to make the divine kingdom coordinates public to the Sima Family.”
“Just a short while ago, the Five Great Families were all investigated by the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.”
“And that person we originally planned to deal with...”
“Now I’m afraid they’re almost taken care of by someone else.”
The room instantly quieted down.
Lu Wan was stunned in place.
A few seconds later, she suddenly stood up. “You... you aren’t joking with me?”
“I originally thought this was something you and Husband did behind my back.”
Watching her shocked expression, Gu Le completely relaxed instead.
“It seems you don’t know either.”
She couldn’t help patting her chest.
“Scared me to death. Knowing that Cousin was also kept in the dark, I suddenly feel much more comfortable inside.”
Lu Wan, however, ignored her, leaving only one question in her mind.
“Husband? This matter is related to Husband?”
“Pretty much.”
Gu Le nodded.
“Mother told me.”
“Not long ago, Husband once spent a full two hundred trillion Divinity Points to purchase two hundred million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers from the Gu Family.”
“Moreover... that transaction was personally reviewed and approved by my father.”
Gu Le raised her hand and pointed at the battlefield on the electronic screen.
“Now it seems, Husband probably gave these war buildings to this Corpse Cultivator deity.”
Lu Wan looked back at the video.
Within the imagery, those endless Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers covered the earth like a black ocean.
Lu Wan couldn’t help swallowing a mouthful of saliva.
Shock, doubt, incomprehension—various emotions intertwined in her heart.
“I know nothing.”
Lu Wan gently bit her lower lip.
Lowering her head, in a place where Gu Le couldn’t see, a trace of faint grievance welled up in the depths of her eyes.
Such a huge matter, yet Yang Fan didn’t tell her anything at all, even though they clearly lived together.
Why?
Could it be that she was just that untrustworthy?

chapters.title: Chapter 469: I Deeply Love You
paragraphs: Gu Le looked at Lu Wan’s expression and did not continue asking.
After learning that Lu Wan was also an outsider to this matter, the slight discomfort in her heart completely vanished, and she even felt faintly happy.
After all, to deal with a Genius of the Peerless Prodigy level like Ma Huainan, the price that needed to be paid was definitely not small.
Even with their status, it would make them feel a pang of distress over the cost.
Now that the matter had unexpectedly been resolved in advance by someone, the pressure on everyone naturally lessened a lot all at once.
Thinking of this, Gu Le couldn’t help laughing.
“Alright, wouldn’t we know by just calling Husband over to ask?”
“Anyway, it’s a great joyous event.”
At this moment, Yang Fan was still leisurely lying downstairs.
The soft recliner swayed slightly, and a few massage robots were methodically helping him relax his body.
Right at this moment,
Boom!
The door was suddenly shoved open fiercely, and Lu Wan walked in quickly holding a virtual helmet in one hand.
“Hm?” Yang Fan had just opened his eyes.
The next moment, a cold metal helmet directly smashed toward his head.
With Yang Fan’s current strength, it was naturally impossible for him to be hit by this kind of attack.
His hand subconsciously raised, steadily catching it.
“Wife Wan’er, what’s wrong?”
Yang Fan looked at the virtual helmet in his hand, a smile still lingering on his face.
“Do you want a massage together?”
Looking at the man in front of her enjoying a massage with a completely leisurely and self-satisfied face,
and thinking of how busy and flustered she had been running around for this period of time,
the fire in Lu Wan’s heart instantly surged upward another notch.
She took a deep breath, “Enter the Virtual World, Gu Le is waiting for us.”
Yang Fan swallowed hard, not knowing why.
He always felt that his wife, who was always gentle and virtuous, was in a state today... that seemed a bit wrong.
“Mn, let’s go.”
Soon, the consciousnesses of the two entered the Virtual World.
Inside the pure white private space, Gu Le had already been waiting for a long time.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, she walked up quickly and tightly hugged Yang Fan’s arm.
“Husband, you are so amazing!”
“You are going to resolve Ma Huainan so quickly!”
“Why didn’t you tell us earlier?”
“My cousin and I have been so busy these past few months that we were almost worked to death!”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan understood instantly in his heart.
Sure enough, the matter had still been exposed.
Actually, the reason why he didn’t tell Lu Wan and Gu Le
on one hand, was because they didn’t take the initiative to ask at all.
on the other hand, was also because of Yang Fan’s own selfishness.
For this kind of matter, naturally the fewer people who knew, the better.
Originally, in his plan, after Ma Huainan was completely resolved,
even Lu Wan and Gu Le would only think that this was some unfamiliar Corpse Cultivator god making a move.
They would treat everything as luck.
In this way, the secret of his own divine kingdom naturally wouldn’t be exposed.
After all, what Yang Fan least hoped for was for the secret of his divine kingdom to be known by others.
Even if the other party was his own wife, it was the same.
But judging from Lu Wan’s obviously wrong attitude just now, and Gu Le’s expression of almost being certain of the answer,
Yang Fan already had a judgment in his heart: he should have been exposed.
As for the exact extent of the exposure and how many people knew, it still needed further confirmation.
“Ahem.”
Yang Fan gave a light cough.
“For some matters, even I myself didn’t have full assurance, so I didn’t want to let you worry in vain.”
This statement was ambiguous, neither denying it nor directly admitting it.
However, upon hearing this, Lu Wan, who had just been sulking, relaxed her expression a little bit.
Lu Wan took a deep breath and said,
“Husband, who on earth is this Corpse Cultivator god?”
“Is he reliable? Do we need any more support?”
“We absolutely cannot give up halfway now.”
Before Yang Fan could speak, Gu Le on the side couldn’t help laughing.
“Cousin Lu Wan, a Corpse Cultivator god with such a terrifying foundation isn’t hard to guess.”
“You actually don’t even know someone from your own family?”
“Someone from my own family?” Lu Wan was startled.
Gu Le spat out three words with a smile, “Lu Mingshi.”
“According to seniority, the other party should still have to call you Great-Grandma, right?”
“...” The expression on Lu Wan’s face instantly froze.
The next moment, she seemed to have finally figured something out.
“So it was him!”
Lu Wan suddenly turned her head, her gaze staring fixedly at Yang Fan.
“Husband, how do you know Lu Mingshi?”
“And... he is actually willing to help you sparing no effort like this?”
Yang Fan’s face couldn’t help twitching slightly.
For a moment, he actually didn’t know how to answer.
In fact, at this moment Yang Fan himself was very curious: who on earth was Lu Mingshi?
Why was everyone suspecting him?
If this kept making a fuss, what if one day this Lu Mingshi came looking for him, pointed at his nose and questioned: “Why did you use my identity as a shield?”
That would be a bit awkward.
Seeing Yang Fan’s look of dilemma, Lu Wan hesitated for a moment.
“Husband... are there some transactions that are restricted by a contract and cannot be spoken of?”
Yang Fan was taken aback upon hearing this.
In the real world, the Human race had federal laws.
Within the divine kingdom world, rules and contracts equally existed.
For example, the Subordinate God Contract that everyone was familiar with.
Once signed, both parties must be bound by the rules of the divine kingdom.
If either party violated the contract, they would have to pay a price.
Therefore, in Lu Wan’s view, a Lu Mingshi would not even hesitate to bet the combat power of his entire divine kingdom to help her husband solve a Peerless Prodigy.
Then between the two parties, apart from those two hundred million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, there must be even deeper-level transactions.
And even to ensure that the transaction between the two sides was fair enough, they likely even used a divine kingdom contract.
Thinking of this, the gaze Lu Wan cast toward Yang Fan instead held a bit more understanding.
“Husband, if it is inconvenient for you to speak, it doesn’t matter.”
“It is just... since it already involves transactions of this level,”
“You must be careful.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt even more bizarre in his heart.
Looking at Lu Wan’s eyes full of worry, Yang Fan hardened his heart and then nodded earnestly.
“Wan’er, Le’er, just leave this matter to me!”
“I am your husband, your man.”
“In the future, it is up to me to protect you.”
“And this is my own problem, how could I push all the difficulties onto you?”
“Everyone has responsibilities that they need to shoulder.”
Saying this, Yang Fan reached out and pulled the two of them to his side, one on the left and one on the right.
Afterwards, he held Lu Wan with one hand and Gu Le with the other.
The palms of the three slowly stacked together.
“Wan’er, Le’er, I deeply love you.”
“This is a responsibility that I, as a husband and a man, should shoulder myself.”
“Back then when I told you about this matter, watching you run around busily for my affairs these past few days, my conscience has constantly been under condemnation.”
“Sometimes, I even feel like I’ve failed as a man.”
“Clearly it should be me protecting you, but in the end, it made you bear the pressure together with me.”
Yang Fan took a deep breath.
“So... please believe me.”
“I deeply love you.”
Finishing speaking, Yang Fan opened his arms and forcefully pulled Lu Wan and Gu Le together into his embrace.
His eyes didn’t have the slightest bit of joking, only the most sincere earnestness.

sentences.text: Gu Le looked at Lu Wan’s expression and did not continue asking.
After learning that Lu Wan was also an outsider to this matter, the slight discomfort in her heart completely vanished, and she even felt faintly happy.
After all, to deal with a Genius of the Peerless Prodigy level like Ma Huainan, the price that needed to be paid was definitely not small.
Even with their status, it would make them feel a pang of distress over the cost.
Now that the matter had unexpectedly been resolved in advance by someone, the pressure on everyone naturally lessened a lot all at once.
Thinking of this, Gu Le couldn’t help laughing.
“Alright, wouldn’t we know by just calling Husband over to ask?”
“Anyway, it’s a great joyous event.”
At this moment, Yang Fan was still leisurely lying downstairs.
The soft recliner swayed slightly, and a few massage robots were methodically helping him relax his body.
Right at this moment,
Boom!
The door was suddenly shoved open fiercely, and Lu Wan walked in quickly holding a virtual helmet in one hand.
“Hm?” Yang Fan had just opened his eyes.
The next moment, a cold metal helmet directly smashed toward his head.
With Yang Fan’s current strength, it was naturally impossible for him to be hit by this kind of attack.
His hand subconsciously raised, steadily catching it.
“Wife Wan’er, what’s wrong?”
Yang Fan looked at the virtual helmet in his hand, a smile still lingering on his face.
“Do you want a massage together?”
Looking at the man in front of her enjoying a massage with a completely leisurely and self-satisfied face,
and thinking of how busy and flustered she had been running around for this period of time,
the fire in Lu Wan’s heart instantly surged upward another notch.
She took a deep breath, “Enter the Virtual World, Gu Le is waiting for us.”
Yang Fan swallowed hard, not knowing why.
He always felt that his wife, who was always gentle and virtuous, was in a state today... that seemed a bit wrong.
“Mn, let’s go.”
Soon, the consciousnesses of the two entered the Virtual World.
Inside the pure white private space, Gu Le had already been waiting for a long time.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, she walked up quickly and tightly hugged Yang Fan’s arm.
“Husband, you are so amazing!”
“You are going to resolve Ma Huainan so quickly!”
“Why didn’t you tell us earlier?”
“My cousin and I have been so busy these past few months that we were almost worked to death!”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan understood instantly in his heart.
Sure enough, the matter had still been exposed.
Actually, the reason why he didn’t tell Lu Wan and Gu Le
on one hand, was because they didn’t take the initiative to ask at all.
on the other hand, was also because of Yang Fan’s own selfishness.
For this kind of matter, naturally the fewer people who knew, the better.
Originally, in his plan, after Ma Huainan was completely resolved,
even Lu Wan and Gu Le would only think that this was some unfamiliar Corpse Cultivator god making a move.
They would treat everything as luck.
In this way, the secret of his own divine kingdom naturally wouldn’t be exposed.
After all, what Yang Fan least hoped for was for the secret of his divine kingdom to be known by others.
Even if the other party was his own wife, it was the same.
But judging from Lu Wan’s obviously wrong attitude just now, and Gu Le’s expression of almost being certain of the answer,
Yang Fan already had a judgment in his heart: he should have been exposed.
As for the exact extent of the exposure and how many people knew, it still needed further confirmation.
“Ahem.”
Yang Fan gave a light cough.
“For some matters, even I myself didn’t have full assurance, so I didn’t want to let you worry in vain.”
This statement was ambiguous, neither denying it nor directly admitting it.

Lu Wan took a deep breath and said,
“Husband, who on earth is this Corpse Cultivator god?”
“Is he reliable?
Do we need any more support?”
“We absolutely cannot give up halfway now.”

“Cousin Lu Wan, a Corpse Cultivator god with such a terrifying foundation isn’t hard to guess.”

“According to seniority, the other party should still have to call you Great-Grandma, right?”
“...” The expression on Lu Wan’s face instantly froze.
The next moment, she seemed to have finally figured something out.
“So it was him!”
Lu Wan suddenly turned her head, her gaze staring fixedly at Yang Fan.
“Husband, how do you know Lu Mingshi?”
“And... he is actually willing to help you sparing no effort like this?”
Yang Fan’s face couldn’t help twitching slightly.
For a moment, he actually didn’t know how to answer.
In fact, at this moment Yang Fan himself was very curious: who on earth was Lu Mingshi?
Why was everyone suspecting him?
If this kept making a fuss, what if one day this Lu Mingshi came looking for him, pointed at his nose and questioned: “Why did you use my identity as a shield?”
That would be a bit awkward.
Seeing Yang Fan’s look of dilemma, Lu Wan hesitated for a moment.
“Husband... are there some transactions that are restricted by a contract and cannot be spoken of?”
Yang Fan was taken aback upon hearing this.
In the real world, the Human race had federal laws.
Within the divine kingdom world, rules and contracts equally existed.
For example, the Subordinate God Contract that everyone was familiar with.
Once signed, both parties must be bound by the rules of the divine kingdom.
If either party violated the contract, they would have to pay a price.
Therefore, in Lu Wan’s view, a Lu Mingshi would not even hesitate to bet the combat power of his entire divine kingdom to help her husband solve a Peerless Prodigy.
Then between the two parties, apart from those two hundred million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, there must be even deeper-level transactions.
And even to ensure that the transaction between the two sides was fair enough, they likely even used a divine kingdom contract.
Thinking of this, the gaze Lu Wan cast toward Yang Fan instead held a bit more understanding.
“Husband, if it is inconvenient for you to speak, it doesn’t matter.”

“You must be careful.”

“I deeply love you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 470: The Sky Is Falling
paragraphs: At that moment, Gu Le’s eyes widened instantly.
Her face was full of disbelief; she never expected that Yang Fan would suddenly pull such a stunt.
On the other hand, Lu Wan beside her responded to Yang Fan almost instantly.
She wrapped her arms tightly around his waist, and the tears in her eyes streamed down completely out of control.
A usually decisive and formidable female CEO was now crying like a child.
“Husband... I know your feelings.”
“But you really don’t have to carry everything by yourself!”
“I can help you!”
“Wuwuwu...”
The more Lu Wan spoke, the more aggrieved she felt.
She suddenly raised her head, her eye sockets completely red.
“My Divine Kingdom still has over two hundred trillion in liquid funds of Divinity Points.”
“And the company’s shares can be cashed out.”
“If worse comes to worst, I can still go ask my mother for help.”
“If that Lu Mingshi really dares to use the Divine Kingdom contract to threaten Husband...”
Lu Wan gritted her teeth.
“I will definitely have my mother make a move and make sure he gets what’s coming to him!”
At that moment, she was truly and completely moved by what Yang Fan had just said.
Just a moment ago, she was actually somewhat upset in her heart because Yang Fan kept such a big matter from her.
She even briefly wondered if she had been deceived.
But now, she finally understood.
The reason her husband hadn’t told them all along wasn’t because of a lack of trust.
On the contrary, it was because he cared too much.
He wasn’t willing to let them bear too heavy of a loss.
Even less was he willing to make them pull out massive resources because of his own affairs.
When all is said and done, this belonged to a man’s self-esteem.
Perhaps this kind of self-esteem sometimes made him pay a higher price when making decisions.
Yet Lu Wan did not hate it.
Because she could feel that Yang Fan truly held her in his heart.
He had never developed any inferiority complex just because he was born in a small place.
Instead, he had always been striving to make himself stronger.
Nor had he ever taken her and Gu Le’s identities for granted to choose dependency, never thinking of lying flat and living off his two wives.
He was genuinely and seriously nurturing this relationship, and truly regarded them as the people he needed to protect.
Thinking of this, the tears in Lu Wan’s eyes welled up once again.
“Husband...”
“I love you so much.”
Her voice trembled slightly.
On the other side, Gu Le, who was held tightly in Yang Fan’s arms, did not have as strong a reaction as Lu Wan.
Of course she was also touched; after all, Yang Fan’s words were indeed very sincere.
Yet for some reason.
She always felt... something wasn’t quite right.
Especially when looking at Lu Wan before her, Gu Le’s expression gradually grew blank.
Is this... Lu Wan?
Is this really Lu Wan?
That cousin of hers who was usually decisive in her actions and whose every word was about interests, investments, and risk control?
Since when did she become like this?
Gu Le felt as if her worldview was being rubbed repeatedly against the ground by someone.
She couldn’t help lowering her head to look at herself, then at Yang Fan and Lu Wan embracing each other.
An absurd thought suddenly popped up in her mind.
“Am I... a bit redundant?”
Clearly, their marriage was a union of interests.
Clearly, they were all gods.
Logically speaking, what they should be talking about was resources, interests, the development of the Divine Kingdom, and future layouts.
But now... why did the style suddenly turn out like this?
“This...”
“What on earth happened?”
Gu Le’s face was filled with bewilderment.
Two gods, playing pure romance here?
“Did I overdo my act again?”
Yang Fan faintly felt as if his conscience had been punched hard by someone, and it tilted slightly to the side.
He quickly released his arms, his tone turning serious once again.
“Believe me.”
“Your husband has the ability to resolve this matter.”
“And since this matter involves illegal activities after all, I hope you can stay out of it as much as possible.”
Lu Wan wanted to say something more.
Right at that moment, she suddenly froze for a second, as if she had received some information.
“What’s wrong, Cousin?”
Noticing that Lu Wan’s expression was off, Gu Le hurriedly asked.
“My intelligent lifeform just reminded me.”
“Lu Mingshi is contacting me, and he’s very anxious, saying he wants to see Husband immediately.”
Lu Wan replied truthfully.
Hearing these words, Yang Fan felt the hairs on his back instantly stand on end.
Was he going to be confronted?
And right in front of his two wives?
At that moment, Yang Fan wished he could directly transmigrate back to one minute ago and take back everything he had just said.
If they were to meet right now.
Wouldn’t his lies be exposed on the spot?
By then... the husband image he had worked so hard to build would probably plummet straight into the eighteenth level of Hell!
“No need.”
Yang Fan quickly said.
“I will contact him personally afterwards.”
“No, Husband.”
Lu Wan, however, shook her head.
“I will send him the coordinates right now.”
“With me here, he will definitely not dare to make any more excessive demands.”
Gu Le at the side also nodded.
“That’s right.”
“Although this Lu Mingshi is several hundred years older than us, if we really calculate by seniority, he probably has to be counted down to our great-great-grandchildren’s generation.”
“Coupled with Aunt Yanran’s face, he shouldn’t dare to ask for an exorbitant price.”
Speaking up to here, Gu Le’s gaze grew slightly cold.
“As for the Divine Kingdom contract.”
“If there are truly any excessive restrictions in it, we might as well resolve them together today.”
Although she didn’t have Lu Wan’s love-brained tendencies.
But since Yang Fan was the husband she had acknowledged, their interests were already firmly bound together long ago.
She would never watch idly as Yang Fan’s fundamental interests suffered damage.
Listening to the two women’s words, Yang Fan felt as if the cold sweat on his forehead was about to stream down.
Yet for the moment, he couldn’t find a suitable reason to stop them.
“Really, there’s no need.”
“He and I... actually have a pretty good relationship.”
Yang Fan said while wiping the cold sweat from his forehead.
“Husband doesn’t need to worry.”
Lu Wan, however, didn’t notice his guilty conscience at all.
“I’ve already sent the coordinates over.”
“His parents are still shareholders in several large companies under my name; if this person really doesn’t know what’s good for him...”
Lu Wan’s gaze gradually turned icy.
“It’s over...” Yang Fan walked silently to the side and sat down, feeling completely dead inside.
The sky has fallen.
His persona... was about to collapse!
He had even started thinking about what excuse he should find to explain later.
“Lu Mingshi, you better watch your words.”
“Otherwise...”
A trace of fierce light flashed across the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Your Divine Kingdom Core, I’m claiming it.”
Soon, a consciousness projection descended upon this private space.
The newcomer was none other than Lu Mingshi.
As a Tier 3 God, at this moment he completely restrained all his aura.
Not only that, but his face also wore an almost ingratiating smile.
The moment he appeared, he shouted towards Lu Wan: “Cousin!”
Lu Wan’s expression, however, was extremely calm.
She raised her eyes to look at Lu Mingshi.
“Judging by seniority, isn’t your form of address wrong?”

chapters.title: Chapter 471: Not a Single Simple One
paragraphs: Lu Mingshi instantly froze, completely dumbfounded.
Gods have long lifespans, and if one were to truly trace bloodlines and generations, it would have long ago become a complete mess.
Therefore, when Clan members met on usual days, they basically addressed each other according to age.
Whenever Lu Mingshi saw Lu Wan in the past, he had always addressed her like that.
Why was Lu Wan’s tone suddenly so cold today...?
What did he do?
“Speak, what business do you have with my husband?” Lu Wan’s tone was calm.
As she spoke, she directly grabbed Yang Fan’s right hand and took a slight step back.
Her entire body stood by Yang Fan’s side.
That posture clearly placed Yang Fan in an absolute core position.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s heart skipped a beat.
He sat up straight with a solemn expression.
When looking at Lu Mingshi, he even subconsciously swallowed a mouthful of saliva, feeling somewhat guilty.
Just as Yang Fan opened his mouth, his mind was still frantically thinking about how to use linguistic art to make up for it.
The next second.
“Brother!”
“Thud!”
Lu Mingshi suddenly rushed over in a single bound.
Following closely behind, his entire person directly slid and knelt forward, his body skimming against the ground and sliding a full four to five meters.
Afterwards, he grabbed hold of Yang Fan’s thigh.
“It is really so hard for Xiaoshi to see you once!”
“Wuwuwu...”
Lu Mingshi was a mess of snot and tears, crying so miserably.
That appearance looked extremely like someone who had finally found his long-lost biological father.
The air instantly fell silent.
Lu Wan: “...”
Gu Le: “...”
Yang Fan: “???”
Looking at Lu Mingshi, who was hugging his thigh and crying heart-rendingly in front of him, Yang Fan somewhat doubted his life.
This person... who is he?
When did he get such an unacquainted younger brother?
What is the situation?
Clearly, this was his first time meeting him, right?
“Husband, I didn’t expect your relationship to be so good!”
Watching this scene, the corner of Lu Wan’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
Amidst her shock, Lu Wan always felt that the scene before her exuded strangeness everywhere.
You must know that Yang Fan and them were of similar age, and now he was only in his twenties.
Yet Lu Mingshi had already graduated from the Primordial Academy for hundreds of years, and was even a notoriously reclusive “stay-at-home” in the Clan.
No matter how one looked at it, the life trajectories of the two of them should not have had any intersection.
But what about now?
A Tier 3 God was actually calling his twenty-something-year-old husband “Brother” left and right, and even putting on an appearance as if he couldn’t wait to pour out his heart and lungs.
Just when did these two people get to know each other?
And... isn’t their relationship a bit too good?
Gu Le at the side looked at Lu Mingshi with equally complex eyes.
At this moment, she discovered that she seemed to have underestimated Yang Fan.
Her own man not only possessed terrifying personal potential, but his hidden connections and network of relationships also far exceeded her imagination.
“Brother, what do we do now?”
Lu Mingshi looked up at Yang Fan, his eyes full of expectation.
“Shall we continue to reinforce troops and directly wipe out that Ma Huainan?”
“As long as Brother says a word, I will immediately exhaust all the power of my Divine Kingdom and completely resolve him!”
That appearance was completely that of a loyal lackey waiting for his master’s order.
Watching this scene, Yang Fan’s facial skin couldn’t help but twitch.
“Is that your believer?”
“Who are you?”
Yang Fan complained wildly in his heart.
Clearly, today was his first time meeting the other party, and before this, they hadn’t even coordinated a single word.
As a result, not only did the other party unhesitatingly take the blame and put it on him, but he even acted so naturally.
This acting skill... simply reached the pinnacle!
Yang Fan took a deep breath, then looked at Lu Wan and Gu Le.
“You two leave first.”
“Leave this place to me to handle.”
Looking at Yang Fan’s serious and solemn expression, the two women looked at each other.
Although there were still doubts in their hearts, they ultimately chose to believe him.
“Alright.”
As the two left, the Virtual World restored its quietness once again.
Only then did Yang Fan look at Lu Mingshi, who was still kneeling on the ground, “Fellow Daoist Lu, please sit.”
“Alright, Brother Yang.”
Lu Mingshi hurriedly got up, then used his sleeve to wipe the snot and tears from his face, sitting down opposite Yang Fan with slight embarrassment.
Looking at his appearance, Yang Fan was silent for a moment before saying, “Fellow Daoist Lu, we should... not know each other, right?”
Lu Mingshi’s expression stiffened, and then he gave a bitter smile.
“Brother Yang, I really have no other way.”
“My Divine Kingdom’s foundation has already been exposed in the eyes of the Five Great Families, and the most crucial thing is...”
A look of sorrow appeared on Lu Mingshi’s face.
“After my mother saw that there were so many war buildings inside my Divine Kingdom, she directly cut off my living expenses!”
“I am truly driven to a desperate strait now!”
Having said that, Lu Mingshi let out a long sigh.
“This younger brother has no other methods, and only hopes that Brother Yang can take me in and let me seek a job at the Yang Corporation.”
At this moment, Lu Mingshi looked at Yang Fan with a face full of anticipation.
In those eyes, there even seeped a trace of clear foolishness.
Looking at him, Yang Fan didn’t know what to say for a moment.
After a moment, he couldn’t help raising his eyebrows, “What is your expected salary?”
Hearing this, Lu Mingshi’s eyes instantly lit up.
“Fifty thousand Divinity Points a month, and I will already be very satisfied!”
Yang Fan shook his head and said, “Five hundred thousand. From now on, you will be a special consultant of the Yang Corporation.”
“However, this time’s matter...”
Saying this, his voice paused slightly, and his gaze landed on Lu Mingshi.
Lu Mingshi instantly understood his meaning and hurriedly waved his hand.
“Brother Yang, rest assured!”
“Unless I actively open my Divine Kingdom’s coordinates and let others enter to investigate.”
“Otherwise, in the eyes of outsiders, I am the biggest suspect.”
“After all, throughout the entire Human Federation, there are simply too few gods who truly walk the path of a Corpse Cultivator.”
As he spoke, Lu Mingshi transmitted his communication account to Yang Fan.
“This is my Feixun account.”
“I am currently living in the Lu Clan grounds. If there is anything, Brother Yang, feel free to give orders at any time.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Alright.”
Finally, Lu Mingshi did not say anything more.
His figure gradually turned illusory, and his consciousness subsequently exited the Virtual World.
Leaving only Yang Fan alone, standing by himself within this silent space.
Yang Fan looked at the spot where Lu Mingshi had just been, his gaze gradually turning solemn.
“Not a single one of these gods from the great families is simple.”
Matters of the Divine Kingdom world were inherently difficult to clarify.
It was simply impossible for Lu Mingshi to open his Divine Kingdom’s coordinates and let others enter his Divine Kingdom to investigate.
Therefore, he simply changed his approach.
Since it could not be clearly investigated, he would simply swallow this black pot and then demand compensation from Yang Fan.
As for these surface-level matters, Yang Fan did not care at all.
Mere five hundred thousand Divinity Points a month was simply nothing to him nowadays.
What truly concerned Yang Fan was Lu Mingshi himself.
The contact just now had truly opened his eyes.
On the surface, this man looked silly and cute, one could even say shameless and completely without bottom lines, and his speech and actions were also in a reckless manner.
Yet in reality, he was extremely adept at observing facial expressions and reading the room.
Knowing what words to say at what time, the sense of propriety was grasped just right.
What was more important was that even with his currently powerful Mental Strength, he still couldn’t tell what the other party was actually thinking from Lu Mingshi’s performance.
This kind of person could never be just a stay-at-home, mama’s boy in the eyes of outsiders.
“This person has a huge secret!”
“Moreover, his strength is definitely not weak.”
Yang Fan inwardly guarded against him.

sentences.text: Lu Mingshi instantly froze, completely dumbfounded.
Gods have long lifespans, and if one were to truly trace bloodlines and generations, it would have long ago become a complete mess.
Therefore, when Clan members met on usual days, they basically addressed each other according to age.
Whenever Lu Mingshi saw Lu Wan in the past, he had always addressed her like that.
Why was Lu Wan’s tone suddenly so cold today...?
What did he do?
“Speak, what business do you have with my husband?” Lu Wan’s tone was calm.
As she spoke, she directly grabbed Yang Fan’s right hand and took a slight step back.
Her entire body stood by Yang Fan’s side.
That posture clearly placed Yang Fan in an absolute core position.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s heart skipped a beat.
He sat up straight with a solemn expression.
When looking at Lu Mingshi, he even subconsciously swallowed a mouthful of saliva, feeling somewhat guilty.
Just as Yang Fan opened his mouth, his mind was still frantically thinking about how to use linguistic art to make up for it.
The next second.
“Brother!”
“Thud!”
Lu Mingshi suddenly rushed over in a single bound.
Following closely behind, his entire person directly slid and knelt forward, his body skimming against the ground and sliding a full four to five meters.
Afterwards, he grabbed hold of Yang Fan’s thigh.
“It is really so hard for Xiaoshi to see you once!”
“Wuwuwu...”
Lu Mingshi was a mess of snot and tears, crying so miserably.
That appearance looked extremely like someone who had finally found his long-lost biological father.
The air instantly fell silent.
Lu Wan: “...”
Gu Le: “...”
Yang Fan: “???”
Looking at Lu Mingshi, who was hugging his thigh and crying heart-rendingly in front of him, Yang Fan somewhat doubted his life.
This person... who is he?
When did he get such an unacquainted younger brother?
What is the situation?
Clearly, this was his first time meeting him, right?
“Husband, I didn’t expect your relationship to be so good!”
Watching this scene, the corner of Lu Wan’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
Amidst her shock, Lu Wan always felt that the scene before her exuded strangeness everywhere.
You must know that Yang Fan and them were of similar age, and now he was only in his twenties.
Yet Lu Mingshi had already graduated from the Primordial Academy for hundreds of years, and was even a notoriously reclusive “stay-at-home” in the Clan.
No matter how one looked at it, the life trajectories of the two of them should not have had any intersection.
But what about now?
A Tier 3 God was actually calling his twenty-something-year-old husband “Brother” left and right, and even putting on an appearance as if he couldn’t wait to pour out his heart and lungs.
Just when did these two people get to know each other?
And... isn’t their relationship a bit too good?
Gu Le at the side looked at Lu Mingshi with equally complex eyes.
At this moment, she discovered that she seemed to have underestimated Yang Fan.
Her own man not only possessed terrifying personal potential, but his hidden connections and network of relationships also far exceeded her imagination.
“Brother, what do we do now?”
Lu Mingshi looked up at Yang Fan, his eyes full of expectation.
“Shall we continue to reinforce troops and directly wipe out that Ma Huainan?”
“As long as Brother says a word, I will immediately exhaust all the power of my Divine Kingdom and completely resolve him!”
That appearance was completely that of a loyal lackey waiting for his master’s order.
Watching this scene, Yang Fan’s facial skin couldn’t help but twitch.
“Is that your believer?”
“Who are you?”
Yang Fan complained wildly in his heart.
Clearly, today was his first time meeting the other party, and before this, they hadn’t even coordinated a single word.
As a result, not only did the other party unhesitatingly take the blame and put it on him, but he even acted so naturally.
This acting skill... simply reached the pinnacle!
Yang Fan took a deep breath, then looked at Lu Wan and Gu Le.
“You two leave first.”
“Leave this place to me to handle.”
Looking at Yang Fan’s serious and solemn expression, the two women looked at each other.
Although there were still doubts in their hearts, they ultimately chose to believe him.
“Alright.”
As the two left, the Virtual World restored its quietness once again.
Only then did Yang Fan look at Lu Mingshi, who was still kneeling on the ground, “Fellow Daoist Lu, please sit.”
“Alright, Brother Yang.”
Lu Mingshi hurriedly got up, then used his sleeve to wipe the snot and tears from his face, sitting down opposite Yang Fan with slight embarrassment.
Looking at his appearance, Yang Fan was silent for a moment before saying, “Fellow Daoist Lu, we should... not know each other, right?”
Lu Mingshi’s expression stiffened, and then he gave a bitter smile.
“Brother Yang, I really have no other way.”
“My Divine Kingdom’s foundation has already been exposed in the eyes of the Five Great Families, and the most crucial thing is...”
A look of sorrow appeared on Lu Mingshi’s face.
“After my mother saw that there were so many war buildings inside my Divine Kingdom, she directly cut off my living expenses!”
“I am truly driven to a desperate strait now!”
Having said that, Lu Mingshi let out a long sigh.
“This younger brother has no other methods, and only hopes that Brother Yang can take me in and let me seek a job at the Yang Corporation.”
At this moment, Lu Mingshi looked at Yang Fan with a face full of anticipation.
In those eyes, there even seeped a trace of clear foolishness.
Looking at him, Yang Fan didn’t know what to say for a moment.
After a moment, he couldn’t help raising his eyebrows, “What is your expected salary?”
Hearing this, Lu Mingshi’s eyes instantly lit up.
“Fifty thousand Divinity Points a month, and I will already be very satisfied!”
Yang Fan shook his head and said, “Five hundred thousand.
From now on, you will be a special consultant of the Yang Corporation.”
“However, this time’s matter...”
Saying this, his voice paused slightly, and his gaze landed on Lu Mingshi.
Lu Mingshi instantly understood his meaning and hurriedly waved his hand.
“Brother Yang, rest assured!”
“Unless I actively open my Divine Kingdom’s coordinates and let others enter to investigate.”
“Otherwise, in the eyes of outsiders, I am the biggest suspect.”
“After all, throughout the entire Human Federation, there are simply too few gods who truly walk the path of a Corpse Cultivator.”
As he spoke, Lu Mingshi transmitted his communication account to Yang Fan.
“This is my Feixun account.”
“I am currently living in the Lu Clan grounds.
If there is anything, Brother Yang, feel free to give orders at any time.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Alright.”
Finally, Lu Mingshi did not say anything more.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: Nothing Much
paragraphs: In the Real World, within the Lu Clan estate.
Inside the room, Lu Mingshi, who had previously kept his eyes tightly closed, slowly opened them.
A faint smile involuntarily curled at the corner of his lips.
“500,000 Divinity Points a month...”
“This son-in-law really spends lavishly.”
Lu Mingshi murmured to himself, his face completely devoid of its previous flippant expression.
Right at that moment, the prompt tone of the intelligent lifeform came from the walls of the room.
“Master, the investigation into Yang Fan has not yielded any more valuable information, and there are likewise no clues regarding the Corpse Cultivator deity behind Yang Fan.”
“Got it.”
Lu Mingshi’s expression was calm as he directly waved his hand.
“There’s no need to continue investigating.”
“500,000 Divinity Points a month—carrying this undeserved blame is well worth the value.”
Speaking up to this point, the smile on his face gradually faded, and his expression turned solemn.
“However, based on what I saw today, this Yang Fan doesn’t seem as simple as the records say.”
“His Mental Strength is even comparable to a Mid-tier God.”
“For a figure like this, it’s best not to offend him if we can avoid it.”
“Understood, Master.”
The intelligent lifeform acknowledged, then completely fell silent.
After returning to the Real World, Yang Fan took off the Virtual Helmet.
Looking at the empty room around him, his tense body finally relaxed a little.
Entering the Virtual World this time, his persona almost collapsed.
Fortunately, he managed to bluff his way through in the end.
Although Yang Fan no longer needed to rely on his wife to leech off Divine Kingdom Resources, the connections of the Lu Clan and Gu Family still played a significant role for him.
Therefore, he still had to carefully maintain his relationship with these two wives.
Right at that moment, the door was gently pushed open.
Lu Wan walked in carrying a plate of iced Spirit Fruit.
Seeing that Yang Fan had already taken off the Virtual Helmet, she hurriedly placed the fruit platter on a nearby table and walked over.
“Husband, do you really not need my help?”
Lu Wan asked gently, her eyes filled with concern.
“Wan’er, this is your man’s own business, just leave it to me.”
Yang Fan smiled, reached out to pull her into his arms, and gently tapped her nose.
“I couldn’t bear to watch you tire yourself out because of my affairs.”
Hearing this, a sweet smile immediately blossomed on Lu Wan’s face.
However, she was still somewhat worried and instructed in a soft voice:
“But Husband, you mustn’t push yourself too hard.”
“If you really encounter trouble you can’t solve, you must tell me.”
“Got it.”
Yang Fan nodded with a smile.
“Let me lie down for a while longer.”
Finished speaking, he reclined back onto the lounge chair, looking lazy and languid.
Seeing this, Lu Wan did not disturb him further.
She walked out of the room on tiptoe and closed the door behind her.
After coming outside, Lu Wan took out the Feixun and sent a message to Gu Le.
“Since Husband is almost solving it himself, I’ll return these funds to you.”
After sending the message, Lu Wan also gave a long stretch.
Afterwards, she directly issued a new command through the intelligent lifeform.
[Pause the deduction of Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom coordinates and all subsequent matters regarding launching a Divine Kingdom War.]
After finishing all this, Lu Wan only felt her entire body become much lighter.
For some time now, her mental state had actually been under high tension.
After all, the target of her actions this time was a Peerless Prodigy.
Under the authority protection of the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, making a move against such a figure was in itself an extremely dangerous matter.
Even she did not dare to be careless in the slightest.
If handled poorly, it might even implicate all the companies under her name, ultimately leading to sanctions by the Federal Government.
By that time, even if her mother Lu Yanran stepped forward, it might not necessarily be resolvable.
“As expected of my husband...”
Lu Wan muttered softly, a relaxed smile blooming on her face.
Gu Le felt the suddenly surging Divinity Points in her Divine Kingdom, and she was stunned for a moment.
Afterwards, a smile gradually appeared on her face.
The next moment, Gu Le directly picked up Gu Chengye from the side.
Looking at the jade-carved, doll-like son in her arms, she couldn’t help smiling and saying:
“Chengye, your daddy is even more outstanding than mommy imagined.”
“When mommy graduates, let’s go find daddy together at the frontline, okay?”
Speaking up to this point, Gu Le paused, then showed a worried expression.
“Otherwise, your daddy is going to be snatched away by your cousin.”
Although Gu Chengye was still young, upon hearing mommy’s words, he still blinked his eyes with a half-understanding look.
Seeing this scene, Gu Le couldn’t help chuckling softly.
Days passed by one by one.
During this period of time, Yang Fan would set aside a fixed amount of time every day to descend into his Divine Kingdom and monitor the situation on the battlefield at the frontline.
Both sides came and went, and the war still had not ended.
Inside Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom, the losses of believers on both sides reached nearly ten billion every year.
However, for Yang Fan, such consumption counted for nothing at all.
Possessing a hundredfold time flow rate, countless zombies were being continuously born within the Eternal Corpse Mine.
A large number of military forces were continuously transported to the frontline, stably maintaining a scale of hundreds of billions of believers.
At the same time, corpse pills, Talismans, Medicinal Pills, micro-nuclear bombs, and various other wartime Resources were shipped to the battlefield like flowing water.
On the other side, the Sima Family deities who came to support Ma Huainan were likewise not idle.
They continuously mobilized believers from their own Divine Kingdoms to replenish this battlefield.
Not only that, aside from relying on the power of Formations and Smart Weapons, these deities of the Sima Family also invested a large amount of disposable wartime Resources.
Various divine art scrolls, special weapons, consumable buildings...
All Resources that could increase the winning rate of the war were continuously poured into it.
The entire battlefield had long since completely turned into a giant meat grinder.
What the two sides were fighting over was no longer whose strength was greater, but who could withstand the more terrifying consumption.
What they fought over was the sacrifice of believers and the investment of Resources.
Only ten days had passed in the Real World, but this war had already lasted for nearly ten years.
After exiting the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes, a trace of a smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
“Nothing much.”
“With the war fought up to now, the consumption of disposable wartime Resources doesn’t even reach a million trillion Divinity Points.”
“It doesn’t even match what I earn in a month.”
A trace of calm flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.
“I’d like to see precisely who fails to hold out first.”
Possessing the Evolution Talent, what Yang Fan feared least was a war of attrition.
Whether it was troop replenishment or the input of wartime Resources, as long as time dragged on, his advantage would only grow larger and larger.
Right now, within his own Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan had long since specially built several large arsenals.
Stored inside were a large number of disposable wartime Resources, ready to be thrown into the battlefield at any time.
Moreover, the current consumption rate of this war couldn’t even compare to the speed of his resource procurement.
Let alone that before the war began, he had already prepared five to six hundred trillion Divinity Points worth of wartime Resources in advance.
At least for Yang Fan right now, there was no pressure whatsoever.

chapters.title: Chapter 473: Resource Competition
paragraphs: Yang Fan stood up, pushed open the door, and slowly walked over to the dining table.
At this moment, the intelligent robot also happened to walk out of the kitchen, serving plates of fresh spiritual fish slices.
“Husband, there is good news.”
Lu Wan walked over quickly, holding an electronic tablet in her hand.
“What good news?”
Yang Fan looked at Lu Wan curiously.
“The Divine Kingdom War video between Ma Huainan and Lu Mingshi has already spread among the Five Great Families.”
“Right now, not many low-tier gods from the Sima Family are willing to continue going to support them.”
“And those who have already joined the battle are also starting to get cold feet.”
“Some gods are already applying for Clan subsidy quotas, otherwise they are prepared to withdraw from the war.”
As Lu Wan spoke, she handed the electronic tablet in her hand to Yang Fan.
After taking it, Yang Fan’s gaze quickly swept over the information on it.
The news that Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had been invaded had long since spread throughout the Five Great Families.
After all, this war involved too many gods.
Regardless of the scale of the war or the resources invested by both sides, it had already become the focus of internal attention within the Five Great Families.
And relying on her own connections, Lu Wan could naturally easily understand the Sima Family’s current true attitude.
During this period of time, Yang Fan would obtain the latest situation of the Sima Family from Lu Wan every day.
Know yourself and your enemy, and you will never be defeated.
Yang Fan was very clear that although he possessed formidable strength, if the Sima Family truly protected Ma Huainan at all costs, it would be utterly impossible for him to win.
However, unfortunately, a large Clan was not a place dictated by a single individual.
Especially reaching the level of gods, what everyone considered ultimately still boiled down to interests.
Even a High-Order God could not forcibly command low-tier gods to invade or protect a certain person’s divine kingdom without paying any price at all.
All of this was because of the restrictions imposed by the rules of the divine kingdom.
The believers of High-Order Gods could not invade the divine kingdoms of low-tier gods.
Therefore, looking across the entire Human race,
low-tier gods would revere High-Order Gods, but they would never be utterly loyal purely out of fear.
Whether it was a corporation, a large faction, or a Clan, essentially they were all a community of shared interests.
Through methods like taxation, business, and equity, everyone worked together to make the pie bigger.
In the end, High-Order Gods took away more benefits, while low-tier gods obtained corresponding resources.
Relying on this method, the entire system could operate stably for a long time.
Therefore, what Yang Fan truly needed to do was never to defeat the entire Sima Family.
But rather to make those gods who came to support feel the pain of war losses.
To make them feel that continuing to persist was no longer worth it.
When that time came, they would naturally choose to retreat.

Looking at the internal chat screenshots of the Sima Family on the electronic tablet, as well as the headline reports on various news media, a trace of a smile couldn’t help but curl the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“It seems things are going very smoothly,” Yang Fan said calmly.
“Husband, does Lu Mingshi still need war supplies over there?”
Lu Wan couldn’t help but speak up:
“During this period, I procured quite a bit of war resources through the company, and I can transfer them to him free of charge.”
Over this period, Lu Wan had also watched quite a few Divine Kingdom War videos leaked by the Sima Family.
Even with her current net worth, seeing the consumption within them couldn’t help but make her heart skip a beat.
Only about ten days had passed in the real world.
The war resources invested by both sides into the battlefield had already exceeded one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Coupled with the continuous demise of high-tier believers, the resources truly consumed by both sides probably already exceeded three hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Such terrifying consumption was almost catching up to the value of an undeveloped Earth-grade Secret Realm.
In Lu Wan’s view, the strategy Lu Mingshi was currently adopting was to completely gamble everything and crush the opponent at the fastest speed.
This was a fighting style that pushed the divine kingdom’s daily war investment to the limit.
The resources invested by both sides could be called massive, and no one knew how much longer the opponent’s resources could hold out.
This kind of war was essentially no longer just a collision of strength.
It was even more of a psychological game.
Whoever felt they couldn’t hold on first would be the first to yield.
Precisely because of this, Lu Wan wanted to directly hand over the large amount of war supplies acquired by the company previously to Lu Mingshi to help him relieve pressure.
“Wan’er, you don’t need to worry about this matter.”
Yang Fan smiled and shook his head.
“We are very well prepared.”
Yang Fan had indeed pushed the the frontline war investment to the limit.
On the battlefield now, even the most ordinary zombies were equipped with a corpse pill and covered in detonating talismans.
As long as they were believers participating in the war, all kinds of war supplies would be fully equipped.
Mainly featuring a desperate attitude that cared about neither lives nor money.
But the reason why Yang Fan did this was not to end this war as soon as possible.
But rather because... the consumption speed of the war was simply too slow for him.
So slow that it couldn’t keep up with his resource procurement speed at all.
For Yang Fan right now, war resources were the thing he lacked the least.
Even if these gods of the Sima Family continued to persist in the real world for a year, or even longer,
he would accompany them to the very end.
For him, who possessed the Evolution Talent, the longer time was dragged out, the more obvious his advantage would become.
Looking at Yang Fan’s confident expression, Lu Wan’s heart also relaxed slightly.
But the next moment, as if she suddenly thought of something, her gaze changed slightly.
“Husband, do you... lack Divinity Points?”
Lu Wan asked suddenly while eating her meal.
Hearing these words, Yang Fan instantly became alert in his heart, but his face didn’t show the slightest change.
“It’s alright. This war mainly relies on Lu Mingshi; after all, this is his foundation accumulated over hundreds of years.”
“I’m afraid I’m going to owe him a huge favor.”
Yang Fan said in a calm tone.
“Is that so.”
Lu Wan nodded, a smile returning to her face.
“Husband, rest assured, our Clan will not forget this kindness.”
As she spoke, she picked up a piece of fish slice and placed it into Yang Fan’s bowl.
“Eat slowly, Husband, I have a meeting to attend.”
Having said that, Lu Wan stood up and walked upstairs.
Watching her retreating figure, Yang Fan finally let out a soft sigh of relief.

If Lu Wan were to find out... that back then he rejected that one hundred trillion Divinity Points of dowry, not because of some bullshit love and responsibility, but purely because he simply didn’t lack money at all,
this submissive wife of his probably wouldn’t be so easy to fool anymore.
Arriving on the second floor, Lu Wan pushed open the office door and then closed it behind her.
She sat down in front of the desk and gently snapped her fingers.
The next moment, a light blue light screen emerged out of thin air, hovering directly in front of her.
“Master, these are all the capital cash flows and various resource transfer records of the Yang Corporation during this period of time.”
The voice of the intelligent lifeform resounded directly in Lu Wan’s mind.
Looking at the various data on the light screen, Lu Wan’s brows gradually knitted together.
“War supplies worth nearly one hundred trillion Divinity Points were procured some time ago, why are there no capital expenditure records?” Lu Wan asked.
(That’s a Wrap!)
