sentences.text: Yang Fan stood up, pushed open the door, and slowly walked over to the dining table.
At this moment, the intelligent robot also happened to walk out of the kitchen, serving plates of fresh spiritual fish slices.
“Husband, there is good news.”
Lu Wan walked over quickly, holding an electronic tablet in her hand.
“What good news?”
Yang Fan looked at Lu Wan curiously.
“The Divine Kingdom War video between Ma Huainan and Lu Mingshi has already spread among the Five Great Families.”
“Right now, not many low-tier gods from the Sima Family are willing to continue going to support them.”
“And those who have already joined the battle are also starting to get cold feet.”
“Some gods are already applying for Clan subsidy quotas, otherwise they are prepared to withdraw from the war.”
As Lu Wan spoke, she handed the electronic tablet in her hand to Yang Fan.
After taking it, Yang Fan’s gaze quickly swept over the information on it.
The news that Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had been invaded had long since spread throughout the Five Great Families.
After all, this war involved too many gods.
Regardless of the scale of the war or the resources invested by both sides, it had already become the focus of internal attention within the Five Great Families.
And relying on her own connections, Lu Wan could naturally easily understand the Sima Family’s current true attitude.
During this period of time, Yang Fan would obtain the latest situation of the Sima Family from Lu Wan every day.
Know yourself and your enemy, and you will never be defeated.
Yang Fan was very clear that although he possessed formidable strength, if the Sima Family truly protected Ma Huainan at all costs, it would be utterly impossible for him to win.
However, unfortunately, a large Clan was not a place dictated by a single individual.
Especially reaching the level of gods, what everyone considered ultimately still boiled down to interests.
Even a High-Order God could not forcibly command low-tier gods to invade or protect a certain person’s divine kingdom without paying any price at all.
All of this was because of the restrictions imposed by the rules of the divine kingdom.
The believers of High-Order Gods could not invade the divine kingdoms of low-tier gods.
Therefore, looking across the entire Human race,
low-tier gods would revere High-Order Gods, but they would never be utterly loyal purely out of fear.
Whether it was a corporation, a large faction, or a Clan, essentially they were all a community of shared interests.
Through methods like taxation, business, and equity, everyone worked together to make the pie bigger.
In the end, High-Order Gods took away more benefits, while low-tier gods obtained corresponding resources.
Relying on this method, the entire system could operate stably for a long time.
Therefore, what Yang Fan truly needed to do was never to defeat the entire Sima Family.
But rather to make those gods who came to support feel the pain of war losses.
To make them feel that continuing to persist was no longer worth it.
When that time came, they would naturally choose to retreat.

Looking at the internal chat screenshots of the Sima Family on the electronic tablet, as well as the headline reports on various news media, a trace of a smile couldn’t help but curl the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“It seems things are going very smoothly,” Yang Fan said calmly.
“Husband, does Lu Mingshi still need war supplies over there?”
Lu Wan couldn’t help but speak up:
“During this period, I procured quite a bit of war resources through the company, and I can transfer them to him free of charge.”
Over this period, Lu Wan had also watched quite a few Divine Kingdom War videos leaked by the Sima Family.
Even with her current net worth, seeing the consumption within them couldn’t help but make her heart skip a beat.
Only about ten days had passed in the real world.
The war resources invested by both sides into the battlefield had already exceeded one hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Coupled with the continuous demise of high-tier believers, the resources truly consumed by both sides probably already exceeded three hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Such terrifying consumption was almost catching up to the value of an undeveloped Earth-grade Secret Realm.
In Lu Wan’s view, the strategy Lu Mingshi was currently adopting was to completely gamble everything and crush the opponent at the fastest speed.
This was a fighting style that pushed the divine kingdom’s daily war investment to the limit.
The resources invested by both sides could be called massive, and no one knew how much longer the opponent’s resources could hold out.
This kind of war was essentially no longer just a collision of strength.
It was even more of a psychological game.
Whoever felt they couldn’t hold on first would be the first to yield.
Precisely because of this, Lu Wan wanted to directly hand over the large amount of war supplies acquired by the company previously to Lu Mingshi to help him relieve pressure.
“Wan’er, you don’t need to worry about this matter.”
Yang Fan smiled and shook his head.
“We are very well prepared.”
Yang Fan had indeed pushed the the frontline war investment to the limit.
On the battlefield now, even the most ordinary zombies were equipped with a corpse pill and covered in detonating talismans.
As long as they were believers participating in the war, all kinds of war supplies would be fully equipped.
Mainly featuring a desperate attitude that cared about neither lives nor money.
But the reason why Yang Fan did this was not to end this war as soon as possible.
But rather because... the consumption speed of the war was simply too slow for him.
So slow that it couldn’t keep up with his resource procurement speed at all.
For Yang Fan right now, war resources were the thing he lacked the least.
Even if these gods of the Sima Family continued to persist in the real world for a year, or even longer,
he would accompany them to the very end.
For him, who possessed the Evolution Talent, the longer time was dragged out, the more obvious his advantage would become.
Looking at Yang Fan’s confident expression, Lu Wan’s heart also relaxed slightly.
But the next moment, as if she suddenly thought of something, her gaze changed slightly.
“Husband, do you... lack Divinity Points?”
Lu Wan asked suddenly while eating her meal.
Hearing these words, Yang Fan instantly became alert in his heart, but his face didn’t show the slightest change.
“It’s alright.
This war mainly relies on Lu Mingshi; after all, this is his foundation accumulated over hundreds of years.”
“I’m afraid I’m going to owe him a huge favor.”
Yang Fan said in a calm tone.
“Is that so.”
Lu Wan nodded, a smile returning to her face.
“Husband, rest assured, our Clan will not forget this kindness.”
As she spoke, she picked up a piece of fish slice and placed it into Yang Fan’s bowl.
“Eat slowly, Husband, I have a meeting to attend.”
Having said that, Lu Wan stood up and walked upstairs.
Watching her retreating figure, Yang Fan finally let out a soft sigh of relief.

If Lu Wan were to find out... that back then he rejected that one hundred trillion Divinity Points of dowry, not because of some bullshit love and responsibility, but purely because he simply didn’t lack money at all,
this submissive wife of his probably wouldn’t be so easy to fool anymore.
Arriving on the second floor, Lu Wan pushed open the office door and then closed it behind her.
She sat down in front of the desk and gently snapped her fingers.
The next moment, a light blue light screen emerged out of thin air, hovering directly in front of her.
“Master, these are all the capital cash flows and various resource transfer records of the Yang Corporation during this period of time.”
The voice of the intelligent lifeform resounded directly in Lu Wan’s mind.
Looking at the various data on the light screen, Lu Wan’s brows gradually knitted together.
“War supplies worth nearly one hundred trillion Divinity Points were procured some time ago, why are there no capital expenditure records?” Lu Wan asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 474: So Husband Has Been Working So Hard All Along
paragraphs: “Reporting to Master, these funds did not go through Yang Corporation’s public account.”
“Instead, the payment was directly completed by General Manager Ma’s Divine Kingdom.”
“However, these wartime supplies were registered by the Corporation’s Supplies Department.”
intelligent lifeform replied quickly.
Hearing this, Lu Wan couldn’t help chuckling and shaking her head.
“Husband really is a scatterbrain.”
“Knowing full well that he is currently a key target of investigation by Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, he actually left behind such obvious traces.”
“Immediately erase all remaining records of these wartime supplies.”
“We cannot leave anyone with any leverage.”
“Understood, Master.”
At this moment, Lu Wan cast her gaze toward Yang Corporation’s current asset situation.
After just a few glances, her brows involuntarily knitted together, and a trace of surprise flashed through her eyes.
“Why are there so many Spirit Stone, Earth Core Spirit Milk, and Enlightenment Tea?”
Lu Wan asked doubtfully.
The next moment, she continued to check the specific quantities of these assets.
Soon, she discovered that the total value of these resource inventories actually reached as high as three trillion Divinity Points!
Such a massive sum of fixed assets piled up like this in the warehouse was an extremely serious waste for any large company.
After all, these Resources were not Divine Kingdom buildings.
Divine Kingdom buildings could continuously output Resources, belonging to fixed assets that could create long-term value.
But things like Spirit Stone, Earth Core Spirit Milk, and Enlightenment Tea essentially belonged to consumable Resources.
Piling them in the warehouse meant that millions of trillions of Divinity Points in funds were completely tied up, unable to play any role.
“Smack!”
Lu Wan slammed her palm onto the desk.
“What is Ma Yu good for?”
“Husband handed the entire Yang Corporation over to him to manage, and this is how he manages it?”
“This is even worse than me casually dispatching an intelligent lifeform over to act as a professional manager!”
The more Lu Wan spoke, the angrier she became.
“Master, the reason why such a massive inventory appeared is mainly because Yang Corporation’s current sales channels are relatively weak.”
The intelligent lifeform hurriedly explained.

“These assets all belong to high-value products, and General Manager Ma is unwilling to sell them at a low price. Coupled with the corporation purchasing too many Resources recently, a large amount of goods has gradually accumulated in the warehouse.”
“Purchasing?”
Lu Wan’s brows furrowed.
“Where on earth did all these Earth Core Spirit Milk come from?”
“the frontline.” The intelligent lifeform answered calmly.
Lu Wan’s body suddenly stiffened.
“Husband? These are all Husband’s...”
Her eyes were instantly filled with shock.
Just at this moment, the light-blue light curtain in front of her changed again.
Item after item of data quickly presented itself.
Soon, two different quotes appeared for the market prices of Spirit Stone, Earth Core Spirit Milk, and Enlightenment Tea leaves respectively.

“Reporting to Master, based on estimations, purchasing Earth Core Spirit Milk and Enlightenment Tea leaves from participating deities on the frontline and selling them through Yang Corporation’s existing channels indeed leaves a certain margin for profit.”
The intelligent lifeform quickly analyzed.
“Synthesizing logistics costs and the time cost of capital occupation, the profit margin of a single circulation is about five percent.”
“As for Spirit Stone, there is currently almost no arbitrage space.”
“It is deduced that when Chairman Yang originally purchased these Resources in large quantities, this was a bundled sales condition proposed by the other party.”
“If leverage is increased through methods like financing loans, the returns will be very considerable.”
“However, this move has extremely high requirements for working capital. Once market fluctuations occur or goods are delayed, the financial security risk is extremely huge.”
Pausing for a moment, the intelligent lifeform continued:
“Based on estimations from currently grasped circumstances, Chairman Yang is probably in a state of relatively tight funds all along, Master...”
Before it finished speaking, the intelligent lifeform’s voice suddenly stopped.
Because it discovered that Lu Wan at this moment was already covered in tears.
She stared blankly at the light curtain in front of her, her eye sockets slightly turning red.
“Husband... So Husband has been working so hard all along.”
“Even if there is only such a meager return, he is unwilling to let it go.”
Lu Wan gently bit her lips, her voice even carrying a hint of a sob.
“He is clearly so short on money...”
“Yet the one hundred trillion Divinity Points dowry that I gave him back then, he refused to accept even a single cent of it.”
“By now, I actually still suspected him...”
Lu Wan clenched her fists tightly, her eyes filled with remorse.
“I really am...”
When she spoke up to here, her voice was completely choked with sobs.
She had finally figured out the truth of the matter.
In order to make money, Yang Fan didn’t even hesitate to use this low-profit arbitrage and increase leverage to earn funds.
Yet a person who was short on money to the extreme like this was precisely unwilling to accept even the one hundred trillion Divinity Points she offered back then.
Thinking of this, the guilt in Lu Wan’s heart grew increasingly intense.
“Master, according to the current situation, once the Divine Kingdom’s capital chain fractures, the risk is extremely high.”
“It is recommended that Master explain the situation to Chairman Yang as soon as possible and assist him in handling potential debt issues.”
The intelligent lifeform suggested earnestly.
Hearing this, Lu Wan shook her head.
“Husband has a strong self-esteem; he will never allow me to do this.”
“Go, arrange a few professional managers to liaise with Ma Yu, introduce the sales channels to Yang Corporation, and find a way to help Husband digest this inventory.”
Speaking to this point, Lu Wan slowly walked to the window.
Looking at the scenery outside the window, her eyes were filled with gentleness.
“Being able to quietly help Husband like this is already enough for me.”
She murmured softly.
“Husband, I will always quietly support you.”
Downstairs, Yang Fan was just picking up a piece of tender fish fillet and sending it into his mouth.
Suddenly, he couldn’t help but sneeze.
“Achoo!”
Yang Fan rubbed his nose, a hint of confusion appearing on his face.
“Who is thinking of me?”
Finishing his words, he didn’t think much more about it, picked up another two pieces of fish fillets to put into his mouth, and leisurely enjoyed himself.
Virtual World.
Sima Family territory.
Inside a magnificent conference room, more than a dozen Sima Family deities were gathered together.
At this moment, everyone’s expression was ugly to the extreme.
And sitting in the main seat was none other than Sima Zhao.
“Bang!”
A Tier 3 God of the Sima Family slammed a hand onto the table.
“Every month, my believers suffer losses exceeding ten million!”
“Those are all high-level believers!”
“If we keep fighting like this, it’s no longer a matter of cost; even my Divine Kingdom Foundation will be affected!”
“Lu Mingshi from the Lu Clan has constantly been exerting extreme pressure. Although the Clan has regulations, I can’t possibly gamble with the safety of my own Divine Kingdom, right?”
“I agree too!”
Another Sima Family deity said in a deep voice.
“The losses of our believers are simply too huge. If we continue fighting, our own Divine Kingdom’s defensive power will become hollowed out.”
Sima Jin’s brows were also tightly locked at this moment.
“Although wartime supplies are all supplied by the Clan, those Smart Weapons are all produced from my Divine Kingdom.”
“With losses this large nowadays, I wonder when the Clan will issue subsidies?”
Speaking to this point, he directly cast his gaze toward Sima Zhao in the main seat.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 475: Psychological Warfare
paragraphs: The atmosphere in the meeting room suddenly grew even heavier.
Sima Zhao also knitted his brows tightly.
As the commander-in-chief of the Sima Family’s forces supporting Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom this time, the pressure he was currently bearing was immense as well.
If this war ultimately failed, his abilities would likely be questioned by the Clan Elders.
There was still a thousand years left until the end of his father’s next term in office.
And during these thousand years, the performance of all candidates within the Clan would be recorded, serving as an important evaluation basis for inheriting the core power of the Clan in the future.
He absolutely did not want such an obvious stain to be left on his record.
“How is the contact with Lu Mingshi of the Lu Clan going?”
Sima Zhao took a deep breath and shifted his gaze to his younger sister.
Hearing this, Sima Yurao immediately stood up.
“The other party has rejected contact with everyone from the Sima Family.”
“The attitude is very resolute.”
“Good.” A trace of anger flashed through Sima Zhao’s eyes.
“This Lu Mingshi is ruthless enough!”
But the next moment, he took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.
In the past, if conflicts arose within the Five Great Families, they would basically each take a step back.

Even if it truly came to a point where they had to resolve the other party, in most cases, no one would be willing to step into the ring personally. Instead, they would choose to throw money at hiring people, finding some forces to handle such dirty work for them.
Yet this time, Lu Mingshi personally stepped up.
Now the entire federation knew that the powerful figure behind the invasion of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom was him.
Yet not only did he show no intention of hiding it at all, he couldn’t even be bothered to acknowledge the Sima Family’s peace overtures, directly locking all contact out.
That legendary mama’s boy... never expected him to actually have such a tough side.
“Brother.”
Sima Yurao hesitated for a moment and spoke,

“This Lu Mingshi has almost no interaction with the outside world on a daily basis, and he hasn’t invested shares in any large companies either. Basically, we can’t find any leverage to put pressure on him.”
“How about... starting with his parents?”
Hearing this, Sima Zhao immediately shook his head.
“Both of this person’s parents are Mid-tier Gods, and they are deeply rooted in the Lu Clan. We can’t touch them.”
Sima Yurao hurriedly said,
“We don’t actually need to touch them, just have them help pass along a message.”
“Useless.”
Sima Zhao rubbed his temples, a trace of helplessness appearing on his face.
“They have recently widely distributed invitations, preparing to host a three-hundred-and-thirty-third birthday banquet for their son Lu Mingshi.”
“Moreover, the invitation has already been sent to me.”
“What?” Sima Yurao’s eyes widened instantly. “What kind of operation is this?”
The other gods of the Sima Family in the meeting room also successively revealed strange expressions.
A three-hundred-and-thirty-third birthday banquet?
Which normal god would specifically celebrate this age?
This was clearly just finding an excuse to collect monetary gifts! It was simply thick-skinned to the extreme.
Sima Zhao sighed.
“After knowing their son’s Divine Kingdom foundation, they are acting all proud right now.”
“The one who died is the Peerless Prodigy of our Sima Family; of course the Lu Clan won’t care.”
Hearing this, Sima Jin immediately said angrily,
“Being so blatant is simply too shameless!”
“A Peerless Prodigy-class Human race Genius has fallen, and this is a loss for the entire federation!”
“Alright.” Sima Zhao waved his hand, interrupting everyone’s discussion.
“The Five Great Families are both in cooperation and in competition.”
“Even if we clearly know it was done by the other party, as long as there is no conclusive evidence, we can’t do anything to him.”
“After all, the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence only looks at evidence.”
As Sima Zhao spoke, his gaze gradually grew calm.
“Whoever tied the bell must untie it.”
“Yurao, you are currently at the frontline. After returning to the real world in a moment, go find Sima Tianci.”
“In the name of the Clan, have him help make a trip.”
Hearing this, a trace of hesitation appeared on Sima Yurao’s face.
“This... Brother, I’m afraid he won’t help wholeheartedly.”
“It doesn’t matter.” Sima Zhao said indifferently.
“Have him pass along a message: If the other party is willing to turn hostility into friendship, our Sima Family is willing to fork out a thousand S-grade resource-type buildings as an apology.”
“If they are unwilling, then we’ll continue fighting.”
“It’s nothing more than both sides suffering mutually.”
“And us...”
Sima Zhao’s gaze swept across everyone present.
“We can still hold on for another month.”
“I believe that Yang Fan is a smart person.”
“Given the current state of the battle, if the Divine Kingdom keeps fighting for another thirty years, is it really worth it?”
As his voice fell, the previously somewhat calm meeting room instantly erupted into an uproar.
“Impossible!”
A Sima Family god stood up directly.
“Another month in the real world with this current fighting style, and my Divine Kingdom will definitely be beaten into bankruptcy!”
“That’s right, I don’t agree either!”
“If we continue fighting like this, I’d rather withdraw the troops right now!”
For a moment, all the gods cast their gazes towards Sima Zhao.
Although Sima Zhao was the son of the Clan Chief and the person in charge of this operation, both his strength and status were above theirs.
But this didn’t mean they had to completely obey Sima Zhao’s commands.
What the Divine Kingdom War consumed was their own foundation.
With such massive losses, let alone Sima Zhao, even if the Clan Chief personally spoke, they might not be willing to gamble their own divine kingdoms.
Seeing this scene, Sima Zhao’s expression remained calm.
“Everyone, all losses from this war will be borne by me.”
“Starting from the fifth day onwards, for every extra day we hold on, have your intelligent lifeform compile all the losses of that day and forward them to me.”
“I will directly transfer the corresponding Divinity Points into your divine kingdoms.”
As soon as these words were said, the meeting room instantly quieted down.
The anger on everyone’s faces turned into astonishment.
“Are these words true?”
“If Young Master says so, then we have no doubts anymore.”
“Rest assured, Young Master, we will definitely do our utmost to complete the mission!”
“Young Master is magnanimous!”
“I will return to the divine kingdom to prepare right now!”
Within just a few breaths, the style inside the meeting room instantly underwent a 180-degree shift.
The gods who were filled with righteous indignation just moments ago now had smiles plastered all over their faces once again.
Soon, the rest of the Sima Family gods successively left the meeting room.
The originally lively hall gradually grew quiet.
In the end, only Sima Zhao and Sima Yurao remained.
Watching the backs of those people leaving, Sima Yurao still wore a trace of worry on her face.
“Brother, is this really worth it?”
“Didn’t you see their expressions just now?”
“I even suspect that these guys will intentionally exaggerate their losses when the time comes.”
Hearing this, Sima Zhao gave a scoff.
“Do you take your brother for a fool?”
“It’s just psychological warfare.”
“Five days later, if the other party is still persisting in combat, I will directly order them to withdraw the troops.”

sentences.text: The atmosphere in the meeting room suddenly grew even heavier.
Sima Zhao also knitted his brows tightly.
As the commander-in-chief of the Sima Family’s forces supporting Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom this time, the pressure he was currently bearing was immense as well.
If this war ultimately failed, his abilities would likely be questioned by the Clan Elders.
There was still a thousand years left until the end of his father’s next term in office.
And during these thousand years, the performance of all candidates within the Clan would be recorded, serving as an important evaluation basis for inheriting the core power of the Clan in the future.
He absolutely did not want such an obvious stain to be left on his record.
“How is the contact with Lu Mingshi of the Lu Clan going?”
Sima Zhao took a deep breath and shifted his gaze to his younger sister.
Hearing this, Sima Yurao immediately stood up.
“The other party has rejected contact with everyone from the Sima Family.”
“The attitude is very resolute.”
“Good.” A trace of anger flashed through Sima Zhao’s eyes.
“This Lu Mingshi is ruthless enough!”
But the next moment, he took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.
In the past, if conflicts arose within the Five Great Families, they would basically each take a step back.
Even if it truly came to a point where they had to resolve the other party, in most cases, no one would be willing to step into the ring personally.
Instead, they would choose to throw money at hiring people, finding some forces to handle such dirty work for them.
Yet this time, Lu Mingshi personally stepped up.
Now the entire federation knew that the powerful figure behind the invasion of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom was him.
Yet not only did he show no intention of hiding it at all, he couldn’t even be bothered to acknowledge the Sima Family’s peace overtures, directly locking all contact out.
That legendary mama’s boy... never expected him to actually have such a tough side.
“Brother.”
Sima Yurao hesitated for a moment and spoke,
“This Lu Mingshi has almost no interaction with the outside world on a daily basis, and he hasn’t invested shares in any large companies either.
Basically, we can’t find any leverage to put pressure on him.”
“How about... starting with his parents?”
Hearing this, Sima Zhao immediately shook his head.
“Both of this person’s parents are Mid-tier Gods, and they are deeply rooted in the Lu Clan.
We can’t touch them.”
Sima Yurao hurriedly said,
“We don’t actually need to touch them, just have them help pass along a message.”
“Useless.”
Sima Zhao rubbed his temples, a trace of helplessness appearing on his face.
“They have recently widely distributed invitations, preparing to host a three-hundred-and-thirty-third birthday banquet for their son Lu Mingshi.”
“Moreover, the invitation has already been sent to me.”
“What?” Sima Yurao’s eyes widened instantly.
“What kind of operation is this?”
The other gods of the Sima Family in the meeting room also successively revealed strange expressions.
A three-hundred-and-thirty-third birthday banquet?
Which normal god would specifically celebrate this age?
This was clearly just finding an excuse to collect monetary gifts!
It was simply thick-skinned to the extreme.
Sima Zhao sighed.
“After knowing their son’s Divine Kingdom foundation, they are acting all proud right now.”
“The one who died is the Peerless Prodigy of our Sima Family; of course the Lu Clan won’t care.”
Hearing this, Sima Jin immediately said angrily,
“Being so blatant is simply too shameless!”
“A Peerless Prodigy-class Human race Genius has fallen, and this is a loss for the entire federation!”
“Alright.” Sima Zhao waved his hand, interrupting everyone’s discussion.
“The Five Great Families are both in cooperation and in competition.”
“Even if we clearly know it was done by the other party, as long as there is no conclusive evidence, we can’t do anything to him.”
“After all, the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence only looks at evidence.”
As Sima Zhao spoke, his gaze gradually grew calm.
“Whoever tied the bell must untie it.”
“Yurao, you are currently at the frontline.
After returning to the real world in a moment, go find Sima Tianci.”
“In the name of the Clan, have him help make a trip.”
Hearing this, a trace of hesitation appeared on Sima Yurao’s face.
“This...
Brother, I’m afraid he won’t help wholeheartedly.”
“It doesn’t matter.” Sima Zhao said indifferently.
“Have him pass along a message: If the other party is willing to turn hostility into friendship, our Sima Family is willing to fork out a thousand S-grade resource-type buildings as an apology.”
“If they are unwilling, then we’ll continue fighting.”
“It’s nothing more than both sides suffering mutually.”
“And us...”
Sima Zhao’s gaze swept across everyone present.
“We can still hold on for another month.”
“I believe that Yang Fan is a smart person.”
“Given the current state of the battle, if the Divine Kingdom keeps fighting for another thirty years, is it really worth it?”
As his voice fell, the previously somewhat calm meeting room instantly erupted into an uproar.
“Impossible!”
A Sima Family god stood up directly.
“Another month in the real world with this current fighting style, and my Divine Kingdom will definitely be beaten into bankruptcy!”
“That’s right, I don’t agree either!”
“If we continue fighting like this, I’d rather withdraw the troops right now!”
For a moment, all the gods cast their gazes towards Sima Zhao.
Although Sima Zhao was the son of the Clan Chief and the person in charge of this operation, both his strength and status were above theirs.
But this didn’t mean they had to completely obey Sima Zhao’s commands.
What the Divine Kingdom War consumed was their own foundation.
With such massive losses, let alone Sima Zhao, even if the Clan Chief personally spoke, they might not be willing to gamble their own divine kingdoms.
Seeing this scene, Sima Zhao’s expression remained calm.
“Everyone, all losses from this war will be borne by me.”
“Starting from the fifth day onwards, for every extra day we hold on, have your intelligent lifeform compile all the losses of that day and forward them to me.”
“I will directly transfer the corresponding Divinity Points into your divine kingdoms.”
As soon as these words were said, the meeting room instantly quieted down.
The anger on everyone’s faces turned into astonishment.
“Are these words true?”
“If Young Master says so, then we have no doubts anymore.”
“Rest assured, Young Master, we will definitely do our utmost to complete the mission!”
“Young Master is magnanimous!”
“I will return to the divine kingdom to prepare right now!”
Within just a few breaths, the style inside the meeting room instantly underwent a 180-degree shift.
The gods who were filled with righteous indignation just moments ago now had smiles plastered all over their faces once again.
Soon, the rest of the Sima Family gods successively left the meeting room.
The originally lively hall gradually grew quiet.
In the end, only Sima Zhao and Sima Yurao remained.
Watching the backs of those people leaving, Sima Yurao still wore a trace of worry on her face.
“Brother, is this really worth it?”
“Didn’t you see their expressions just now?”
“I even suspect that these guys will intentionally exaggerate their losses when the time comes.”
Hearing this, Sima Zhao gave a scoff.
“Do you take your brother for a fool?”
“It’s just psychological warfare.”
“Five days later, if the other party is still persisting in combat, I will directly order them to withdraw the troops.”
“Aside from the Clan subsidies, don’t even think about getting a single cent of extra resources.”
“What I said just now is nothing more than fake news specifically released for Sima Tianci to hear.”
“And then, through him, pass this news to Yang Fan.”
“As long as the other party knows that we can still hold on for another month, they will naturally re-evaluate the cost of this war.”

chapters.title: Chapter 476: Near the Finish Line
paragraphs: Hearing this, Sima Yurao immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
“Older brother is still the smart one.”
“With so many eyes and ears here, Sima Tianci will definitely find a way to learn the contents of the meeting.”
“Regardless of whether he is genuinely passing the word for us or not, as long as this news can be spread out, it will be enough.”
Sima Zhao nodded.
“Go do it. It’s a good thing you already divorced before the other party got into trouble.”
“Otherwise, you would probably have been implicated in this battle as well.”
“Sunk costs cannot participate in major decision-making.”
“Five days later, I won’t use my own God-Kingdom Resources to continue gambling for so-called reputation.”
“I just hope these little tricks can work.”
Sima Yurao nodded.
Afterward, her figure gradually disappeared, exiting the Virtual World.
After everyone left, the meeting room fell back into silence.
Sima Zhao raised his hand.
The next moment, an exquisite invitation card appeared in his hand, pinched between two fingers.
On the invitation card were strikingly large characters— [Lu Mingshi Birthday Banquet Invitation]
Sima Zhao lowered his head to look at it a few times, then gently let out a breath.
“Go, prepare a congratulatory gift worth fifty thousand Divinity Points and put my name on it.”
“Yes, Master.” The voice of an intelligent lifeform came from all around.
Sima Zhao’s fingers gently stroked the invitation card, his gaze gradually turning deep.
“Lu Mingshi...”
“With such combat strength, I didn’t expect the Lu Clan to still hide a Genius like you.”
“Although we are in a hostile relationship today, who can say for sure about future matters?”
“Perhaps one day, we will even become friends or partners.”
“It’s better to ease this relationship as much as possible.”
Sima Zhao muttered softly to himself.
As for Ma Huainan’s God-Kingdom... if it truly couldn’t be saved, he would just accept it.
Who told him he had bad luck and happened to take on this mission.
The lifespan of a god is endless, and there are still long years ahead in the future.
A mission failure and a loss of interests, placed on a long timescale, are simply nothing.
If one were to let emotions affect judgment because of a single failure.
To completely make an enemy of a powerful person for the sake of so-called face and temporary gains and losses would be truly unwise.
On this day, Yang Fan was accompanying Gu Chengye within Primordial City of the Virtual World.
Inside the room, Gu Chengye was running all over the place, holding a doll bear embedded with blood-red pearl gems in his small hands.
Gu Chengye had already learned how to speak, but because he was still young, his speech was still milky and slightly slurred.
Fortunately, there were always nanny robots following and taking care of him in the room, so no matter how joyfully he ran, there was no need to worry about him bumping into things.
“Daddy, give... bear...”
Gu Chengye ran to Yang Fan’s side, tilted his head up, and pointed his small finger at the slightly smaller doll bear.
“Alright, I’ll give it to you.”
Yang Fan smiled and handed the doll bear back.
Gu Chengye immediately beamed with joy, hugging the two doll bears and running off to the side.
“Husband, this is the Purple Light Spirit Water produced in the high-order Cultivation Divine Kingdom.”
Gu Le obediently picked up the teapot and poured a cup for Yang Fan.
“Brewing Enlightenment Tea with this has a unique flavor.”
Yang Fan picked up the teacup and took a gentle sip.
The next moment, a trace of surprise appeared on his face.
“Le’er, could this have been plucked from your father by you?”
“Why does it taste exactly the same as what I drank there when I went to the frontline last time?”
Hearing this, Gu Le’s face immediately showed a trace of embarrassment.
“This was even discovered by Husband.”
“The Enlightenment Tea is alright, but as for this Purple Light Spirit Water, my father treasures it dearly.”
“I begged for a long time before getting a few tons from him.”
Speaking of this, Gu Le looked eagerly at Yang Fan.
“Husband, do you like it?”
“How about I take the Gu Family’s exclusive spatial wormhole in a little while and transfer these Purple Light Spirit Water into your God-Kingdom?”
“Forget it.” Yang Fan shook his head.
“I’m not fond of tea anyway, and I see Chengye quite likes drinking this water. Leave it all to him.”
Saying this, Yang Fan looked toward Gu Chengye not far away, “Right, what has Chengye been learning recently?”
“He is still too young right now.”
Gu Le said with a smile.
“Recently, I invited a few robots specialized in etiquette education from the Gu Family. In other aspects, it’s mainly letting him play more, see more, and come into contact with this world more.”
“Just this?”
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow.
“Don’t we need to teach him knowledge regarding the God-Kingdom in advance?”
Yang Fan was indeed somewhat puzzled.
Regarding children’s education, he actually didn’t understand it very well.

Back when he was studying in Yang County, he had heard that the children of many demigod Clan members had already been exposed to theoretical knowledge of the God-Kingdom from a very young age, and would even specially hire tutors for one-on-one teaching.
And last time on Xiling Planet, Luo Rou had also told him about it.
She had specially built a school next to the villa and hired more than a dozen demigods specifically responsible for teaching Yang Chengrou.
The purpose was to give the child the best educational Resources, allowing her to take fewer detours from a young age.
But hearing Gu Le’s words now, Yang Fan was somewhat shocked instead.
After all, speaking of conditions, Gu Chengye was much more privileged than Yang Chengrou.
His grandparents were both High-Order Gods, and they both held immense power within the Gu Family.
Under these conditions, it stood to reason that he should receive top-tier education.
Hearing Yang Fan’s confusion, Gu Le hurriedly waved her hand.
“Of course it’s not needed. Starting to learn various God-Kingdom knowledge at such a young age is ‘tiger parenting’ for poor families.”
“Our son only needs to enjoy life properly.”
“Learning etiquette from a young age is so that he can better integrate into upper-class society in the future.”
“As for how to develop after Awakening the God-Kingdom in the future, naturally, a high-tier Divine Planner from my Gu Family will make a one-on-one plan for him.”
When Gu Le reached this point, a trace of pride even flashed in her eyes.
“I am even prepared.”
“After Chengye finishes Awakening his God-Kingdom, I will go ask my father to apply for a ninth-grade intelligent lifeform to bind directly with his God-Kingdom.”
“Chengye’s time should be used to enjoy life, experience this world, and find the things he truly likes.”
“As for those basic knowledge...”
“Spending some Divinity Points can completely buy other people’s professional services.”
Saying this, Gu Le continued:
“And Husband, I have already arranged all of Chengye’s future development.”
“Doesn’t Chengye already have a life planet now?”
“Every year he grows older in the future, I will help him acquire a medium-sized listed company in that Starfield.”
“When he turns eighteen and completes the Awakening of his God-Kingdom, I will gift him some A-rank and S-rank resource-type buildings.”
“For God-Kingdom development, just taking it step by step is enough.”
“For gods, the importance of Resources far exceeds those theoretical knowledge.”
“Rather than making Chengye work hard with bitterness, it’s better for the two of us husband and wife to strive well first.”
“With us backing him up, his life will definitely be incomparably smooth.”
Finished speaking, Gu Le hugged Gu Chengye into her arms with full doting affection.
Gu Chengye didn’t struggle either; instead, holding the doll bear in his hands, he leaned affectionately into Gu Le’s arms.
After hearing this speech, Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
Afterward, he slowly nodded, “What you said... also makes sense.”
Yang Fan knew very well that he was born in a small place, and in terms of certain insights and horizons, he indeed could not compare to Gu Le and Lu Wan.
The most fundamental reason why he was able to reach his current height was still because he had awakened the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent.
Without this Talent, no matter how hard he tried, it would be impossible to reach today.
In this world, a fair starting point simply does not exist.
If parents cannot give their child things, then this child will most likely only be an ordinary person for the rest of their life.
But when the parents are powerful enough, from the moment the child is born, they are already standing near the finish line.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 477: How Can You Be So Shameless
paragraphs: Although Yang Fan’s consciousness was currently in the Virtual World, he could still perceive the situation in the Real World.
Sensing that the robotic butler in the Real World seemed to have knocked on the door, Yang Fan glanced at Gu Chengye in his arms and then said softly,
“Le’er, I still have some matters to deal with.”
“I’ll come over to accompany Chengye tomorrow.”
“Alright.” Gu Le nodded and didn’t ask any further questions.
Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly exited the Virtual World.
In reality, he opened his eyes.
At this moment, the robotic butler was standing quietly beside the bedroom door.
“What is it?”
Yang Fan asked.
“Reporting to Master, your friend Sima Tianci has come to visit.”
The robotic butler replied respectfully.
“Sima Tianci?”
Hearing this, a trace of doubt appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Ever since he became a shareholder of the Star Group, the contacts between the two sides had indeed increased quite a bit.
They also frequently met in the Virtual World on ordinary days.
But meeting directly in the Real World was rare.
“Could he want to change places to lie down again?”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched, and a trace of disgust appeared on his face.
“Let him in.”
“Yes, Master.” The robotic butler bowed and retreated.
A few minutes later, the robotic butler brought Sima Tianci to the massage room.
As soon as he entered the door, Sima Tianci began looking around.
Afterwards, without any politeness, he walked over to Yang Fan’s side and lay directly on another massage chair.
The waiting massage robot on the side immediately activated and began giving him a full-body massage.
Sima Tianci closed his eyes comfortably, his entire body instantly relaxing.
“Hiss...”
“Brother Yang still knows how to enjoy life.”
“This life is simply too comfortable.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
“Brother Sima, what wind blew you here?”
Sima Tianci was still lying on the massage chair with a look of enjoyment.
“My own home is too boring, and the Clan always arranges some weird and eccentric tasks for me.”
“So I thought about coming to Brother Yang’s place to hide for a bit.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s face darkened instantly, as if he recalled some not-so-pleasant memories.
Seeing this, Sima Tianci quickly laughed out loud.
“Stingy guy, I’m just joking.”
“And I like the life of a single man.”
“I really wouldn’t be used to living in a couple’s villa like yours that generates noise every day.”
After speaking, he leaned back against the massage chair again, lying there lazily with a face full of enjoyment.
Yang Fan shook his head helplessly, “If you have anything to say, just say it directly.”
Ever since Yang Fan achieved a breakthrough in his Realm and came to the frontline,
Sima Tianci, whom he met back at the Primordial Academy, had also undergone a noticeable change in attitude.
Although Sima Tianci in the past had also looked lazy, he was still rather aloof.
Nowadays, even though the other party was still lying flat and liked to chat in Feixun groups,
he was much more active than before, which instead made Yang Fan a bit unaccustomed to it.
“I came here after receiving a Clan task.” Sima Tianci said suddenly.
“A Clan task?”
Yang Fan raised his eyebrows slightly.
“That’s right.”
Sima Tianci opened his eyes.
“Those gods supporting Ma Huainan are starting to crack under pressure now.”
“The Clan wants to sue for peace.”
“As for the conditions and their threats, see for yourself.”
After speaking, a flash of light flickered in Sima Tianci’s hand, and an electronic screen appeared in his palm.
Afterward, he tossed it directly to Yang Fan.
Yang Fan caught the electronic screen and clicked play.
The next moment, the entire process of Sima Zhao presiding over the meeting was completely presented before his eyes.
From the very beginning where those gods of the Sima Family demanded a retreat, to later demanding Clan subsidies,
and finally to Sima Zhao proposing one thousand S-grade resource-type buildings as compensation, along with issuing a threat that they could hold out for at most one month.
There were no omissions in the contents of the entire meeting.
After finishing it, the expression on Yang Fan’s face gradually turned peculiar.
He turned his head to look at Sima Tianci, “Brother Sima, what is this?”
Seeing this, Sima Tianci quickly explained:
“One of the Tier 3 Gods participating in this meeting is a consultant hired by my mother’s company.”
“This is news he secretly passed to me; it’s confidential, oh.”
Speaking of this, a trace of smugness even appeared on Sima Tianci’s face.
“Brother Yang, this news must be quite useful to you, right?”
Yang Fan shook his head, the expression on his face remaining calm.
“Brother Sima, you misunderstood my meaning.”
“My meaning is... what does this have to do with me?”
Sima Tianci was stunned upon hearing this.
Yang Fan looked at the other party earnestly.
“Why does the host of this meeting want to give me one thousand S-grade resource-type buildings in exchange for that Corpse Cultivator god to withdraw his troops?”
“I have indeed heard of this Divine Kingdom War, but what does it have to do with me?”
“I’m not even close to that Corpse Cultivator god; did the Sima Family misunderstand something?”
Yang Fan said with an earnest expression.
Looking at Yang Fan’s incomparably sincere expression, the corners of Sima Tianci’s mouth couldn’t help twitching.
At this moment, he realized—
How could this person Yang Fan... be so shameless?
“Ahem.”
Sima Tianci gave a light cough, his expression slightly awkward.
“This person is named Sima Zhao, and he is Sima Yurao’s own brother.”
“To misunderstand Brother Yang without evidence is indeed his problem.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately displayed a helpless expression.
“Please, Brother Sima, be sure to vouch for me.”
“I just broke through to the divine Realm not long ago; how could I possibly have the ability to do such a thing?”
“Back then, after the God-Sealing Tournament of Prodigies at the Primordial Academy ended, I even received financial support from the Sima Family.”
“Sigh, this matter truly has nothing to do with me.”
Listening to these words from Yang Fan, the expression on Sima Tianci’s face could barely hold together.
He took a deep breath and then said gloomily,
“Brother Yang, according to investigations, the upper management of the Yang Corporation you founded has recently undergone personnel changes.”
“There is an extra consultant named Lu Mingshi.”
“That is indeed the case.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Come to think of it, it really does have a connection to this Divine Kingdom War.”
Hearing this, a trace of surprise instantly flashed through Sima Tianci’s eyes.
Not pretending anymore?
Ready to lay cards on the table directly?
In fact, because of the matter concerning Ma Huainan, Lu Mingshi, Gu Le, Lu Wan, and Yang Fan himself had long been listed as key targets of investigation by the Sima Family.
The matter of Lu Mingshi becoming a consultant for the Yang Corporation naturally couldn’t be hidden from their investigation.
Even the salary and benefits offered by the Yang Corporation, as well as related tax payment information, were thoroughly investigated.
Within the Five Great Families, one matter had basically been tacitly accepted by now.
That was, the reason Lu Mingshi took action to invade Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom was precisely under Yang Fan’s instigation.
“Brother Sima might not know this.”
Yet Yang Fan acted as if he completely didn’t know about these things and continued,
“Back then, when I saw the battle situation of Brother Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom, I also felt somewhat surprised, so I secretly launched an investigation.”
“Soon, I locked onto Lu Mingshi of the Lu Clan.”
Speaking of this, a trace of appreciation even surfaced in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Such a terrifying divine kingdom foundation was actually able to contend head-on with over a dozen Tier 3 Gods single-handedly.”
“This kind of strength truly commands my admiration.”
“My Yang Corporation has just started up and is precisely at a time when we need to recruit strong individuals.”
“Although I personally do not agree with his approach of invading the divine kingdom of a fellow clansman, from the perspective of the company’s development, this investment is indeed worth it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 478: Divine Kingdom Environmental Pollution
paragraphs: Yang Fan spread his hands, his face filled with helplessness.
“If this causes the Sima Family to have any misunderstandings, please help me explain a thing or two, Brother Sima.”
“After all, when managing such a large company, some things cannot be done purely based on hot-blooded passion and a so-called sense of justice.”
“In doing real business, one must ultimately consider interests.”
Hearing this speech, Sima Tianci opened his mouth.
After a full few seconds, he couldn’t squeeze out a single word.
In the end, he could only slowly raise a thumb toward Yang Fan.
“You’re awesome, I admit defeat.”
Sima Tianci seemed to no longer want to stay here.
He sat up directly from the massage chair.
“Brother Yang, to be honest with you.”
“Sima Zhao and I are in a competitive relationship to begin with.”
“Just treat it as me talking to myself, and forget it once you’ve heard it.”
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly.
Sima Tianci continued:
“It’s impossible for him to truly persist for another month.”
“The Clan’s subsidies will end in five days, and the remaining war investment must be borne by oneself.”
“According to the current war intensity, at most ten days, the Tier 3 Gods supported by the Sima Family won’t be able to hold on.”
“By then, this war naturally won’t be able to continue.”
Speaking of this, Sima Tianci showed a trace of a smile.
“Right, my younger brother Sima Bang will also come to the frontline for service before long.”
“At that time, let’s get together.”
“Easy to say.” Yang Fan nodded in agreement.
Walking out of the Lu Family Villa.
A cool breeze blew toward his face, and Sima Tianci couldn’t help shivering.
He looked back at the villa behind him, and couldn’t help complaining:
“As expected of a man who can eat two portions of soft rice at the same time.”
“When lying like this, his heartbeat doesn’t even change.”
Thinking of Yang Fan’s serious appearance just now, the corners of Sima Tianci’s mouth couldn’t help twitching.
But soon, the smile on his face gradually faded.
“Although we are friends now, I still have to be careful of this person.”
“Yang Fan’s words are watertight, and his trump cards are hidden deeper than anyone else’s.”
“Once he truly makes a move... it’s aimed at driving people to death.”
Sima Tianci pondered for a moment and slowly shook his head.
“This kind of person can be made friends with, but must never be befriended deeply.”
Finishing his words, he looked back at the Lu Family Villa once more.
At this moment, his evaluation of Yang Fan had completely changed.
Back then when he leaked the investigative news of Ma Huainan to Yang Fan, his true purpose was actually just to use Yang Fan’s hand to create a little trouble for Sima Zhao’s lineage.
According to his initial plan, Yang Fan only needed to actively report the investigated matters to the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
In this way, Ma Huainan would inevitably suffer a not-so-light punishment.
And Sima Yurao, who had a close relationship with Ma Huainan, was also extremely likely to be implicated.
But who could have thought... the development of things completely exceeded his expectations.
Yang Fan didn’t walk the path he had anticipated at all.
Instead, from a victim, he directly became the perpetrator.
In such a short time, he actually deduced Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core coordinates, and arranged for Lu Mingshi to directly kill into it.
Now even the support team sent by the Sima Family was almost unable to hold on.
Identity, foundation, connections...
Today’s Yang Fan was already not inferior in the slightest to the direct-line geniuses of the Five Great Families.
The most terrifying thing was... he was only in his twenties.
People always need to socialize upwards; only by constantly contacting strong people can one see the scenery at higher places.
But while contacting strong people, one must also protect oneself well.
In this world, there are many people who can pull you up.
But similarly, there are also many people who will casually swallow you up without leaving even your bones.
In Sima Tianci’s view, the Yang Fan seen today was this kind of person.
Cautious, dangerous, ruthless, shameless.
The most important thing was that his strength was strong enough!
Inside the massage room, Yang Fan looked at the electronic screen in his hand, without a trace of ripples on his face.
A moment later, he gave a casual flick.
“Crack!”
The electronic screen was directly thrown into the trash can beside him.
To Yang Fan, these had no meaning whatsoever.
Even if the Sima Family could really persist for another month, so what?
Thinking of this, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
In his mind, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core couldn’t help but emerge.
“Over a dozen Tier 3 Gods personally entered your Divine Kingdom to support...”
“By then, through deducing via your Divine Kingdom Core, I wonder how many of their Divine Kingdom coordinates it can deduce for me.”
Yang Fan licked his lips, a trace of anticipation flashing in his eyes.
For him now, a God’s Divine Kingdom coordinates were naturally the more the better.
As for whether the other party was an alien race or the Human race.
Yang Fan didn’t care at all.
Of course, in a short time, to avoid attracting too much attention, he would not immediately make a move against these supporting Tier 3 Gods.
When the time was ripe, he would naturally harvest them.
Moreover, these Tier 3 Gods of the Sima Family were not like Ma Huainan, possessing an SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talent.
Solving them by then wouldn’t cause too big of a sensation at all.
The war still continued.
Inside Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom, believers from both sides fell continuously.
Various war supplies were crazily thrown into the frontline as if they cost nothing.
corpse pills, Talismans, Medicinal Pills, war weapons... were all thrown into the battlefield by both sides.
However, the battle line was always strictly restricted to the edge of the core area of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Neither side was willing to step back an inch.
Once the battle line shifted, the other side would inevitably immediately invest more troops to retake the lost area.
By now, this had completely turned into a pure war of attrition.
Throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, corpses left behind by the war were everywhere.
Because the war never stopped, both sides didn’t even have time to clean up the battlefield.
Zombies, human believers, and various remains were casually discarded on the earth.
As time went on, a large number of corpses began to rot.
Various plague viruses also began to spread continuously inside the Divine Kingdom.
“Sima Jin!”
“Holy Spirit Water, I already purchased one thousand tons yesterday, and the Divinity Points haven’t been transferred to me yet!”
“Boss, my believers have already begun to contract diseases on a large scale! Now even gas masks need to be equipped!”
“These do not belong to war losses, and the Clan doesn’t reimburse them. You have to figure out a way to solve it, right?”
“A-rank war weapons, yesterday I lost a full six million sets!”
“Although my Divine Kingdom has Planted quite a bit of spiritual rice, it can’t supply so many people. From now on, everyone should solve their own food problems!”
As time went on, these supporting Sima Family Gods finally began to gradually develop dissatisfaction.
The reason was very simple.
The longer the war lasted, the higher the cost invested, and the lower the benefits that could be obtained.
Even by now, they had begun to doubt.
Whether there were still subsidies to be earned if they continued to support.
Sima Jin’s consciousness was high above the Divine Kingdom, coldly looking at the scarred land before his eyes.
Today’s Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had long since lost its prosperity.
Everywhere were traces left by the war.
Plague, pollution, death...
Even in the Divine Kingdom Core area, the remaining believers were all sallow and emaciated, with listless spirits.
Due to environmental pollution, as well as the fear brought by long-term war.
Even though Ma Huainan constantly used Breeding Cards, the birth rate of these believers was still getting lower and lower.
The Divine Kingdom had even begun to experience serious problems of population aging and low birth rates.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 479: Borrowed
paragraphs: Looking at this scene, a trace of doubt arose in Sima Jin’s heart for the first time.
Although Ma Huainan possessed an SS-grade Divine Kingdom talent with infinite future potential,
However... now his Divine Kingdom had deteriorated to such an extent.
To completely restore it to its former state, the Resources required would probably be ten or a hundred times greater.
“Does this so-called Peerless Prodigy... really still need saving?”
This thought couldn’t help but surface in Sima Jin’s mind.
Just at this moment, a Tier 3 God walked over.
“Big Brother, where is that kid Ma Huainan?”
“The Clan is not subsidizing these war investments.”
“We came over to help him guard his Divine Kingdom; we can’t keep bearing the costs ourselves, right?”
Sima Jin shook his head.
“He probably went out to borrow money again.”
“This guy doesn’t have much left in him now.”
“All funds are used to purchase detoxification potions and various disease-prevention medicines.”
“Otherwise, under this harsh environment, his remaining believers would probably have all gone extinct long ago.”
Hearing this, the other Sima Family gods all looked toward the Divine Kingdom Core.
Looking at those sickly believers,
The Sima Family gods present couldn’t help but let out a long sigh.
“Damn it, Lu Mingshi from the Lu Clan is truly ruthless, actually destroying his Divine Kingdom to this extent.”
“Even if we manage to help him defend it in the end, it will probably be very hard to recover its Vitality for hundreds of years.”
“I specifically investigated this person yesterday; he’s just a shut-in.”
“I didn’t expect his mind to be so vicious.”
Another god shook his head.
“If I encounter any gods following the Corpse Cultivator path in the future, I will definitely give them a wide berth.”
“Such people are too terrifying.”
Virtual World.
At this moment, Ma Huainan had long since lost the poise that the Peerless Prodigy-level Genius of the past should have.
He could no longer care about even an ounce of face and directly knelt in front of Qin Xue.
“Sister Qin Xue, no, Director Qin!”
“Lend me a bit more!”
“Just ten thousand, no... a thousand Divinity Points will do!”
“My believers urgently need a large amount of medicine right now. As long as I can get through this hurdle, I, Ma Huainan, will be your beast of burden in the future!”
Ma Huainan said, kowtowing frantically all the while.
One, two, his forehead heavily slamming against the ground.
It was as if he wanted to grasp his last lifeline, completely lacking any semblance of his former Heavenly Pride appearance.
But facing his bitter entreaties, Qin Xue remained silent throughout.
She merely lowered her head, continuously scrolling through the electronic screen in her hand.
Asset information after asset information, debt records after debt records flashed past rapidly.
The further down she looked, the uglier Qin Xue’s expression became.
After a full moment, she coldly spoke:
“Young Master Ma, all assets under your name have been completely frozen.”
“Quite a few of those assets have even been used for mortgage loans.”
“You even borrowed a large amount of short-term funds from those micro-lending companies with an annual interest rate as high as six hundred percent.”
Speaking up to this point, Qin Xue found it somewhat hard to believe.
Was this even borrowing money?
This was fraud!
Snap!
Qin Xue directly tossed the electronic screen aside.
The next moment, she stood up and kicked Ma Huainan in the body.
“Scram!”
“Do not waste my time anymore!”
Accompanied by a cold shout, a powerful force erupted instantly.
Ma Huainan’s consciousness was directly blasted flying, and his entire body miserably flew out of the meeting room.
After finishing all this, Qin Xue heavily slumped onto the sofa.
Her complexion was ugly to the extreme.
“Number Six!”
“Master, please give your instructions.” The voice of the intelligent lifeform sounded immediately.
“Currently, our company is Ma Huainan’s largest creditor.”
Cold light flashed in Qin Xue’s eyes.
“Immediately apply to the Federal Government to freeze all his remaining assets.”
“And hire the best legal-type high-tier intelligent lifeform for me to comprehensively sue those micro-lending companies.”
“Ma Huainan’s currently frozen shares, assets, funds...”
“Recover as much as you can for me!”
“Master.”
The intelligent lifeform hesitated for a moment.
“Our company primarily engages in credit loan business. From a legal standpoint, our creditor’s rights have a lower priority.”
“Then find loopholes for me! Dig out all related clauses for me!”
Qin Xue slammed the table fiercely.
“Get back everything that can be retrieved for me!”
“Yes, Master.”
As the intelligent lifeform’s voice fell, the entire meeting room fell back into silence.
Qin Xue leaned against the sofa, raising her hand to pinch her glabella.
She had been in the financing and loan business for a full tens of thousands of years.
And her clients were all high-net-worth gods with extremely high credit.
Over so many years, although the company occasionally encountered bad debts, most of the time, the interest paid back by the other party long exceeded the principal.
She wouldn’t take such losses to heart at all.
To some extent, those bad debts could even be considered a quite profitable business.
But this time... she truly took a massive tumble.
When she originally lent funds to Ma Huainan, she never would have imagined,
That in less than a year, this illustrious Peerless Prodigy’s Divine Kingdom was almost breached by someone.
Matters developed too fast.
So fast that even she, the largest creditor, didn’t react in time.
“Fortunately...”
Qin Xue let out a long breath.
“To spread risks, the company purchased insurance for every large-amount loan.”
“Otherwise... those major shareholders would probably eat me alive.”
Qin Xue leaned her entire body against the sofa.
Having done business for so many years, this was the first time she felt so exhausted.
In the Real World, Ma Huainan slowly opened his eyes.
He took off the virtual helmet, leaving only a withered grayness on his youthful face.
What kind of appearance of a Peerless Prodigy did he have left now?
His whole person was gaunt and haggard, and his originally pitch-black hair now had large patches of grayish-white.
Clearly only in his early twenties, at this moment he looked like an old man about to step into the end of his life.
All of this was because his Divine Kingdom was damaged far too severely.
A large number of believers died, and the environment of the Divine Kingdom was destroyed, which had begun to conversely affect his Real World Physical Body.
Ma Huainan slowly raised his left hand and opened Feixun.
Afterwards, he began scrolling through the contacts bit by bit.
Here were Genius classmates he knew at the Primordial Academy, friends he made when studying on ordinary life planets in the past,
And relatives he had known since childhood.
These people once all had close relationships with him.
He was once full of high spirits.
As long as he spoke up, almost no one would refuse his request.
But now... Ma Huainan’s fingers slowly slid across the contacts list.
One, two, three...
Behind almost every familiar remark, two dazzling words were added—[Borrowed]
Looking at the full screen of the two words “Borrowed”, Ma Huainan’s gaze gradually dimmed.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 480: Mom's Taste
paragraphs: At present, Ma Huainan had already borrowed all the money he could possibly borrow in order to protect his last remaining believers.
However... this was still not enough.
Even though his believers did not directly participate in the war, in that current Divine Kingdom environment polluted and shrouded by plague, they had begun to die in large numbers.
Every day, a large number of believers perished due to disease, hunger, poisoning, and the deterioration of the environment.
Ma Huainan’s finger continuously scrolled through his contacts list.
Finally, it stopped at the very top.
[Dad]
Looking at this remark, Ma Huainan was silent for a long time.
In the end, he did not choose to open video, but simply made a phone call.
“Beep—”
“Beep—”
A few seconds later, the phone connected.
“Xiaonan. How have things been recently?”
“Did you encounter any bottleneck in your development? Lacking resources?”
The voice of a middle-aged man came from the other end of the phone, his tone filled with concern.
“When you got married back then, the hundreds of millions of Faith Points that daughter-in-law Yurao transferred to us, your mother and I have never touched them.”
“We’ve been saving them all for you.”
“If you really lack money, just tell Dad, and I’ll transfer it to you immediately.”
Hearing his father’s familiar voice, Ma Huainan’s eye sockets instantly turned red.
Immediately after, a woman’s voice came from the other end of the phone.
“Xiaonan, you haven’t called us in a long time.”
“Why aren’t you turning on the video? Mom wants to see you.”
Hearing these words, Ma Huainan took a deep breath, trying to keep his voice calm.
“Dad, Mom.”
“I’m fine.”
“I’m not lacking anything, your son is an SS-rank Divine Kingdom talent owner after all.”
“And I even married the proud daughter of heaven from the Sima Family, my life is going great right now.”
When he reached this point, his voice suddenly stopped, as if his throat was blocked by something.
The words behind, no matter what, could not be spoken.
He wanted to tell his parents that he had failed.
Everything he took pride in was collapsing bit by bit.
But these words... how could he possibly speak them aloud?
The other end of the phone fell silent for a moment.
Afterward, his father’s gentle voice sounded once more.
“Xiaonan, we’ve lived through hard times for so many years and experienced all kinds of things.”
“So you don’t need to put so much pressure on yourself.”
“How others view you is not important.”
“Whether you become a person above others is also not important.”
“Your mom and dad just hope that you can live a safe, peaceful, and happy life.”
“That is enough.”
Hearing his father’s words, the tears in Ma Huainan’s eyes could finally no longer be controlled, sliding down his cheeks.
Yet he still did not tell the truth.
In the end, the phone call hung up.
“Beep—”
“Beep—”
Meanwhile, on a remote living planet.
Inside an ordinary villa, the middle-aged couple looked at the prompt indicating the end of the Feixun call, both of their faces revealing expressions of worry.
“What on earth is going on with Xiaonan recently?”
The woman furrowed her brows.
“A few days ago, Aunt Wang even asked me, saying whether Xiaonan borrowed money from her son.”
“That woman just loves to gossip idly.”
The man shook his head.
“Our son is now the son-in-law of the Sima Family, one of the Five Great Families, how could he possibly borrow money from her son?”
“I reckon... it should be that Xiaonan had some conflict with Yurao again.”
Saying this, the man couldn’t help but let out a sigh.
“Our Clan’s conditions aren’t good.”
“This marriage is also our son marrying above his station.”
“Suffering a little grievance is also normal.”
The woman did not refute, only gazing out the window.
After a long time, she softly said:
“When Xiaonan comes back next time, I’ll make him braised spare ribs.”
“When he was little, he liked eating my secret-recipe spare ribs seasoning the most.”
Saying this, a trace of a smile appeared on the woman’s face.
But deep within her eyes, thick worry was hidden.
They were Ma Huainan’s biological parents, having accompanied their child’s growth for over twenty years; naturally, they could hear the abnormality in their son.
Only... knowing, what could they even do?
They were merely ordinary Divine Beings.
Being able to enjoy a lavish life on this living planet nowadays was solely because they bathed in their son’s light.
Without powerful strength, without massive resources, they didn’t even have the qualification to ask for the reason.
Because they were very clear about it.
Even if they knew, they couldn’t help with anything at all.
Powerlessness was the fate of the vast majority of ordinary people.
the frontline, the Sima Family’s ancestral villa.
Ma Huainan slowly leaned against the sofa, his face full of loneliness.
The once high-spirited youth now resembled a helpless child.
“Someone come!” Ma Huainan suddenly shouted.
“Master, what are your instructions?”
An intelligent lifeform robot heard the sound and quickly pushed the door to enter.
Ma Huainan leaned on the chair, his voice low.
“I want to eat something, braised spare ribs.”
“Yes.”
The intelligent lifeform robot nodded.
“I wonder if Master has any specific requirements for the flavor?”
Ma Huainan was silent for a moment, then said in a low voice:
“I want... Mom’s taste.”
The intelligent lifeform robot paused for a moment.
“After retrieval, the option ‘Mom’s taste’ does not exist in the recipe.”
“Master...”
“Make whatever you want.”
Ma Huainan closed his eyes, his entire body leaning against the back of the chair.
“Let me be quiet for a while.”
“Yes.”
The intelligent lifeform robot bowed and exited, and the room returned to silence.
The periphery of the core area of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, those Sima Family gods originally stationed here all had extremely ugly expressions.
“What on earth does Sima Zhao mean?”
A Tier 3 God couldn’t help but say angrily.
“I reported all today’s war losses upward, and all proof materials are also prepared.”
“But what about his Divinity Points?”
“Why is there not a single sound of movement?”
Another god beside him also had a gloomy expression.
“Boss, what the hell is there to guard anymore!”
“Ma Huainan himself hasn’t appeared until now.”
“You guys have also seen the situation of his Divine Kingdom; the believers who can still be alive right now probably number less than one billion.”
“Continuing to guard, what meaning is there left?”
“In my view, that Sima Zhao is simply making empty promises!”
“That’s right!”
Another god let out a cold snort.
“I originally thought that after the Clan subsidy ended, he would at least put on a show and hold out for a few days.”
“Now it looks like it’s purely empty promises!”
For a time, various complaints kept sounding.
By now, how could the gods present not understand what had happened.
They weren’t fools either.
If Sima Zhao was really prepared to continue bearing the war consumption, the intelligent lifeform should have already transferred the Divinity Points over.
But so much time had passed without any news.
The answer was already very obvious.
Sima Zhao had given up.
Or rather... Sima Zhao was not prepared at all to truly bear the losses outside of the Clan subsidy.
Sima Jin stood within the crowd, silent for a long time, and finally let out a soft sigh.
“Alright, the support cost has already reached the upper limit that the Clan can accept.”
“Continuing to fight has no meaning whatsoever.”
“Retreat the troops.”
(That’s a Wrap!)
