chapters.title: Chapter 481: Double Joy
paragraphs: In this war, they had fought to the very end.
The subsidies from the Sima Family were indeed substantial.
But alas... the consumption of this Divine Kingdom War was simply too terrifying.
Various warfare Resources, believer losses, Smart Weapon attrition...
Calculated all together, these supporters were likely operating at a loss.
“Let’s go.”
A Tier 3 God snorted coldly.
“I will never take on such support missions again in the future.”
With that, he waved his hand.
The next moment, a spatial fluctuation appeared within the divine kingdom.
Countless believers were pulled by the traction and directly teleported away to evacuate.
Seeing the first god leave, the others did not continue to hold out.
One after another, they opened spatial channels.
In the blink of an eye, the nearly one hundred billion Human race believers previously stationed around the outer periphery of the Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom Core area all vanished.
The entire battlefield instantly became desolate and empty.
Reality, Lu Family Villa.
In the living room, Yang Fan was sitting at the dining table enjoying his dinner.
“Husband, try this.”
Lu Wan picked up a piece of pan-fried food and placed it in Yang Fan’s bowl.
“This is a Hydra egg I pan-fried for you, it tastes especially good.”
Looking at the snake egg in his bowl that was meticulously arranged into a heart shape, Yang Fan couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
“Since when did you learn to do this?”
However, he still picked it up, took a bite, and then nodded.
“It tastes good.”
During this period of time, Lu Wan’s changes were very obvious.
For some unknown reason, Lu Wan had suddenly become very clingy.
She had even started taking an interest in cooking, something that seemed utterly meaningless to gods.
Occasionally, when she was in the mood, she would personally cook and prepare things for Yang Fan.
What left Yang Fan most helpless was that Lu Wan always liked giving him things lately.
Instead of giving Divinity Points directly, she gave all sorts of strange buildings, precious foods, and Heavenly Treasuress.
Every time, the reason was very simple— “Husband, try this, it tastes good.”
But... each gift amounted to hundreds of millions of tons.
How was this letting him try a fresh delicacy?
It was clearly enough for all believers in the divine kingdom to taste it.
Sometimes Yang Fan even felt that giving these precious Heavenly Treasuress to ordinary believers to eat was a bit too wasteful.
But thinking of his own terrifying monthly income of Divinity Points, he felt it didn’t matter anymore.
After all, no matter how precious these things were, they were ultimately just Resources.
And what he lacked the least nowadays... was Resources.
However, this also gave Yang Fan a deeper understanding of Lu Wan’s wealth.
You must know that other gods were not like him, possessing a thousandfold divine kingdom investment return.
“Husband.”
Just as Yang Fan was pondering, Lu Wan suddenly sat down beside him.
She reached out to hold Yang Fan’s left hand, her eyes filled with gentleness.
“If you are under too much pressure, don’t keep it bottled up inside.”
“Although massages can relieve some fatigue, they can’t solve the real problem.”
“If there is anything on your mind, you can tell me.”
“We are husband and wife.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s heart stirred slightly.
“I... I’m fine, I don’t have much pressure.”
He gave a light cough.
What pressure could he possibly have?
His biggest pressure every day was probably worrying that others would discover how wealthy and powerful he was.
After listening, Lu Wan pouted her small lips slightly, her expression clearly showing disbelief.
The next moment, she suddenly snapped her fingers.
Soon, a robot walked over from the side.
It was holding a dining tray in its hands, with a cover on top.
After putting down the dining tray, the robot quietly retreated to the side.
Yang Fan was somewhat curious, “What is this?”
“A surprise.”
Lu Wan smiled and motioned.
“Open it and take a look.”
With doubt, Yang Fan slowly lifted the cover.
The next moment, his movements stopped.
Inside the dining tray was not any food, but a certification document.
Yang Fan picked it up, and after seeing the contents clearly, his eyes widened abruptly.
“This is...”
At this very moment, Lu Wan hugged him directly from behind, her voice soft.
“Husband, we have a child.”
“Are you happy?”
Yang Fan looked at the proof in his hand.
This was a female deity pregnancy testing certificate.
Representing that... Lu Wan was pregnant.
“Happy.”
A smile appeared on Yang Fan’s face, and then he couldn’t help teasing:
“Wan’er, your tummy is really living up to expectations.”
“You got pregnant so quickly.”
Hearing this, a happy smile appeared on Lu Wan’s face.
For gods, conceiving offspring was not an easy matter.
The stronger both parties’ strength and the higher their life level, the lower the probability of wanting to give birth to offspring.
Many High-Order God couples might not be able to have a child even after thousands or tens of thousands of years.
And the time Yang Fan and Lu Wan had been together was not even a year yet.
“In order to conceive this child, I don’t know how many fertility-boosting Heavenly Treasuress and newly developed medicines I’ve eaten!”
Lu Wan rolled her eyes with annoyance.
“From beginning to end, I’m afraid it cost tens of trillions of Divinity Points!”
“This brat hasn’t even been born yet, he’s simply a gold-swallowing beast!”
To conceive a child as soon as possible, Lu Wan indeed spent quite a lot of Divinity Points during this period.
Fortunately, both of their strengths were still at the Low-rank Deity level, so these things could still play a good role.
If their strength were stronger and their life level higher, even if they used the most precious fertility drugs, the effect would be greatly discounted.
“It’s fine!”
“No matter how big the gold-swallowing beast is, we can afford to raise it!”
Yang Fan laughed out loud.
At this moment he was truly happy, not just because he was about to have a child.
More importantly, from the moment Lu Wan conceived the child, he and the Lu Family, one of the Five Great Families, could be considered to truly have an inseparable bond.
In the future, whether it was himself or the development of the Yang Corporation, it would go much smoother because of this.
“Wife Wan’er, now that you’re pregnant, you can no longer overwork yourself.”
“Come, I’ll carry you upstairs.”
Saying that, Yang Fan directly reached out and gently picked Lu Wan up.
“No matter what, I am still a god, how could I be that fragile?” Lu Wan rolled her eyes and said.
“Then I still want to carry you.” Yang Fan said righteously.
Seeing this, Lu Wan could only let him carry her, while a sweet smile couldn’t help but appear on her face.
After sending Lu Wan to the study, Yang Fan then returned alone to the massage room.
Just as he sat down, Yang Da’s voice came into his mind.
Yang Fan’s expression flickered slightly.
The next moment, his consciousness entered the divine kingdom.
Through the video transmitted back from the frontline, he quickly saw the current scene of Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom.
The entire divine kingdom was already battered and scarred.

As those gods supported by the Sima Family completely withdrew their troops, Yang Fan’s zombie army entered Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core area directly in a mighty, unopposed manner like walking through an uninhabited land.
“Master, those gods of the Sima Family could no longer bear the consumption of the war and have all withdrawn their troops.”
“Now, our army has completely occupied the core area of Ma Huainan.”
“The war has been won!”
Yang Da’s tone was filled with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 482: Why? On what grounds?
paragraphs: Hearing this, Yang Fan gently nodded.
“Well done.”
“After this battle ends, let Yang Four and the others begin invading the Divine Kingdom of the Black Armored Beetle Race.”
“Next, warfare and the development of the Divine Kingdom must proceed simultaneously.”
Through this battle, Yang Fan had also gained a clear understanding of the current combat strength of his Divine Kingdom.
Among low-tier deities, his Divine Kingdom could almost be called invincible.
Since that was the case, what he needed to do next was even simpler.
Devour more Divine Kingdom Cores.
On one hand, he could use this to continuously strengthen his own Divine Kingdom talent.
On the other hand, it was also to expand the area of the Divine Kingdom more quickly.
Sustain war through war, keeping his Divine Kingdom in a state of high-speed growth at all times.
The stronger his own strength, the greater his confidence.
At present, he already possessed wealth unimaginable to ordinary deities.
And as the Divine Kingdom continued to develop, the wealth he controlled in the future would only increase more and more.
These things might still be hidden for now, unknown to the outside world.
But who could guarantee the future?
Wealth itself could not guarantee safety.
When wealth reached a certain degree, people would inevitably harbor covetous desires.
What could truly ensure that one was not targeted by others wasn’t how deeply one hid, but rather being strong enough oneself.
“Yes, Master!” Yang Da nodded excitedly.
Inside Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
The remaining believers had completely reached the point of utter exhaustion.
They couldn’t even swallow water anymore, nor could they eat normally, each and every one of them reduced to skin and bones.
Their originally normal skin was now tinged with an eerie dark green.
Clearly, they had been poisoned for too long within this polluted Divine Kingdom.
Now, the remaining believers in the entire Divine Kingdom were even fewer than one million.
And the vast majority of them were in the Martial Disciple Realm.
Those tiered believers simply could not withstand such a harsh environment and had long since died amidst plagues and virulent toxins.
As for the higher-tier believers... they had all perished long ago in that previous tragic battle.
At this final moment, Ma Huainan’s consciousness finally appeared within his own Divine Kingdom.
His conscious phantom floated in the sky, having already become incomparably transparent.
As if a gust of wind blew past, it would completely dissipate.
He looked at his own Divine Kingdom, his eyes filled only with boundless desolation.
After a long silence, Ma Huainan slowly took a breath.
Subsequently, his gaze fell upon the mighty and sprawling army of zombies in the distance.
“The Lu Family... Lu Mingshi...”
His voice was incomparably weak.
“The current me is already a worthless cripple.”
“Before I die... can I see you just once?”
Ma Huainan no longer struggled, nor did he think about how to turn things around; he already harbored a fatal resolve.
Yet until his life reached its end, he still wanted to know an answer.
What on earth did the person who destroyed everything he had look like?
For all these days, the news he received from the outside world had always been just one name—Lu Mingshi.
Aside from that, he didn’t even know what the other party actually looked like.
Therefore, he wanted to take a look with his own eyes, which could also be considered letting himself die with understanding.
The sky of the Divine Kingdom was dead silent, without any spatial fluctuations.
On the earth, the sprawling army of zombies was still steadily advancing.
Facing Ma Huainan’s interrogation, Yang Fan never responded.
“The current me...”
Seeing this, Ma Huainan smiled miserably.
“Even if everything that happened here is fully synchronized to the outside world, I’m afraid no one will speak up for me.”
“What do you even have to worry about?”
Ma Huainan was right.
The current him had his Divine Kingdom Foundation completely destroyed.
The once-prideful SS-rank Divine Kingdom talent had lost its meaning at this moment.

The Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence protected the Peerless Prodigy-level geniuses of the Human race, those existences who possessed infinite potential and could provide immense value for the future of the Human race.
And the current Ma Huainan... his Divine Kingdom was in ruins, his believers were all dead, and his Foundation was completely destroyed.
Under such a state, how could he still be called a Peerless Prodigy?
Unfortunately, Ma Huainan’s final request was destined to fall through after all.
Until now, no deity’s consciousness had descended.
“Good!”
“Good, good, good!”
Ma Huainan suddenly let out a hoarse laugh.
“The dignified Lu Family Heavenly Pride turns out to be nothing more than a cowering rat?”
“Do you not even dare to meet me?”
His voice grew louder and louder.
“Why?”
“What on earth did Yang Fan give you? Is he worth you helping him like this?”
“Where on earth am I inferior to Yang Fan?”
Ma Huainan’s voice had completely spun out of control.
“We both came from small places!”
“He is an SS-rank Hundredfold Time Dilation, and I am an SS-rank Martial God Body!”
“Why?”
“Why is he able to intermarry with the direct-line daughters of two of the Five Great Families at the same time?”
“Why, the moment his father-in-law makes a move, he gifts him a planet of life?”
“Why is he able to casually pull out two hundred trillion Divinity Points to establish his own company?”
“Why does his wife, Lu Wan, want to help him like this?”
“Even sparing no effort to enlist an expert like you to make a move for him!”
One interrogation after another echoed in this dead-silent sky.
Ma Huainan’s eyes were bloodshot.
“I am not resigned!”
“I refuse to accept this!”
“My life has clearly only just begun! I haven’t even seen the true heights yet...”
“On what grounds? On what grounds must it stop right here!”
His voice grew lower and lower.
“On what grounds...”
In the end.
A dignified deity actually hugged his head in the high altitude right in front of his remaining believers, crying bitterly like a gambler who had completely lost everything.
He didn’t understand, nor was he willing to understand, and even less was he willing to accept it.
Yang Fan, who was located in the Divine Kingdom Core, took in this entire scene.
Yet his expression never showed any change at all.
Ma Huainan had indeed lost his value, but this did not mean Yang Fan would show up to mock the other party.
On the contrary, showing up at a time like this was true stupidity.
For an enemy whose death was already doomed, there was simply no need to add any unnecessary risks.
What did it matter to him if an enemy died with eternal regret?
Once Ma Huainan completely died and the Divine Kingdom Core was taken away, this battle would naturally end.

Yang Fan certainly wouldn’t be like the villains in certain storybooks who insisted on running in front of the enemy at the final moment to enjoy the thrill of victory and blurt out a few nonsense words.
That wasn’t being strong; it was increasing risks for oneself.
A true expert had no need whatsoever to prove their strength to a loser.
As for Ma Huainan’s current despair, pain, and unwillingness...
Yang Fan didn’t even have much interest in appreciating it.
Because right from the start, Ma Huainan was merely a stumbling block on his path to becoming a deity.
Now that stone was already trampled underfoot.
Since he had already walked past it, why bother looking back?
The height of life did not lie in how many people you trampled down, but in how far you could continue to walk.
Therefore, Yang Fan simply watched quietly, waiting for this battle to finally end.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 483: A God's Dream
paragraphs: Rumble!
Just at this moment, Yang Fan’s zombie army had already advanced to the core region of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Compared to the outside world, the environment here was obviously much better.
To ensure the survival of his final believers, Ma Huainan had invested a massive amount of resources to improve the environment.
Therefore, the concentration of toxic gas here was relatively low.
Over a million believers.
Regardless of men, women, old, or young, at this moment, all of them picked up the weapons in their hands.
There were no Formations, no precise military deployment, and even quite a few people had trembling legs.
As they looked at the overwhelming zombie army coming from afar, their eyes were filled with terror.
But even so, not a single person stepped back.
They knew they could not win, but they still gripped the weapons in their hands tightly.
Even a mayfly would instinctively struggle when death truly descended.
Let alone... they were humans.
Boom, boom, boom!
Suddenly, above the sky, countless energy cannons rose.
The densely packed muzzle barrels resembled a forest of steel.
The next moment, countless energy beams cut across the sky, raining down like a violent storm, frantically smashing towards the human city below.
“Boom!”
“Boom, boom, boom!”
The earth-shattering sound of explosions instantly resounded through the entire city.
The ground trembled frantically, and buildings collapsed in swathes.
The streets were torn apart by terrifying energy, and the crowd instantly plunged into chaos.
“Run! Run quickly!”
“Help!”
“Daddy! Mommy!”
“Save me...”
Screams, cries, and cries for help resounded from all directions in an instant.
Yet facing such dense energy cannon bombardment, these believers had no ability to resist whatsoever.
Some didn’t even have time to let out a scream before their bodies were instantly annihilated under the terrifying energy impact.
Someone had just hugged the child beside them, only to be fiercely blown away by the aftermath of the explosion the next second, fresh blood scattering across the long street.
Someone was torn apart at the waist by the shockwave, falling into the ruins, never able to get back up again.
House after house collapsed with a crash, and the streets were dyed red with blood.
Within just a few breaths, this place completely transformed into a living hell.
And this was only the beginning.
Countless energy cannons continued to fall, and the explosions never stopped for a moment.
Life after life vanished in this suspense-free war.
Women, men, the elderly, children... no one could escape.
War never stops because of the cries of the weak.
In the face of immense power, life appeared so fragile.
The so-called civilization, family, and hope all became the most worthless things the moment the artillery fire descended.
Ma Huainan stood high in the sky, watching all of this.
His illusory consciousness had become so transparent that it was almost impossible to see clearly.
His final bit of consciousness was rapidly dissipating.
His voice also grew softer and lighter.
“A dream of humble origins rises from dust, accidentally gaining heavenly mandate to enter the azure clouds.”
“In the past, no one asked my surname; when the wind rose overnight, ten thousand people welcomed me.”
“Before triumphant success had gone far, I saw the long sky stained with twilight clouds.”
“If asked what path I came by, if asked what kind of person I was in this life.”
“It was nothing more than a god’s dream; only upon waking did I know the dream wasn’t real.”
The final believer also fell amidst the sky-filling artillery fire.
Boom!
Ma Huainan’s illusory consciousness completely shattered, dissipating between the heaven and earth of the Divine Kingdom.
At the same time, in the Real World.
In the Sima Family villa, Ma Huainan sat quietly inside the room.
The next moment, his body trembled slightly.
Afterwards, his entire body slowly transformed into countless points of light like dust in the wind.
Eventually... completely dissipating into nothingness.
Watching Ma Huainan’s final trace of consciousness completely dissipate.
Yang Fan’s expression remained consistently calm.
“Bring back his Divine Kingdom Core, don’t worry about the rest.”
Yang Da bowed slightly, “Yes, Master.”
After this war, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had long been battered beyond recognition, holding no reclamation value whatsoever.
Now that the war was over, they only needed to withdraw their troops.
After making the arrangements, Yang Fan’s consciousness also withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
Upon returning to reality, he slowly opened his eyes, let out a long breath, and his entire body relaxed quite a bit.
The duration of this Divine Kingdom War was not particularly long.
But without a doubt, this was the war with the largest investment and the fiercest combat Yang Fan had experienced thus far.
And now, with Ma Huainan’s death, it not only represented the end of the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
It also meant that the troubles in the Real World had completely come to an end.
A fallen Peerless Prodigy.
Whether it was the Sima Family or the Federal Government, it was impossible for them to continue investing resources into further investigations.
After all, dead people had no value.
No matter how strong one’s talent once was, after falling, one ultimately became just a name in history.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan leaned back in the massage chair, his expression completely relaxed.
On the other side.
The study on the second floor of the villa where Sima Yurao lived.
At this moment, Sima Yurao was having a video call with Sima Zhao.
Beep——
An intelligent lifeform prompt tone suddenly sounded.
“Master, Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core has been seized.”
“The target’s life aura has vanished, confirmed dead.”
Hearing this news, neither of their faces showed too much surprise.
With the war fought to this point, the outcome was already predetermined.
Under the huge war costs, the gods supported by the Sima Family chose to evacuate, so Ma Huainan’s fate naturally had no suspense.
Sima Yurao was silent for a moment, then gently let out a sigh.
Although she had once felt aversion toward Ma Huainan and even chose to divorce in order to cut her losses.
But after all, the two had once been husband and wife and lived together for a period of time.
Now hearing the news of the other person’s death for real, her heart inevitably felt a trace of complexity.
“Yurao.”
Sima Zhao’s voice was calm.
“Ma Huainan is dead.”
“Back when we divorced, for the sake of decency and not offending each other to death, we didn’t continue appealing to recover the losses.”
“But now that premise no longer exists.”
“He should still have some remaining assets in the Real World.”
“You can sue in the identity of his ex-wife, citing reasons such as issues with asset division during the divorce back then.”
“Take back as much as you can get.”
“Just leave these matters to intelligent lifeform to handle; you don’t need to expend too much energy.”
Sima Yurao nodded, “Understood, Brother.”
Sima Zhao was silent for a moment, and continued:
“Since this matter has completely ended, don’t dwell on the past anymore.”
“After some time, I will personally make a trip to the frontline.”
“You will come with me to see Yang Fan and clear up the previous matters.”
“We can even talk about cooperation.”
Sima Yurao was slightly startled, “Cooperation?”
“That’s right.”
Sima Zhao nodded.
“There are no eternal enemies, only eternal interests.”
“Yang Fan has already proved his influence.”
“With a person like this, try to become friends.”
“Having one more friend is always better than having one more enemy.”
Sima Zhao’s voice remained calm.
The Sima Family’s huge losses this time did not affect his judgment.
A true person in power never looks at temporary gains and losses, but rather the longer-term interests of the future.
“Understood.” Sima Yurao nodded.

sentences.text: Rumble!
Just at this moment, Yang Fan’s zombie army had already advanced to the core region of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Compared to the outside world, the environment here was obviously much better.
To ensure the survival of his final believers, Ma Huainan had invested a massive amount of resources to improve the environment.
Therefore, the concentration of toxic gas here was relatively low.
Over a million believers.
Regardless of men, women, old, or young, at this moment, all of them picked up the weapons in their hands.
There were no Formations, no precise military deployment, and even quite a few people had trembling legs.
As they looked at the overwhelming zombie army coming from afar, their eyes were filled with terror.
But even so, not a single person stepped back.
They knew they could not win, but they still gripped the weapons in their hands tightly.
Even a mayfly would instinctively struggle when death truly descended.
Let alone... they were humans.
Boom, boom, boom!
Suddenly, above the sky, countless energy cannons rose.
The densely packed muzzle barrels resembled a forest of steel.
The next moment, countless energy beams cut across the sky, raining down like a violent storm, frantically smashing towards the human city below.
“Boom!”
“Boom, boom, boom!”
The earth-shattering sound of explosions instantly resounded through the entire city.
The ground trembled frantically, and buildings collapsed in swathes.
The streets were torn apart by terrifying energy, and the crowd instantly plunged into chaos.
“Run!
Run quickly!”
“Help!”
“Daddy!
Mommy!”
“Save me...”
Screams, cries, and cries for help resounded from all directions in an instant.
Yet facing such dense energy cannon bombardment, these believers had no ability to resist whatsoever.
Some didn’t even have time to let out a scream before their bodies were instantly annihilated under the terrifying energy impact.
Someone had just hugged the child beside them, only to be fiercely blown away by the aftermath of the explosion the next second, fresh blood scattering across the long street.
Someone was torn apart at the waist by the shockwave, falling into the ruins, never able to get back up again.
House after house collapsed with a crash, and the streets were dyed red with blood.
Within just a few breaths, this place completely transformed into a living hell.
And this was only the beginning.
Countless energy cannons continued to fall, and the explosions never stopped for a moment.
Life after life vanished in this suspense-free war.
Women, men, the elderly, children... no one could escape.
War never stops because of the cries of the weak.
In the face of immense power, life appeared so fragile.

chapters.title: Chapter 484: Can You Afford to Look Up to Me?
paragraphs: Beep——
With the end of the communication, the room quieted down again.
After a moment, Sima Yurao slowly spoke.
“Contact a legal-type High-tier intelligent lifeform.”
“In my name, investigate the assets left behind by Ma Huainan.”
“See if we can recover some assets from those loan companies.”
“Yes, Master,” the intelligent lifeform responded.
Sima Yurao looked out the window and continued to add:
“The recovered assets... transfer all of them to Ma Huainan’s parents.”
“In addition, take a portion of the funds from there to hire a demigod from the security company in their Starfield.”
“Protect the safety of the two of them.”
The intelligent lifeform noticeably paused for a split second, as if it didn’t expect its master to make such a decision.
At night, Sima Yurao stood by the window, looking at the brilliant starry sky.
After a long while, she opened Feixun.
She found a contact and sent a message.
“I want a male model.”
“Requirement... looks like my ex-husband.”
Not long after the message was sent, the other party replied quickly.
“Young Miss Sima, I wonder what level of strength is needed?”
“We have God-level ones here.”
Sima Yurao looked at the message and replied calmly:
“Demigod, Gods are too expensive.”
The other party replied almost in a second.
“Understood! Young Miss Sima, rest assured.”
“Arranging it immediately.”
The fall of a Peerless Prodigy-tier Human race Genius quickly spread through the Five Great Families.
Although quite a few Sima Family Gods were somewhat unhappy about this, most Gods just shook their heads and didn’t care too much.
Divine Kingdom War was inherently this cruel.
So what if you were a Peerless Prodigy?
When the cost of a war had already exceeded the value one could bring, death was still unavoidable.
A Genius was ultimately just a Genius.
Before growing up, they would die just the same.
In contrast, the other several Families were filled with more shock and curiosity.
After this battle, one person’s name had completely spread through the Five Great Families.
Even those high-and-mighty High-Order Gods had heard this name.
Lu Mingshi!
A shut-in who stayed at home all day and was supported by his parents.
A mama’s boy who seemed to have no prospects in the eyes of the outside world.
No one expected that this seemingly unremarkable man on usual days hid so deeply.
With his own strength, he forcefully beat over a dozen Tier 3 Gods into continuous retreat.
Such terrifying strength naturally made everyone look at him with sidelong glances.
It also made countless people begin to re-examine this Lu Clan Young Master whom they had once ignored for the first time.
Lu Clan territory.
At this moment, Lu Mingshi was leisurely staying in his own room.
However, his Feixun suddenly vibrated crazily.
“Beep, beep, beep...”
“Beep, beep, beep...”
In just a short moment, his friend requests had actually exceeded a thousand!
Lu Mingshi’s mouth twitched slightly, “Are these people crazy?”
He casually opened the friend request list.
Sure enough, there were all sorts of people in it.
“Young Master Lu, I heard that you walk the Corpse Cultivator path. Our company’s main business is Corpse Flowers, rotten bone grass, and other Corpse Cultivator spiritual materials.”
“Our company’s chairman believes that your Divine Kingdom development direction highly aligns with our company’s corporate culture, and hopes to have an in-depth communication with you.”
“The position of the company’s deputy general manager has always been vacant, with a monthly salary of ten thousand Divinity Points. Young Master Lu, what do you think...”
“President Lu, the Immortal Army Soul Stele doesn’t seem to have much use for your Divine Kingdom. I wonder if you have any intention of selling it?”
“The price is definitely fair, and will never let President Lu suffer a loss!”
“Young Master Lu, I am the HR Director of Yuandan Co., Ltd...”
“Big Brother Lu, I am a person from the Qin Family.”
“I heard that Big Brother Lu is still single nowadays, and I wonder if there is a chance to meet...”
Message after message crazily refreshed the screen.
Even after being filtered by the intelligent lifeform, leaving only the most important batch, it still gave Lu Mingshi a headache.
“Reject!”
“Reject all of them for me!”
Lu Mingshi directly selected all with one click.
Afterward, the more he thought about it, the angrier he became.
“Offering such a low price, and you have the nerve to invite me?”
“When my mom used to come to your door asking for help to arrange a job, you said one moment that it was unsuitable, and another moment that the position was full.”
“What? Now you remember me, Lu Mingshi?”
Lu Mingshi sneered.
“Thirty years in the east of the river, thirty years in the west of the river!”
“Can you afford to look up to me now?”
As for those messages actively seeking to go on blind dates with him, they filled Lu Mingshi with even more disgust.
“Still want a blind date? Just a gold-digger!”
“When my mom used to help me arrange blind dates before, which one of them wasn’t putting on an arrogant and bossy attitude?”
“Every single one of them thought walking the Corpse Cultivator path had no future, saying things like it only has input and no output.”
“Now that they think I am awesome, every single one of them has jumped out!”
“Do you have any shame?”
The more Lu Mingshi spoke, the more excited he became.
In the end, he directly selected all with one click and rejected them all!
As the friend requests disappeared one by one.
Lu Mingshi only felt refreshed.
“Ah, comfortable. That’s more like it.”
Right at this moment, the voice of the intelligent lifeform suddenly sounded in his mind.
“Master, Yang Corporation does not have work arrangements.”
“Would you consider choosing a high-paying part-time job?”
“After all, the development of the Divine Kingdom requires consuming a massive amount of resources.”
Hearing this, Lu Mingshi waved his hand.
“Unnecessary. How it was developed before is how it will be developed now.”
“Besides, five hundred thousand Divinity Points a month.”
“When using Mom’s intimate payment, I’m afraid there wasn’t even a fraction of this number, right?”
Thinking of this, the smile on Lu Mingshi’s face became even brighter.
“A person must know how to be content.”
“Any job requires paying a value that matches the income.”
“If you don’t have that capability yourself, don’t force it.”
“Besides, how great is it to work at Yang Corporation?”
“I don’t have to do anything; I just need to take the blame.”
Speaking of this, Lu Mingshi was even somewhat proud.
“Anyway, I have minimal contact with the outside world usually.”
“Even if someone really wants to deduce my Divine Kingdom coordinates, I’m afraid they can’t even gather my basic information completely.”
“This kind of job is simply tailored for me.”
Lu Mingshi patted his own chest.
“I, Lu Mingshi, was born to eat this bowl of rice!”
After saying these words, he couldn’t suppress the corners of his mouth no matter how hard he tried.
This scapegoat he took on not only didn’t cause him a loss, but instead found him a long-term meal ticket!
Without Mom’s intimate payment, he gained an even more stable and generous source of income instead.
A blessing in disguise.
Right at this moment, the intelligent lifeform suddenly spoke.
“Master, your mother sent a message.”
“She said the birthday banquet requires your personal attendance.”
Hearing this, Lu Mingshi’s brows instantly furrowed.
“Just say I am preparing for a new round of Divine Kingdom War and have no time to bother with these trivial matters. Help me reject it.”
Speaking of this, he seemed to remember something else.
“Oh right, please have Mother transfer all the gift money received to me.”
“I won’t look at those gift lists; let Father keep them himself to return gifts.”
“Consider it as me getting married, and he completed a son.”
The intelligent lifeform was silent for a moment.
“Master, do you really want to send such a message?”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 485: God Ling Xuzi
paragraphs: “Of course.”
Lu Mingshi wore a confident expression.
“Nowadays, in their eyes, I am the most outstanding son.”
“How could I still need to act as useless as before, shamelessly tricking them for resources?”
“At a time like this, naturally, I have to act a bit more mature.”
“Yes, Master.” intelligent lifeform responded helplessly.
Early the next morning, morning light spilled through the curtains into the room, and Lu Wan was still fast asleep.
Yang Fan leaned down, gently kissed her forehead, and then sat cross-legged on the bed.
The next moment, his consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom directly.
Inside the Divine Kingdom hall,
aside from Yang Da, Yang Eleven and Ling Xuzi had already been waiting here for a long time.
As Yang Fan’s consciousness descended, expressions of excitement suddenly appeared on the faces of Yang Eleven and Ling Xuzi, and they quickly knelt respectfully to salute.
“Greetings, Master!”
Yang Da likewise bowed in salute.
“Master, all participating believers on the frontline have completely withdrawn to the Eternal Corpse Mine.”
“Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core has also been successfully brought back.”
“In addition, I have used the Divine Kingdom deduction card, utilizing Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core, and deduced the Divine Kingdom coordinates of a total of four gods!”
“Four?” Yang Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.
This quantity was somewhat beyond his expectations.
After all, the deduction probability of Divine Kingdom coordinates had always been pitifully low.
Under normal circumstances, even if one deduced hundreds or even several hundred demigod-Level Divine Kingdom Cores, it might not necessarily deduce the coordinates of a god.
This time, four appeared all at once, which was truly somewhat exaggerated.
Yang Da immediately explained:
“Reporting to Master, these four gods had all dispatched their own believers to enter Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.”
“And after they retreated, Ma Huainan himself was even able to know the Divine Kingdom coordinates of all participating gods.”
“Therefore, the success rate of this deduction was far higher than normal circumstances.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally understood.
But immediately afterward, his heart ached a bit.
If he had known this earlier... he should have directly asked Ma Huainan for these people’s Divine Kingdom coordinates before he died, wasting such a great opportunity for nothing.
But very soon, Yang Fan shook his head.
He was already about to destroy the other party’s Divine Kingdom; how could Ma Huainan honestly tell him the Divine Kingdom coordinates of all his enemies?
“Master.”
Yang Da continued to report:
“According to information comparison, among these four gods, one of them is Sima Yurao.”
“I have temporarily stopped the subsequent deduction work of Mechanical Civilization on Sima Yurao’s Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded.
“Very good. We are currently in the spotlight; temporarily record these coordinates.”
“Within the short term, do not choose to invade.”
Sima Yurao’s identity was too special.
Although in the Federation’s public evaluations she was only a Human Race Prodigy,
after all, she was the daughter of the Sima Family head. If he rashly dispatched the zombie army to invade her Divine Kingdom now,
himself in the Real World would probably immediately face immense pressure.
The risks obviously outweighed the rewards, so there was no need to rush.
Since he already knew the Divine Kingdom coordinates, the other party couldn’t run away.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da immediately acknowledged.
“Master, there is another piece of good news.”
“During this period of time, we have harvested quite a few demigod-Level Divine Kingdom Cores again.”
“I selected some smaller-sized Divine Kingdom Cores from them and handed them to Ling Xuzi.”
“Under the continuous support of the Divine Kingdom’s resources, Ling Xuzi has successfully broken through to a First-Order God!”
As Yang Da’s voice fell, Ling Xuzi’s small head instantly became extremely excited.
“Bang, bang, bang!”
He directly knelt on the ground and kowtowed frantically.
“Thank you, Master, for your cultivation!”
“Without Master, this subordinate would never have had the chance to step into the Realm of gods in this lifetime!”
“From today onwards, this subordinate’s life belongs to Master!”
“If Master tells this subordinate to go east, this subordinate will never go west!”
“Even if the path ahead is a mountain of blades and a sea of fire, this subordinate will never take half a step back!”
“This subordinate will surely pour out everything to fight in all directions for Master!”
“If there is the slightest trace of disloyalty, may my Divine Soul be destroyed and never be reincarnated for all eternity!”
Ling Xuzi spoke until his voice was hoarse, trembling all over with excitement.
For him, becoming a god was something he wouldn’t even dare to imagine in the past.
And all of this was bestowed by Yang Fan.
Nowadays, his loyalty to Yang Fan was almost carved into his bones.
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Very good. Next, Divine Kingdom Wars will become more and more frequent.”
“You will collaborate with Yang Four and the others, and be responsible for invading the Divine Kingdoms of other gods.”
“As long as you can acquire valuable intelligence, your believers will obtain better cultivation resources.”
“Including Earth Core Spirit Milk, all of them can be used as rewards.”
Ling Xuzi’s eyes instantly lit up, “Yes, Master!”
Yang Fan could tell at a glance that the time Ling Xuzi broke through to the god Realm was very short.
Within the other party’s Divine Kingdom nowadays, there were probably not many believers who had truly stepped into the Core Formation Realm.
However, this was not any problem.
As long as resources were sufficient, the strength of those Void Spirit Race believers would inevitably usher in rapid growth.
Divine Kingdom information warfare was equally important.
Divine Kingdom Wars were never purely a comparison of whose believers were more powerful.
Bizarre Formations, mutually destructive methods, and various special Divine Kingdom defense buildings.
As long as these things were known in advance, targeted countermeasures could be arranged.
But if nothing was known and an attack was rashly launched,
even if one’s overall combat power vastly surpassed the opponent’s, it was very likely to suffer heavy losses under the opponent’s trump cards.
Or even end up capsizing in the gutter and losing the entire Divine Kingdom War.
Therefore, even though Yang Fan was extremely confident in his own Divine Kingdom’s combat power now, he still wouldn’t become blindly arrogant because of it.
The stronger one was, the more one should know reverence.
Every war must be treated seriously.
Every detail must be pushed to the extreme of what one could do.
Only in this way could the probability of failure be suppressed to the lowest possible level.
Even if he still failed in the end, he would not regret it.
“This subordinate guarantees to complete the mission, everything for Master’s Divine Kingdom!”
Ling Xuzi excitedly grabbed his chest, his expression incomparably pious.
Regarding this, Yang Fan simply nodded, then cast his gaze toward Yang Eleven at the side.
“You commanded this Divine Kingdom War very well.”
“Next, in addition to continuing to develop the Zombie Kingdom, I will provide you with enough Mechanical Hearts to promote you to a fifth-Level intelligent lifeform.”
Yang Fan said earnestly.
This was something he had already promised Yang Eleven before the war started.
Now that the war had ended, naturally he would not break his promise.
Moreover, as the scale of the Divine Kingdom continued to expand, future wars would only become more and more frequent.
Not only Yang Eleven, but also high-Level intelligent lifeform responsible for warfare such as Yang Four, all needed to gradually upgrade their Levels.

Otherwise, given wars with scales easily reaching tens of billions or hundreds of billions of believers nowadays, even high-Level intelligent lifeform would gradually feel that their computing power was insufficient.
Wanting them to continue undertaking the responsibility of commanding the great army, upgrading their intelligence Level had become imperative.

chapters.title: Chapter 486: Irresistible
paragraphs: “Thank you, Master!”
Yang Eleven’s eyes were filled with excitement.
“Your subordinate only hopes to bring more victories to the Divine Kingdom in the future!”
“Very good.” Yang Fan nodded, “You and Ling Xuzi may withdraw first.”
“Yes, Master.”
The two respectfully saluted, then turned and left the grand hall.
After their figures disappeared, Yang Fan looked toward Yang Da.
“Yang Da, there will be more and more Divine Kingdom Wars in the future.”
“If Yang Four and the others perform meritorious service on the battlefield, grant them more Mechanical Hearts as rewards.”
“The scale of the current wars is too large, and their computing power has already somewhat failed to keep up.”
Yang Fan said in a deep voice.
During this Divine Kingdom War with Ma Huainan, he observed many details.
Especially in the Late Stage, after the deities of the Sima Family arrived with a large number of believers to support, the scale of the battlefield expanded drastically.
Although he ultimately achieved victory relying on his own terrifying logistics capabilities and overwhelming resource reserves.
But Yang Fan also saw the problems within it.
Yang Eleven’s command capability had no problems whatsoever.
Yet facing a massive battlefield where hundreds of billions of believers fought simultaneously, he still exhibited some minor misjudgments.
It’s just that these problems were forcibly covered up by the terrifying resource replenishment capability of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
If it were a deity with insufficient resources, any tiny misjudgment could lead the entire war toward a completely different result.
“Rest assured, Master.”
Yang Da nodded.
“The number of Mechanical Hearts currently stored in the Divine Kingdom is sufficient.”
“Furthermore, the Mechanical Civilization has already begun cultivating intelligent lifeform specifically responsible for war command.”
“After the cultivation is completed, these war-type intelligent lifeform forms can be assigned to various war legions to assist Yang Four and the others in sharing the pressure.”
“In the future, as the scale of the war expands, it can also ensure that every battlefield receives precise control.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded and did not continue speaking further.
Although he was the master of the Divine Kingdom, in terms of details regarding Divine Kingdom development and war management, he ultimately could not compare to intelligent lifeform like Yang Da.
Professional matters should be left to professional people to do.
As a deity, he only needed to control the general direction.
If he personally intervened in everything, it would instead be counterproductive.
Yang Fan slowly raised his hand.
The next moment, the Divine Kingdom Cores stored in the Divine Kingdom’s warehouse were instantly drawn over.
Divine Kingdom Cores exuding powerful auras appeared out of thin air in the center of the grand hall.
Their sheer quantity piled up like a small mountain.
Yang Fan’s gaze gradually grew ardent.
“It is time to enjoy the main course!”
Yang Fan couldn’t help licking his lips, his eyes filled with anticipation and greed.
The size of a Divine Kingdom Core is usually related to the area of its corresponding Divine Kingdom; the larger the Divine Kingdom’s area, the larger the Divine Kingdom Core.
As for its shape and color, they are closely related to the deity’s race and the Divine Kingdom talents they awakened themselves.
Right now, Yang Fan had already accumulated quite a number of Divine Kingdom Cores in his hands.
However, except for the one belonging to Ma Huainan, the rest were all demigod-Level Divine Kingdom Cores.
As for the Divine Kingdom Core belonging to Ma Huainan, it appeared exceptionally special.
It was as tall as a building, crimson red throughout its body, resembling a huge blood-colored crystal.
The entire grand hall could feel the dense blood Qi contained within it, incomparably heavy and majestic.
Yang Fan slowly extended his right hand.
The next moment, within the grand hall, a large number of demigod-Level Divine Kingdom Cores vibrated one after another.
Core after core rose into the air, flying toward Yang Fan, one after another sinking into Yang Fan’s consciousness.
As the Divine Kingdom Cores were continuously absorbed, Yang Fan also closed his eyes slightly, quietly sensing the subtle changes taking place within the Divine Kingdom.
The Divine Kingdom’s area experienced an extremely subtle expansion.
At the same time, under the effect of Origin Evolution, one brand-new Divine Kingdom talent after another surfaced consecutively.
[Level F Talent: Weak Spiritual Qi]
[Level F Talent: Vegetation Affinity]
[Level F Talent: Weakened Poison Resistance]
[Level D Talent: Life Recovery]
[Level D Talent: Elementary Comprehension Enhancement]
[Level D Talent: Flesh and Blood Strengthening]
Divine Kingdom talents of all types were available in complete variety.
Resource-type, Cultivate-type, bloodline-type, environment-type... almost everything was there.
Unfortunately, the Levels of these talents were generally not high, basically all being Level F and Level D.
This was also normal; these Divine Kingdom Cores all came from those demigods on the frontline who made a living by signing contracts with deities.
Their own talents were poor, especially those Alien Demigods, who could basically only provide Yang Fan with Level F Divine Kingdom talents.
However, Yang Fan was not picky either; coming from a small place, he understood best the reasoning that even a mosquito’s leg is meat no matter how small.
After completely absorbing these demigod Divine Kingdom Cores.
Yang Fan’s gaze landed on that huge Divine Kingdom Core of Ma Huainan.
He slowly walked over, then extended his right hand, gently pressing his palm against the surface of the Divine Kingdom Core.
Boom!
The next moment, a boundless Origin energy suddenly erupted from the Divine Kingdom Core.
That force encountered no resistance at all, surging frantically along Yang Fan’s palm into his Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly raised his head.
An unprecedented sense of exhilaration instantly swept through his entire body.
He let out a long breath, and every pore on his body seemed to open up at this moment.
That was not a simple increase in power, but a transformation originating from the level of life.
It was as if some formless shackles originally binding his body and Divine Soul were forcibly stretched open at this moment.
Every single cell seemed to have received the purest nourishment.
Every inch of flesh and blood, every wisp of Mental Strength, was constantly sublimating.
This feeling... was like swallowing the most precious divine medicine in the world in one gulp.
Or like a believer feeding back to themselves after a breakthrough in a major Realm, that ultimate satisfaction gushing from the depths of the soul.
“Awesome!”
Yang Fan couldn’t help muttering softly.
Only by devouring the Divine Kingdom Cores of deities who were at the same Realm as himself could he experience this sense of exhilaration.
Devour others, strengthen oneself.
Thoroughly transforming a deity into nutrients for his own growth.
This feeling... was truly irresistible.
Meanwhile.
Ma Huainan’s long-since dilapidated Divine Kingdom finally welcomed its ultimate collapse.
Rumble!
The earth began to shake frantically, with huge cracks spreading across the entire Divine Kingdom.
Large swathes of the Divine Kingdom’s land began to disintegrate, turning into countless fragments floating in the the void.
There was also a portion of land guided by a formless force.
Traversing space to be slowly absorbed by Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Boom!
A large tract of brand-new land directly embedded itself into the outermost periphery of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Like pieces of a puzzle, they were forcibly pieced together.
Only, these newly expanded lands were at this moment completely incompatible with Yang Fan’s original Divine Kingdom.
The zombie virus left behind by the war still remained within them, and a large amount of vegetation quickly withered as soon as it came into contact with this area.
The originally vibrant earth unexpectedly began to show large patches of grayish-black blemishes.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 487: S-rank Talent Myriad Martial Saint Body
paragraphs: This situation lasted for only a moment.
The next moment, even denser immortal aura surged in from all directions.
Like an invisible tide, it rapidly swept across this newly expanded land.
Hiss, hiss, hiss... Faint corrosive sounds constantly echoed through the air.
Those residual zombie viruses rapidly disintegrated under the scouring of the terrifying immortal aura.
The withered vegetation regained its vitality, and the cracked earth began to slowly heal.
Tender green sprouts broke through the soil one after another.
In less than a moment, this land that had just experienced endless war once again radiated the breath of life.

Within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom right now, hundreds of thousands of S-Level resource-type buildings had been set up, along with tens of millions of Spirit Veins, as well as the continuous conversion of spiritual energy of heaven and earth by the S-Rank Building Heavenly Court.
By now, the concentration of immortal aura throughout the entire Divine Kingdom had long reached an extremely terrifying level.
Under such an environment, mere zombie viruses simply could not hold on for long.
Being completely purified was only a matter of time.
In the blink of an eye, that massive crimson Divine Kingdom Core had been completely absorbed.
Yang Fan stood in the center of the grand hall with his arms slightly open, as if savoring the ultimate transformation of the essence of life from just moments ago.
After a moment, he slowly opened his eyes.
The next second, Yang Fan’s gaze instantly landed on the Divine Kingdom Talent column.
[ S-rank Talent: Myriad Martial Saint Body ]
[ A-Level Talent: Undying Body ]
[ D-Level Talent: Flesh Reinforcement ]
Looking at the newly added [ Myriad Martial Saint Body ] in his Divine Kingdom Talent column, Yang Fan thought to himself that it was just as expected.
Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Talent was the SS-Level [ Martial God Body ]. After Origin Evolution, it had indeed evolved an S-Level martial dao talent for him.
“Yang Da, is there any relevant record of this S-rank Talent [ Myriad Martial Saint Body ] in the Human Federation’s database?” Yang Fan asked.
“Retrieval complete, please take a look, Master.”
As the voice fell.
Yang Da raised his right hand, and a light blue light screen instantly appeared above the grand hall.
[ Myriad Martial Saint Body ]
[ Level: S-Level Divine Kingdom Talent ]
[ Effect: Believers gain the blessing of the Saint Body, comprehensively enhancing Physical Body talent, Qi and blood, Comprehension, and martial dao comprehension. ]
[ When cultivating martial dao Cultivation Methods, efficiency is greatly increased, and the more powerful the martial dao Cultivation Method is, the more its true power can be unleashed. ]
[ Believers possessing this Saint Body possess the ability for martial dao Inheritance. ]

[ When high-tier Martial Artists in the Divine Kingdom die, they can condense their lifelong martial dao comprehension into a Inheritance. After believers with the same Physique accept the Inheritance, they can quickly master the corresponding martial arts and inherit a portion of the strength. ]
[ In Human race history, there are fewer than a hundred gods possessing this Divine Kingdom Talent. Among them, even the weakest in strength has reached the Mid-tier God level. ]
After reading the introduction of the Myriad Martial Saint Body, a trace of surprise flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“This Physique is actually able to let high-tier believers pass down their own martial dao comprehension, and can even inherit a portion of their strength?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow a mouthful of saliva.
“Isn’t this equivalent to Cultivation base initiation?”
“It’s just... why does this Divine Kingdom Talent feel more inclined towards the growth of believers?”
There was a bit of doubt in his tone.

You must know that whether it was Ma Huainan’s SS-Level Divine Kingdom Talent [ Martial God Body ] or Yang Fan’s own A-Level Talent [ Undying Body ], their core function was to strengthen the believers’ own combat power.
Believers possessing these Physiques naturally achieved twice the result with half the effort when practicing martial arts.
But more importantly, on the battlefield, they could rely on this talent to erupt with combat power far surpassing those of the same Level.
However, the [ Myriad Martial Saint Body ] was different; it was more like a talent capable of driving the development of the entire martial dao civilization.
The martial dao comprehension cultivated by a powerful Martial Artist throughout their entire life could still leave behind a Inheritance after death.
Descendant believers accepting the Inheritance could avoid countless detours.
This meant that the development speed of the Martial Route would receive a terrifying boost.
After thinking for just a moment, Yang Fan understood the truly terrifying aspect of the S-rank Talent Myriad Martial Saint Body.
Within his Divine Kingdom right now, the most powerful was naturally the Mechanical Civilization.
The reason was very simple: as long as Resources were sufficient, the development of the Mechanical Civilization could steadily improve.
And what Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom lacked the least was Resources.
Especially after obtaining the Inheritance of the Goddess of Wisdom, the Mechanical Civilization had now become the most core combat power in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
It could even be said that nearly half of the wartime strength of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom currently came from the Mechanical Civilization.
Meanwhile, the development of the Immortal Alliance benefited from the Divine Kingdom investments Yang Fan had made.

Whether it was the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest, the Enlightenment Tea tree, or the Spirit Veins scattered throughout the Divine Kingdom, they were constantly improving the environment of the Divine Kingdom.
Such dense Spiritual Qi was helpful to all Cultivation systems.
But without a doubt, those who benefited the most were still the Cultivation believers.
Therefore, aside from the Mechanical Civilization, the Immortal Alliance had always been the most powerful force in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
In comparison, the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court, which walked the Martial Route, was slightly inferior.
But now, with the S-rank Talent [ Myriad Martial Saint Body ], everything was different.
Those top-tier Martial Artists were no longer just pure combat units.
The fall of a Martial Emperor-level powerhouse meant that the next generation of Martial Artists could quickly inherit his Cultivation experience.
The martial dao knowledge of an era could be passed down to the next generation through this method of Inheritance.
Coupled with the hundred-fold time flow rate of the Divine Kingdom...
Yang Fan even had a premonition that perhaps before long, the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court would be able to catch up with the development speed of the Immortal Alliance.
And even take the lead in giving birth to powerhouses surpassing the Martial Emperor Realm.
“Congratulations, Master. With this Divine Kingdom Talent, the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court will surely usher in a huge boost.” Yang Da was likewise somewhat excited.
Yang Fan nodded.
“That’s right. Although [ Myriad Martial Saint Body ] is only an S-Level Divine Kingdom Talent, to my Divine Kingdom, its value is not necessarily lower than the SS-Level [ Martial God Body ].”
“Under the blessing of the hundred-fold time flow rate, the potential of this talent even surpasses the Martial God Body.”
“Now, let’s begin fusing the talents.”
“I hope this time it can still bring me some surprises.”
As Yang Fan’s voice fell.
His consciousness moved slightly.
The next moment.
Those F-Level and D-Level Divine Kingdom Talents obtained from devouring a large number of demigod Divine Kingdom Cores successively transformed into streaks of pure Origin power.
Under the effect of [ Origin Evolution ], they began to fuse toward higher-Level Divine Kingdom Talents.
The entire process did not last too long.
Just a few breaths later, all the low-Level talents had completed Fusion.
The densely packed F-Level and D-Level talents originally present completely vanished.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
Afterward, he cast his gaze toward his own Divine Kingdom information panel.

The next moment, even denser immortal aura surged in from all directions.
Like an invisible tide, it rapidly swept across this newly expanded land.
Hiss, hiss, hiss...
Faint corrosive sounds constantly echoed through the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Demon Restoration
paragraphs: “God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 11.5 billion square kilometers
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution [First Divine Power: Time Evolution (one hundred times); Second Divine Power: Origin Evolution]
[S-rank Talent Growth of All Things] [A-rank Talent myriad manifestation spiritual body] [A-rank Talent ingenuity] [A-rank Talent Life Reproduction]
[S-rank Talent Myriad Martial Saint Body] [B-rank Talent alchemy Dao spiritual heart] [B-rank Talent formation analysis] [C-rank Talent Soul Seed]

Believers: Nascent Soul (14.53 million), Core Formation (9.8 billion)... Martial Emperor (1.45 million), Martial King (7.7 billion)... Fourth-Class intelligent lifeform (410 million), Third-Class intelligent lifeform (32.2 billion)... White Zombie (2.33 billion)...
Occupations: Alchemist (79.8 billion), Blacksmith (101.1 billion) (capable of batch-crafting A-grade weapons), talisman master (20.2 billion), Formation Master (39.3 billion)...
Dependents: Elven Warriors (17.65 billion)
Techniques: Four Symbols Heaven Evolution Array (B-rank, Mastery)...
Divinity Points: 151 trillion (Real World daily provides 3784 Divinity Points)

Buildings: Fountain of Life X10 million, War God Codex (S-rank), Heavenly Court X8 (S-rank), Goddess of Wisdom (S-rank), Eternal Corpse Mine (S-rank), World Tree (S-rank), Alchemy Spirit World (S-rank), Great Void Warship X254 (S-rank), Mechanical War Puppet X248 (S-rank), God-Slaying Tower X238 (S-rank), Immortal Army Soul Stele X249 (S-rank), Flesh Scourge Mother Nest X258 (S-rank), Sanctuary of Myriad Paths of Evolution X15 (S-rank), Nine Nether River X20 (S-rank), Life Essence Conversion Pool X3 (S-rank), Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest X291,000 (S-rank), Ancient Tree of Enlightenment X198,000 (S-rank), Divine Weapon World-Forging Platform (S-rank), Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers X200 million (A-rank), Spirit Vein X45 million (A-rank), Alchemy Tower X15 million (B-rank), Prison-Suppression Body-Refining Tower X1 million (B-rank), Immortal Cultivation Tower X1 million (B-rank)...
Wonders: World’s Greatest Martial Arts Arena X1 million (deployed), Monument of Myriad Manifestations X1 million, Heavenly Pool X1

Assets: Spirit-Plant Planet X600, mineral vein star X70, destruction fighter 1.0 (), Intelligent Mecha (), fourth-class Smart Weapons X 100 million, Mechanical Heart X10.1 million, Cloning Nutrient Pod X500 billion, war supplies()...”
Yang Fan looked at his Divine Kingdom information panel, and his brows involuntarily furrowed.
Although this Fusion devoured a large amount of demigod-rank Divine Kingdom Cores, the quality of these cores themselves was truly limited.
The Origin provided by those F-rank and D-rank Divine Kingdom Talents was far too weak. After Fusion, most of the talents did not even show obvious changes.
As for the S-rank [Myriad Martial Saint Body], after fusing with the A-rank [Undying Body], Yang Fan could clearly sense that this talent had grown a bit stronger.
But it was still far away from a true qualitative change.
“It seems that wanting to rely on the accumulation of quantity to cause a qualitative change through quantitative change is simply too difficult.”
Yang Fan muttered softly.
“In the future, I still need to find a way to hunt down those alien and Human race powerhouses, or top geniuses.”
However, Yang Fan would not give up collecting the Divine Kingdom Cores of those ordinary demigods because of this.
On one hand, these Divine Kingdom Cores could be used to deduce the Divine Kingdom coordinates of gods.
On the other hand, obtaining these cores cost him almost nothing.
It was nothing more than paying a bit more Divinity Points to make those demigods on the frontline risk their lives for him.
“Yang Da, what is this newly added C-rank Talent [Soul Seed]?” Yang Fan asked quizzically.
“Reporting to Master.”
A large amount of data streams flashed through Yang Da’s eyes, and then it explained:
“Under normal circumstances, if a god’s Physical Body is destroyed in the Real World, their soul will return to their Divine Kingdom and continue to exist by relying on the Divine Kingdom.”
“By the same token, believers in the Divine Kingdom also possess their own souls.”

“It’s just that after ordinary believers die, they have no Divine Kingdom to reside in, and their souls will quickly turn into energy, completely dissipating between the heaven and earth of the Divine Kingdom.”
“And the [Soul Seed] talent can make the residual souls of believers after death more stable and less prone to rapid dissipation.”
“According to the Federal Government database records, this type of soul-type Divine Kingdom talent is extremely rare.”
“Under normal circumstances, when Awakening Divine Kingdoms every year, out of millions of people, one might not necessarily appear.”
“After possessing the soul-type talent, the soul of a believer upon death is more likely to survive.”
“If matched with the corresponding Cultivation Method, theoretically one can attempt to walk the path of the ghost cultivator.”
“Ghost cultivator?” Yang Fan’s brows slightly furrowed.
This was the first time he had heard this name.
Within the Human race Federation, Mechanical, Cultivation, and Martial Arts were the three most mainstream Cultivation Paths.
In addition, there were also quite a few branches derived from the three major routes.

For example, Sword Cultivators and talisman cultivators in the Cultivation Path; bloodline Martial Artists in the Martial Route; the Mechanical Path had also derived different directions such as war weapon tactics, Mechanical modifiers, and intelligent lifeform engineering.
Besides these, there were also some more unorthodox routes, such as Corpse Cultivators, element cultivators, poison cultivators, blood cultivators, etc.
Naturally, people tried these unorthodox routes, but most either had obvious flaws, or the development Resources were too harsh, making it difficult to form a complete Divine Kingdom route.
The ones that could truly occupy the mainstream among the entire Human race were ultimately only those few Great Daos; unorthodox routes were mostly supplementary.
As for the ghost cultivator in Yang Da’s words... Yang Fan had indeed never heard of it.
“Master, please look.”
Yang Da’s eyes immediately shot out a light blue beam of light.
A huge light screen appeared out of thin air in front of Yang Fan.
[Federal soul Cultivation Path Research Archive — Ghost Cultivator Branch]
[Route Attribution: Cultivation Path Branch]
[Realm: Basically consistent with the Cultivation Path]

[Route Overview: Ghost Cultivators are an extremely special soul Cultivation branch within the Cultivation Path. This route takes the soul and Mental Strength as its core, attempting to shake off Physical Body restrictions and continue Cultivation in the form of a soul body.]

[Cultivation Requirements: After a believer dies, the soul usually dissipates in a short time. Only when the Cultivation base before death reaches above the Qi Refining Realm, and possesses a special soul talent and Divine Kingdom environment, will the soul have a higher probability of retaining consciousness after death and attempting to continue Cultivation as a soul body.]

[Route Characteristics: Ghost cultivators excel in Mental Strength and soul power, adept at special methods such as mental attacks, illusions, and soul perception. Some high-order ghost cultivators can ignore conventional Physical Body defenses and cause direct damage to the enemy’s Divine Soul.]

[Route Flaws: The difficulty of cultivating ghost cultivators is extremely high, and the demand for soul-type Heavenly Treasures, special Medicinal Pills, and Divine Kingdom buildings is immense. During their Cultivation process, the soul is extremely vulnerable to damage; once the soul body collapses, the believer will completely die.]

[Talent Requirements: Existing records show that if one wants to develop the ghost cultivator route on a large scale, one at least needs to possess a soul-type Divine Kingdom talent, otherwise it is difficult to preserve the souls of believers for a long time after death.]

[Federal Historical Records: Several High-Order Gods once tried to pioneer the ghost cultivator route, but ultimately all gave up due to excessive consumption of soul-type Resources, lack of core buildings, and overly long believer Cultivation cycles.]

[One of the eighth-tier gods once established a large-scale ghost cultivator experimental Divine Kingdom, investing over millions of trillions of Divinity Points, but ultimately only cultivated three high-order ghost cultivators. Its input-output ratio was far lower than the traditional Cultivation Path. It is recommended to only use it as a supplementary Cultivation Path for small-scale exploration, and it is not recommended to invest a large number of high-order believers for experimentation.]

[Federal Official Advice: Ordinary demigods and gods are not recommended to actively try this route. If the Divine Kingdom has a profound foundation and possesses the corresponding soul-type Divine Kingdom talent, intending to explore new routes for the Human race, small-scale, low-risk experiments can be conducted.]

[If breakthrough results appear in this route in the future, relevant research results can be submitted to the Federal Government. After evaluation by the highest scientific research institution of the Human race, rewards such as military merits, Divinity Points, top Resources, and special permissions will be given based on the value of the results.]
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 489: Chamber of Commerce
paragraphs: After reading the information in the light screen, Yang Fan could not help showing a look of disgust.
“What a mess.”
“It’s actually a Divine Kingdom development path that no predecessors have successfully walked.”
“After devouring so many Divine Kingdom Cores, all kinds of weird talents can really explode out for me.”
Yang Da reminded him from the side:
“Reporting to Master, strictly speaking, the so-called ghost Cultivation path can currently only be considered a theoretical prototype.”

“According to the Human Federation database search, there is currently no god in the entire Human Federation who truly uses ghost Cultivation as the main development direction of their Divine Kingdom.”
“There have long been related discussions in the God Forum.”
“But even with soul-type Divine Kingdom talents, most gods only make small-scale attempts and haven’t truly invested Divine Kingdom Core Resources into it.”
“Got it.” Yang Fan waved his hand.
“Ignore it for now.”
“Right now, after devouring Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core, the area of my Divine Kingdom has also expanded.”
“Buy the buildings that should be bought, and replenish what needs to be replenished.”
“Then let Yang Four reorganize the army.”
“Arrange for Cultivation, Martial Arts, Mechanical, and Elf Race to dispatch together and start invading the Divine Kingdom of the Black Armored Beetle Race.”
“Divine Kingdom development and external expansion, neither side can be delayed.”
“You will uniformly distribute the corresponding wartime Resources.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da nodded and continued, “There is one more matter that needs instruction.”
“Over the past few months, according to Master’s instructions, I have been purchasing various alien S-Rank Building through the Dark Web.”
“Subsequently, I sold them to the Han Family in exchange for military merits.”
“Now the accumulated military merits have reached twenty thousand. Do we need to exchange for some top-tier S-Rank Building?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not hesitate at all.
“Naturally, we do.”
“In the future, you don’t need to ask me for instructions on such matters.”
“Keeping military merits has no meaning at all; exchange them all for top-tier S-Rank Building that can enhance the foundation of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Take [Heavenly Court] and [War God Codex] as the primary exchange targets.”
“In addition, if you find any top-tier S-Rank Building suitable for Mechanical Civilization or the Zombie Kingdom, you can also exchange for them.”
“As long as it has value, don’t be stingy with military merits.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da said respectfully.
After explaining everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
In the Real World, it was only an instant.
On the bed, Lu Wan was still lying quietly, with no sign of waking up at all.
Perhaps because of the pregnancy, the female CEO, who had always maintained a regular schedule these past few days, had also begun to rarely enjoy sleeping in.
Looking at the sleeping Lu Wan, Yang Fan did not disturb her.
He got out of bed lightly, came to the living room, and put on the virtual helmet.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness descended directly into the Virtual World.
Xiling Planet, the headquarters building of the Yang Corporation.
In the Divine Kingdom era, the daily work of the vast majority of gods was already completed in the Virtual World.
However, there were actually not many affairs that truly required gods to handle personally.
The vast majority of transactional work had long been handed over to intelligent lifeform.
It was still very early, and inside the huge building of the Yang Corporation, no divine aura could be felt at all.
Instead, individual intelligent lifeform and robots were still working 24 hours a day without interruption.
Organizing data, analyzing the market, basic auditing.
The entire group was like a huge machine, operating in an orderly manner even without a god presiding over it.
Not long after Yang Fan arrived at the office.
The next moment, Ma Yu’s figure closely followed and descended.
The moment Yang Fan’s consciousness arrived, the group’s intelligent lifeform had already sent a reminder to Ma Yu.
Even though Ma Yu was arranging affairs in his Divine Kingdom at this moment, upon receiving the news, he immediately put down what he was doing and rushed over.
“Master, you are here!”
As soon as Ma Yu appeared, he greeted him with an excited face.
Yang Fan nodded.
“You sent me a message yesterday saying there was a great joy.”
“What is it?”
When receiving Ma Yu’s message on Feixun yesterday, Yang Fan didn’t pay too much attention to it.
No matter how big the joyful event of the Yang Corporation was, in his view, it was nothing more than successfully acquiring another company or earning how many Divinity Points.
To Yang Fan nowadays, these things didn’t have much attraction at all.
After all, when he founded the Yang Corporation back then, his main purpose was not to make money.
But rather to use the group to expand his influence in the Real World, while establishing his own industry and network channels.
As for the profits...
Yang Fan, who possessed a Divine Kingdom investment return rate of nearly a thousand times, really looked down upon the meager Divinity Points currently earned by the Yang Corporation.
“Reporting to Master! This is a tremendous joyful event!”
Ma Yu spoke excitedly.
“A few days ago, a chamber of commerce from the Battlefront Star Sector took the initiative to contact me!”
“The other party is willing to fully acquire assets in the hands of our Yang Corporation such as Earth Core Spirit Milk, Enlightenment Tea, and Spirit Vein at market prices!”
“And the other party also explicitly stated that no matter how much there is, they want all of it!”
Speaking of this, the smile on Ma Yu’s face could hardly be suppressed.
“Now the working capital of the Yang Corporation has skyrocketed to five hundred trillion Divinity Points!”
“How to use it next, please give your instructions, Master!”
Major Starfields basically all have their own chamber of commerce Alliances.
Although the current Yang Corporation is developing at an extremely fast speed and its strength is no longer weak, after all, it was established for too short a time.
Over these days, relying on huge funds and the relationships of the Han Family and Gu Family behind it,
The Yang Corporation has been frantically acquiring equity in various companies, buying living planets, and constantly expanding its own influence.
But when all is said and done, this company currently looks just like a newly rich “upstart”.
Its foundation is not deep, and its channels are limited.
Not to mention the entire Federation, even placed within the Battlefront Star Sector, the Yang Corporation should not be considered a top enterprise.
In the past, most of the group’s business channels still relied on the interpersonal connections Ma Yu had accumulated before.
Now, suddenly a Starfield-level chamber of commerce took the initiative to come knocking, and even begged to cooperate with them.
This feeling, in Ma Yu’s view, was simply like a huge pie suddenly falling from the sky.
Naturally, he wouldn’t think this was his own ability, but simply attributed it to good luck.
But sometimes, luck itself is also a part of strength.
Therefore, Ma Yu naturally couldn’t help feeling a little secretly pleased, and even hoped to get the recognition of his boss, Yang Fan.
“Chamber of Commerce?” A trace of doubt appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“Master, a chamber of commerce and the Virtual World Divine Shop are actually not the same.”
Ma Yu quickly explained.
“The Virtual World Divine Shop is open to all gods, and individuals can also trade Resources.”
“But the Starfield chamber of commerce is different; it mainly targets large enterprises and basically does not accept private transactions.”
“And the threshold for joining is extremely high.”
“The most basic condition is that one must become one of the top 500 enterprises in the Starfield where they are located.”
“In addition, there is a whole set of very complex Aptitude audits and commercial certifications.”
(That’s a Wrap!)
