chapters.title: Chapter 490: Treating Wealth as the Ultimate Goal
paragraphs: Speaking of this, excitement appeared on Ma Yu’s face once again.
“I never expected our luck to be this good.”
“Yang Corporation actually received a direct invitation to join the Battlefront Star Sector Chamber of Commerce, and the entire review process was practically given the green light all the way!”
“Master, with this Resource channel, the circulation efficiency of the company’s goods will be greatly improved in the future.”
“It’s not just about selling goods; for example, the last time Master asked me to procure a large amount of disposable wartime supplies.”
“If we had the chamber of commerce channel back then, we might have been able to complete the procurement in just a few days.”
“And the price might have even been lower!”
Ma Yu became more and more excited as he spoke.
That expression was simply like winning the jackpot.
However, upon hearing this, Yang Fan did not show much excitement and instead directly seized upon one of the key issues.
“Top 500 in the Starfield? Has Yang Corporation met the standard?”
Hearing this, Ma Yu was stunned, then hurriedly shook his head.
“No, Yang Corporation currently chooses not to go public, so it can only be evaluated based on the scale of its net assets.”
“From the perspective of the Real World, Yang Corporation’s ranking in the entire Battlefront Star Sector is probably still thousands of places away.”
Speaking of this, the smile on Ma Yu’s face gradually disappeared, and he calmed down entirely.
Right!
Yang Corporation didn’t even have the basic qualifications to apply to join the chamber of commerce, so why would the other party take the initiative to invite them?
This simply didn’t make sense.
“Ma... Master.”
Ma Yu quickly reacted.
“This matter was probably initiated by one of the matriarchs.”
“It’s just that this subordinate hasn’t received any news yet.”
Failing to meet the requirements, yet being able to receive an active invitation from the Starfield Chamber of Commerce.
Then the only possibility was that a big figure had spoken up behind the scenes for Yang Corporation.
Being able to influence the decision of a Starfield Chamber of Commerce.
Such a figure must at least be a core member of the Five Great Families, and their status and position were definitely not low.
As a result, the answer was already on the verge of coming out.
It was just that whether it was the matriarch of the Lu Clan or the matriarch of the Gu Family...
Ma Yu couldn’t guess.
“It’s fine.”
Yang Fan waved his hand and didn’t care.
“Since Yang Corporation already has this channel, you should use this opportunity to develop well.”
Unlike Ma Yu, Yang Fan had already guessed the person behind the scenes.
High-Order Gods like Lu Yanran and Gu Xuanting naturally wouldn’t personally bother with these minor matters.
Among Gu Le and Lu Wan, only Lu Wan, a girl somewhat infatuated in relationships, would probably silently arrange these matters for him.
As for how many Divinity Points Yang Corporation could actually earn, Yang Fan didn’t actually care.
After all, his current Divine Kingdom’s income was far from comparable to a newly started group company.
However...
The feeling of being quietly kept in someone’s heart and having one’s path paved in secret by them made Yang Fan feel quite nice.
“Aren’t the women cultivated by these Clan all extremely shrewd?”
“How did it happen that someone like Wan’er turned out to be so lovesick?”
Thinking of this, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth couldn’t help but reveal a trace of a smile.
“Master, Yang Corporation is now well-funded and has a stable sales channel through the chamber of commerce.”
“Do you think we should use the group’s funds to continue procuring more Earth Core Spirit Milk from the frontline?”
Ma Yu continued.
“According to what the chamber of commerce staff disclosed, their demand for these Resources is extremely large.”
“Even if we just act as a middleman to earn a 5% profit, this is still a sure-fire business.”
Ma Yu was not stupid; he guessed that Yang Fan must have channels behind him that could continuously supply top-tier Resources such as Earth Core Spirit Milk and Enlightenment Tea.
At this moment, he even began to consider whether to make this kind of channel business the main business of Yang Corporation.
If it were placed in the past, he would never have made such a suggestion.
After all, if all these Resources were piled up in Yang Corporation’s warehouse without circulation value, they would instead occupy a large amount of funds.
But now the situation was completely different; with the chamber of commerce’s channel, Resource turnover was extremely fast.
A Resource transaction of 100 trillion Divinity Points earning only a 5% price difference would still be a profit of 5 trillion Divinity Points.
This money-making speed was much easier than his previous operation of the lending business.
More importantly, the other party was a large-scale chamber of commerce in the entire Battlefront Star Sector, so there was no need to worry about delayed payments or failure to sell.
“Ma Yu.”
Yang Fan suddenly turned his head, his gaze staring straight at the other party.
“What do you think is the most important purpose of establishing a group company in the Real World?”
Hearing this question, Ma Yu had almost no hesitation: “Making money!”
As soon as the words fell, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
“Cough cough...”
“Ma Yu, your ideological awareness still has a lot of room for improvement.”
“Ah?” Ma Yu was stunned, completely failing to understand where he had said something wrong.
Establishing a company in the Real World, purchasing shares, and even going public for financing—wasn’t it all to earn Divinity Points?

Even in a sense, the vast majority of commercial activities in the entire Human Federation were essentially to earn Resources and then feed back into the development of the Divine Kingdom. This was almost the path chosen by all powerful gods.
Such as the top consortium of the Human Federation known for capital—the Lu Corporation.
They held shares in a large number of large enterprises, but the vast majority were mainly equity investments, and they did not directly participate in enterprise management.
The core purpose was to enjoy long-term dividends.
Looking at Ma Yu’s puzzled expression, Yang Fan said with a calm expression.
“Making money is, of course, one of the purposes.”
“But if making money is treated as the sole purpose, then that would be falling to a lower tier.”
“Please enlighten me, Master.” Ma Yu said hurriedly.
Yang Fan slowly stood up and walked to the floor-to-ceiling window.
Looking at the bustling Xiling Planet in the distance, he said with an inscrutable look.
“Within the scope allowed by federal laws, purchasing living planets, acquiring shares of listed companies, and building one’s own business Empire.”
“These things can, of course, make money.”
“Relying on the compound interest effect to continuously expand the scale of assets, and then using funds to continue investing.”
“Ten years, a hundred years, a thousand years—as long as the direction is correct, a company can completely move from weakness to strength.”
“But you must understand. Money itself is not the purpose.”
“Money is just a tool; what is truly important is what money represents behind it.”
Yang Fan turned around, his gaze deep.
“Influence, right to speak, and Resource mobilization capability.”
“These are the things a true expert should pursue.”
“You must remember, money is merely an appendage of power.”
“Possessing wealth does not mean possessing everything.”
“However, with sufficient power, wealth will naturally converge toward you.”
Ma Yu’s expression gradually turned serious.
Yang Fan continued:
“Although I haven’t broken through to become a god for long, I have also read quite a bit of Human race history in the Primordial City Library.”
“Countless gods in the past were once addicted to the returns brought by compound interest.”
“They poured all their Divinity Points into Divine Kingdom investments, or frantically purchased Real World assets.”
“In order to accumulate wealth, they even continuously compressed the cultivation of their own believers.”
“In the short term, they indeed obtained astonishing returns.”
“After ten thousand years, after a hundred thousand years, they accumulated massive wealth.”
“Yet once one day, the Divine Kingdom’s coordinates are exposed and enemies descend.”
“The wealth that those gods painstakingly accumulated for tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years ultimately becomes nothing more than wedding garments for others.”
“There is nothing wrong with wealth.”
“What is wrong is treating wealth as the ultimate goal.”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 491: Really Don't Want to Make Money Anymore
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s voice grew increasingly heavy.
“Therefore, I created the Yang Corporation not to earn Divinity Points.”
“My goal is to make the Yang Corporation a commercial giant that can truly influence the economic landscape of the Human Federation.”
“Step out of the Battlefront Star Sector and enter the core market of the Human Federation.”
“Make the Yang Corporation a presence that all gods in the Federation cannot ignore.”
“Even...”
Yang Fan paused for a moment, a sharp glint flashing through his eyes.
“Let the Yang Clan become the sixth Great Clan of the Human Federation!”
Boom!
At this moment, Ma Yu only felt as if his mind had exploded.
Let the Yang Clan become the sixth Great Clan!
What kind of startling ambition was this?
“Ma Yu, you don’t need to worry about the circulating funds of the Yang Corporation.”
“Use these funds to purchase mature core enterprises, clear government relations, and establish commercial ties with those great families within the Starfield!”
“This is what you truly need to do.”
Yang Fan’s tone was earnest.
“As for how much profit you create for me, it is actually not that important.”
“The Earth Core Spirit Milk and Enlightenment Tea I gave you are not meant for you to sell and then transfer the earned Divinity Points into my Divine Kingdom.”
“I want you to use these Resources to continue expanding the scale of the Yang Corporation!”
At this moment, Ma Yu fell completely silent.
He stood in place, his brain short-circuiting for a moment.
This was completely different from the way of business he had understood in the past.
After a long while, seeing no reply from the other side, Yang Fan continued:
“Think about it carefully.”
“After you figure it out, submit a new development planning report for the Yang Corporation to me.”
After speaking, Yang Fan’s consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
Long after, Ma Yu in the Virtual World finally recovered his senses.
“You injected so much capital, yet you’re asking me to do such illusory things?”
He swallowed hard, his voice even trembling slightly.
“Is this... really reliable?”
Yang Fan’s words just now had indeed made his blood boil.
The sixth Great Clan!
What an imposing goal.
But once he completely calmed down and thought about it carefully...
Ma Yu felt that this matter was utterly ridiculous.
The Five Great Families of the Human Federation have stood tall until now, having experienced who knows how many epochs.
Over such a long period, the layout of the Five Great Families has almost never changed.
Let alone a Yang Corporation that he had just established not long ago.
I’m afraid even those top enterprises and families that have operated for millions of years wouldn’t dare to shout the slogan of becoming the “sixth Great Clan”.
Wealth, power, Genius, and powerhouses are inherently continuously concentrated over time.
This is the instinct of human nature and also the essence of pursuing advantages and avoiding disadvantages.
The more powerful a faction is, the more Resources it can control.
The more Resources there are, the easier it is to Cultivate more powerhouses.
The more powerhouses there are, the more stable the faction becomes.
Under such a cycle, it naturally eventually formed behemoths like the current Five Great Families.
Furthermore, the Five Great Families themselves are extremely enlightened, and will take out massive amounts of Resources to recruit those Genius with different surnames.
Looking across the entire Human Federation.

From small things like the food, clothing, housing, and transportation of ordinary believers, to Cultivate Resources, top-tier Divine Kingdom buildings, weapons of war, and even the control of a large number of living planets, they are all more or less in the hands of the Five Great Families.

Even the two most powerful institutions of the Human race on the surface—the Federal Government and the Virtual Universe Company—how are they not influenced by the Five Great Families through various direct or indirect methods?
Yang Fan’s bold words just now were probably something even those High-Order Gods standing at the top of the Federation might not dare to say.
Thinking of this, Ma Yu couldn’t help letting out a long sigh.
“Could my master... have been having things too easy?”
“Why does it feel like he’s getting a bit carried away?”
He shook his head.
“Sigh, it’s not easy being a working stiff either.”
“One word from the boss, and I have to rewrite the report.”
On the other side, Yang Fan put the virtual helmet aside and muttered softly to himself:
“Compared to the development of the Divine Kingdom, the Yang Corporation is still too slow.”
“It seems I need to urge him more often in the future.”
Ever since the establishment of the Yang Corporation, it had been in a phase of crazy expansion.
Relying on sufficient funds, as well as the connections of the Lu Clan, Gu Family, and other aspects, Ma Yu had almost never stopped external investments.
Every once in a while, he would submit a Yang Corporation development report to Yang Fan.

It detailed which company shares the group had recently acquired, the control of which living planet had been purchased, and even clearly listed the group’s fund flows and estimated yields of various assets.
Especially large fixed assets like living planets.

The report would even incorporate various indicators such as the planet’s future earnings, tax scale, population growth, and industrial layout into the evaluation, and then calculate a reasonable acquisition price.
The report was undeniably detailed.
However... every time, Yang Fan hadn’t looked at it very seriously.
Ma Yu was more like a professional manager.
The responsibility of a professional manager was to purchase the highest quality assets possible at the lowest possible price.
Projects with particularly high yields and exceptionally good transaction values would even be specially marked in red by Ma Yu for Yang Fan to view easily.
This was the mindset of a businessman.
But for Yang Fan now, the thing he lacked the least was Divinity Points.
Even at this moment, various Resources worth over twenty trillion Divinity Points were still lying in his Divine Kingdom warehouse unsold.
He really didn’t want to make money anymore.
Compared to continuing to accumulate Divinity Points, he preferred to use this money in exchange for greater influence.
Just like Lu Wan, a single word could mobilize massive investigation Resources to figure out various information about Ma Huainan and Sima Yurao’s Divine Kingdoms in a short time.
This was what the current Yang Fan truly lacked.
Money, he did not lack.
Influence, connections, and the ability to mobilize various Resources were what he lacked.
It’s just that these words... Yang Fan couldn’t tell Ma Yu.
After all, the fact that he didn’t lack Divinity Points must absolutely not be known by a second person.
Yet Ma Yu, this subordinate, was still racking his brains to save money for him.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help feeling a bit helpless.
Just as Yang Fan was thinking about how to make Ma Yu bolder, a strange sense of comfort suddenly came from the depths of his soul.
With a thought in Yang Fan’s mind, he knew the reason.
Yang Da used the Han Family’s military merit system to exchange for three [Heavenly Courts] and one [War God Codex], and successfully loaded them into the Divine Kingdom.
During the time Yang Fan had left the Divine Kingdom, Yang Four had already begun organizing the troops.
A large number of Mechanical war units, Cultivation believers, Martial Artists, and Elves believers rapidly assembled.
The Divine Kingdom War targeting that Black Armored Beetle Race god officially started.
Regarding this Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan was not prepared to worry about it.
Just an ordinary Foreign Deity, with the wartime strength of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom nowadays, solving such an opponent would not take long at all.
Yang Four and the others would naturally send that Divine Kingdom Core before him.
Having experienced Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom War, Yang Fan could now be said to be full of confidence.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 492: Easing Relations
paragraphs: In the blink of an eye, five days passed.
Virtual World, Yang Corporation headquarters.
Holding a brand-new development planning report, Ma Yu finally came before Yang Fan once more.
“Master.”
“This is the corporation’s development plan, redrafted according to your requirements.”
Yang Fan took the report and began reading it carefully.
Compared to the past, obvious changes had already appeared in this report.
In the past, whenever Yang Corporation engaged in real estate purchases, corporate equity investments, and the acquisition of living planets, its primary consideration was always the rate of return.
Now, many assets that had been directly abandoned in the past due to insufficient profit margins were also beginning to enter the corporation’s investment list.
After reading for a moment, Yang Fan said directly:
“In the future, the bargaining authority for similar assets can be appropriately relaxed.”
“Based on reasonable market prices, I will directly give you a twenty percent bargaining margin.”
“Do not miss valuable assets just to save that bit of return rate.”
“It is already very lenient. Adding another 20%, you might as well just issue loans,” Ma Yu reminded him softly.
“Do as I say.” Yang Fan let out a cold snort.
“Understood, Master.” Ma Yu hurriedly nodded.
Yang Fan continued to add:
“In addition, we must also begin laying out basic industries.”
“The spacecraft industry related to Starfield tourism can be invested in.”
“The construction of spatial wormholes can be invested in.”
“Energy industries such as solar energy, nuclear energy, and atomic energy can be invested in.”
“Even the food industry, whose profit margin has been compressed to within ten percent, can be invested in.”
Ma Yu was slightly stunned.
“Master, these are all extremely mature industries.”
“Their profit margins are low, market competition is fierce, and some can even be considered sunset industries.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“I know.”
“These industries look inconspicuous, and their profits are even pathetically low, but they are truly the capillaries of the entire Human Federation.”
“Spaceships connect cities and living planets, while spatial wormholes connect Starfields and control resource transportation.”
“Food is indispensable to Human race believers.”
“Although the rate of return for these industries is low, they can truly allow us to enter the underlying operating system of Federation society.”
Yang Fan said slowly:

“Once we participate deeply enough, the people we know will naturally increase more and more, the number of times we deal with the government will rise, and commercial dealings with other large forces will also increase.”
“When these industries gradually roll out, what Yang Corporation possesses will no longer just be wealth, but channels, connections, influence, and even the right to speak.”
Yang Fan’s voice was calm, yet it carried an unquestionable power.
“If you want to possess power, you must dare to approach power.”
“A true behemoth is never because a company has the highest profits, but because it makes everyone unable to leave it...”
“Whoever controls food controls Divine Beings; whoever controls energy controls planets; whoever controls currency controls the entire world.”
Hearing Yang Fan’s investment plan, Ma Yu couldn’t help but swallow hard.
“Master, would you like to reconsider?”
“The rate of return for these industries is probably about the same as the monetary funds issued by the Federation!”
“If we invest a large amount of capital according to your requirements, I’m afraid it will be hard to see obvious returns in the short term.”
Yang Fan just glanced at him indifferently.
“Do as I say. You don’t need to worry about the problem of funds.”
“Also, purchase as many living planets as possible.”
“In the name of Yang Corporation, establish schools on these living planets.”
“If you discover young people with outstanding talent, sign cultivation contracts with them in advance.”
Yang Fan’s gaze was calm.
“If the corporation wants to truly grow and develop, it cannot do without talent.”
After leaving these words behind, Yang Fan’s consciousness withdrew from the Virtual World.
Virtual World, Yang Corporation headquarters.
Looking at the vanished Yang Fan, Ma Yu remained silent for a long time.
Afterwards, he slumped down onto his office chair, his face full of helplessness.
“He’s playing for real?”
“Transportation, energy, food...”
“The average annualized return rate of these industries isn’t even ten percent. Isn’t this purely wasting money?”
Ma Yu felt that his career was seemingly about to usher in a major Waterloo.
He was a professional business management deity, and in his cognition, capital should naturally flow to the places with the highest returns.
Now in the Divine Kingdom era, when low-level deities made Divine Kingdom investments, the minimum rate of return was basically above fifty percent.
As for the Real World, even if one simply purchased stocks of those listed companies through the stock exchange, the annualized return rate could generally reach around thirty percent.
Some top technology enterprises, if development went smoothly, could even double in a year.
But those industries Yang Fan had just chosen...
Transportation, energy, and food—these were all mature industries that had developed for countless years, and their profits had long been compressed to the extreme.
Although Yang Corporation’s funds were extremely abundant now, when all was said and done, it was still in its Early Stage of development.
According to normal business logic, shouldn’t they take this opportunity to rapidly expand returns and increase the corporation’s asset scale?
As a result, his own master was good; not only did he not pursue high returns, but instead he went to invest in these sunset industries that even demigods disdained.
“Five hundred trillion Divinity Points...”
Thinking of this, Ma Yu couldn’t help but rub his forehead.
This was a full five hundred trillion!
If they were all poured into these heavy asset industries, I’m afraid not even a single ripple could be stirred up.
Wasn’t this purely wasting resources?
“If that Lu Family matriarch finds out that I used so much capital to invest in these things...”
“Am I really going to resign to take the blame?”
Thinking of this, Ma Yu couldn’t help but shiver.
Real World, Yang Fan took off his virtual helmet.
Just as he came out of the room, he saw Lu Wan walking down the stairs.
“Husband.”
Lu Wan came to his side and said softly.
“I just received a visitor application that requires your approval.”
“Who?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“One of the candidates for the head of the Sima Family, Sima Zhao.”
Lu Wan paused for a moment. “And Sima Yurao.”
Hearing these two names, Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
These two people were naturally not unfamiliar to him.
Especially Sima Zhao.
During the Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom War, the leader who organized the deities of the Sima Family to go support them was none other than this person.
Yang Fan tapped his fingers lightly on the tabletop.
“What is their purpose in visiting at this time?”
Lu Wan walked over and poured Yang Fan a cup of clear tea.
“I have had contact with Sima Zhao a few times.”
“This person is very capable, and almost all of his actions put interests first.”
“Among the younger generation of the Sima Family, he is considered one of the popular candidates for family head.”
Lu Wan explained softly.
“As for why he chose to come over now...”
She smiled slightly.
“Actually, it’s not hard to guess.”
“Ma Huainan once belonged to his lineage.”
“Now that Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom has been destroyed, the biggest conflict of interest between him and us has disappeared.”
“Taking the initiative to visit at this time naturally means he wants to ease relations.”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Apology
paragraphs: Yang Fan nodded, “What is your suggestion?”
“Meet up.”
Lu Wan did not hesitate.
“This person is not even a thousand years old, yet he has already become a Mid-tier God, and he holds shares in quite a few Starfield listed companies.”
“His personal strength, business acumen, and connections are all extremely strong.”
“Now that we have resolved the trouble caused by Ma Huainan, it would naturally be best if we can resolve our grievances.”
Lu Wan smiled and continued.
“Of course, if Husband is not willing to see him, I will decline.”
“No matter what, I will stand by Husband’s side.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help laughing, “I’m not that emotional; having one more friend is always better than having one more enemy.”
“Agree to it.”
At that very moment, a notification sound suddenly came from the smart watch on Lu Wan’s wrist.
Beep——
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “What’s wrong? Who sent the message?”
Lu Wan’s watch was usually kept on silent; unless it was someone particularly important, it wouldn’t actively remind her.
Lu Wan glanced at her watch, a trace of surprise flashing in her eyes.
“This Sima Zhao... is truly formidable.”
Yang Fan was puzzled, “What is it?”
She lowered her head to look at the Feixun message.
“I didn’t reply to him immediately, so he probably guessed that I was discussing it with you, Husband.”
“Therefore... he directly invited a middleman.”
Yang Fan furrowed his brows, “Who?”
Lu Wan looked at him, “Gu Tianyu.”
Hearing this name, a peculiar look flashed across Yang Fan’s eyes.
Lu Wan continued.
“Sima Zhao must have investigated Husband’s network of connections and learned that you have had interactions with Gu Tianyu.”
“Furthermore, he owns shares in Gu Tianyu’s company.”
Yang Fan fell into deep thought.
He naturally remembered the name Gu Tianyu.
Gu Tianyu was an important figure in the business aspect of the Gu Family.
It could even be said that the other party had helped a great deal for Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom to develop to this extent today.
If it weren’t for Gu Tianyu back then, he wouldn’t have had the opportunity to access the Dark Web resource channel at all.
It was just that Yang Fan didn’t expect Sima Zhao to be able to persuade Gu Tianyu to come out and act as this lobbyist.
“It seems... this Sima Zhao really has quite a bit of clout.” Yang Fan said softly.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s face broke into a smile as he instructed:
“Wan’er, since our esteemed guest is coming, we naturally must treat him well! Prepare the finest meals and tea, and make sure we don’t lose our manners.”
“Yes, Husband, I’ll go arrange it right away.” Lu Wan nodded.
Time soon reached the afternoon.
Inside the villa, the smart butler had already made preparations in advance.
Accompanied by a crisp doorbell ring, the robot butler stepped forward and welcomed the two esteemed guests, Sima Zhao and Sima Yurao, inside.
As soon as he stepped into the villa, Sima Zhao revealed a hearty smile and warmly greeted them.
“President Lu, long time no see. I suppose this must be your husband, President Yang?”
His face was full of smiles, and his tone was affectionate, as if the two of them were old friends who hadn’t seen each other for many years.
Before Lu Wan could even introduce them, Yang Fan took the initiative to greet him and said politely,
“Senior Sima, you flatter me. I can’t live up to the title of President Yang; addressing me that way is really too much for me to bear.”
“Hahaha, not at all, not at all.”
Sima Zhao waved his hand and smiled:
“Since we have already become gods, naturally there is no such distinction between Seniors and juniors. However, calling you President Yang is somewhat distant.”
“If you don’t mind, just call me Big Brother!”
Speaking of this, the smile on Sima Zhao’s face grew even brighter.
“Speaking of which, I am actually the biological older brother of that brat Sima Tianci.”
“Greetings, Big Brother Sima.” Yang Fan immediately followed the cue and called out.
For this kind of relationship delivered right to his doorstep, he naturally wouldn’t refuse.
“Haha, good!” Sima Zhao laughed, obviously very satisfied with this.
“Big Brother, please come inside. Hearing that you were coming, we started preparing early in the morning.”
Yang Fan reached out and made a gesture of invitation.
Sima Zhao didn’t stand on ceremony either. He walked straight up, grabbed Yang Fan’s arm in the exact manner of close brothers, and the two walked towards the living room together.
Meanwhile, Sima Yurao, following behind, looked at the scene before her, feeling completely dazed.
“Has this relationship developed this fast?”
“Could it be... that this is the way adults interact with each other?”
Sima Yurao couldn’t help muttering inwardly.
Right at this moment, Lu Wan took the initiative to speak, “Sister Yurao, please come inside.”
“I wouldn’t dare, I wouldn’t dare.”
Sima Yurao hurriedly waved her hands.
What kind of identity Lu Wan had, she was more than clear about in her heart.
Being a figure comparable to her own older brother Sima Zhao, she really didn’t dare to accept this title of “Sister”.
Back then, because of the matter with Ma Huainan, a single sentence from Gu Le could directly kick her out of the board of directors.
And the Lu Wan before her was above Gu Le in both strength and backing influence.
Sima Yurao knew very well that if Sima Zhao hadn’t personally accompanied her today, given her own status, she probably would have faced a closed door.
At the dining table, apart from Sima Yurao appearing somewhat reserved, the rest of them were very casual.
Sima Zhao raised his wine glass and said with a smile:

“Young Brother Yang is young and promising. I’ve heard that Yang Corporation has been developing extremely rapidly recently, and has even joined the chamber of commerce of the Battlefront Star Sector.”
“You flatter me, you flatter me.”
Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hand.
“That’s all for the sake of my wife’s face.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan, who was picking food for Yang Fan on the side, paused slightly in her movements.
“Husband and wife are one, after all.”
Sima Zhao said with a smile.
“Speaking of which, it’s still Younger Brother Yang’s good fortune to be able to get a virtuous wife like President Lu.”
“Unlike the one in my family, who has not even a bit of interest in business matters.”
Speaking of this, Sima Zhao couldn’t help sighing.
Hearing this, Lu Wan smiled and said:
“Sister Han prefers to invest in industries related to Divine Kingdom Secret Realms. Everyone has their own specialty, so it’s normal that she doesn’t like participating in company management.”
“That’s true.” Sima Zhao nodded.
“Speaking of which, my wife and I originally met at the Primordial Academy...”
While eating, several people chatted idly.
As time went on, the initially unfamiliar relationship gradually grew close.
The atmosphere at the entire dining table didn’t look like a first meeting at all; instead, it felt more like a gathering of old friends who hadn’t seen each other for years.
For gods, even if they didn’t eat for several years, it wouldn’t have any impact.
However, if it was purely for enjoying delicious food, given a god’s physique, even swallowing over a thousand catties of food containing massive energy at once wouldn’t cause the slightest burden.
In order to entertain Sima Zhao, Lu Wan also brought out quite a few top-tier ingredients treasured within her Divine Kingdom.
Throughout the meal, chatting and eating as they went, they actually polished off every single delicacy on the table.
After eating and drinking to their hearts’ content.
Sima Zhao leaned back in his chair, a smile still lingering on his face.
However, he imperceptibly gave a wink to Sima Yurao beside him.
Sima Yurao understood instantly.
She took a deep breath, then slowly stood up.
“President... President Yang.”
“What my ex-husband did back then has nothing to do with me.”
“Coming here today, I hope to apologize to you in person.”

chapters.title: Chapter 494: Quite Shameless
paragraphs: After saying that, she lowered her head slightly, adopting an extremely humble posture.
Sima Yurao knew very well in her heart that although Yang Fan was only a First-Order God, she and the other party were simply not on the same level.
A God’s Realm could not fully represent the combat power of a Divine Kingdom.
And the combat power of a Divine Kingdom likewise could not represent the status of a God.
Being able to invite an expert of Lu Mingshi’s level to make a move was enough to prove that Yang Fan possessed terrifying energy behind him.
Moreover, the current Yang Fan could already associate with Sima Zhao as an equal.
Sima Yurao naturally did not dare to offend him.
Seeing this, Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hand and said,
“You are Big Brother Sima Zhao’s younger sister. According to age, I still have to call you Elder Sister. As for the matter concerning Ma Huainan, I also heard about it from others!”
Speaking of this, a trace of helplessness appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“During this period of time, I have suffered quite a bit of groundless suspicion. Today, Big Brother Sima has personally come to visit, so I must explain the matter clearly.”
“Everything Ma Huainan experienced has nothing to do with me. You must believe me.”
Hearing these words, Sima Yurao was directly stunned.
She stared blankly at Yang Fan, her eyes full of confusion.
This... what does this mean?
Why was it completely different from what she had imagined?
Just as Sima Yurao was in a daze, Sima Zhao, who was at the side, raised his wine glass and said with a serious expression,
“I naturally believe Little Brother Yang!”
“In my opinion, this matter is most likely some unfamiliar God sending believers to wander in the Divine Kingdom world, who happened to discover Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.”
“That’s how the subsequent events happened.”
“When all is said and done, everything is just a misunderstanding!”
As Sima Zhao spoke, his gaze fell upon Sima Yurao.
“However, after all, this younger sister of mine entrusted her heart to the wrong person. Even though she divorced Ma Huainan in time, she still had some connection with him after all.”
Speaking of this, Sima Zhao slammed the table fiercely, as if the alcohol had gone to his head.
“In my opinion, that Ma Huainan deserved to die!”
“To actually dare to violate federal law and groundlessly investigate the Divine Kingdom information of a Peerless Prodigy!”
“Big Brother Sima, watch your words!” Hearing this, Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hand.
“No matter what Ma Huainan was like, he was still a Peerless Prodigy of our Human race.”
“His fall is ultimately a huge loss for the entire Human race!”
Speaking of this, a trace of regret appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“For the greater good of the entire Human race, I was previously discussing with Wan’er whether we should do our best to support some war supplies.”
“I just didn’t expect this war to develop so quickly...”
Yang Fan shook his head, the look of regret on his face becoming even more obvious.
“Little Brother Yang is truly righteous!”
Hearing this, a trace of appreciation flashed through Sima Zhao’s eyes.
“If the Five Great Families could have a few more figures like Little Brother Yang, how would those Foreign Deitys dare to offend our Human race!”
After saying this, Sima Zhao took out a document from his bosom and handed it directly in front of Yang Fan.
“That’s right, Little Brother Yang, President Lu.”
“When the two of you got newly married, I failed to send a congratulatory gift in time. Let this be a small token of appreciation from your older brother.”
Yang Fan took the document, and a trace of astonishment instantly flashed through his eyes.
This turned out to be ownership proof of a living planet!
Moreover, the name of this planet was actually somewhat familiar to him.
“Yang Corporation is currently at its peak development period. It’s normal to encounter some stubborn holdouts on certain living planets.”
Sima Zhao smiled and explained.
“Speaking of this Dwarf King Star, it’s quite a coincidence; it just happens to be a living planet under the name of a friend of mine.”
“Hearing that Yang Corporation has been acquiring recently, I am borrowing flowers to present to Buddha and using it as your wedding gift.”
“I hope President Lu and Little Brother Yang will not disdain it.”
Hearing this, a trace of realization instantly flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.
No wonder he felt the name was somewhat familiar.
In the acquisition reports previously submitted to him by Ma Yu, this Dwarf King Star had once been mentioned.
“Big Brother Sima is too polite.”
Yang Fan smiled and accepted the document.
“This living planet is indeed very important to Yang Corporation.”
“However, it is Big Brother’s first time visiting my home as a guest, so I cannot let you return empty-handed.”
Saying that, Yang Fan snapped his fingers.
The next moment, a pale golden metal box appeared out of thin air in his hand.
He casually pushed the metal box in front of Sima Zhao.
“The gift is light, but the affection is heavy.”
Sima Zhao glanced at the metal box in front of him, and without any hesitation, directly reached out and accepted it.
Furthermore, a trace of joy faintly flashed deep within his eyes.
He naturally understood what Yang Fan’s action represented.
Accepting his gift and taking the initiative to offer a return gift, regardless of what was actually inside, meant that Yang Fan was willing to accept his goodwill.
At least, the slight estrangement between the two of them caused by Ma Huainan could be considered completely brushed past from this point on.
Merely a living planet meant nothing at all to Sima Zhao.
Being able to use this opportunity to have one less potential enemy—no matter how one looked at it, this deal was not a loss.
After the dinner party ended, Sima Zhao and Sima Yurao did not continue to linger.
After exchanging a few simple pleasantries, the two of them stood up to take their leave.
Yang Fan personally escorted the two of them to the door.
Until the flying ship slowly ascended, turning into a stream of light that disappeared into the horizon, did Yang Fan turn around and return to the villa.
On the second floor of the villa, in front of the huge floor-to-ceiling window, Yang Fan stood with his hands behind his back, calmly watching that flying ship gradually distance itself.
Inside the flying ship.
Sima Zhao leaned against the seat, unable to help letting out a soft sigh of relief.
A faint smile always hung on his face, and his mood was clearly quite good.
“Brother, can this be considered resolved?”
Sima Yurao sat to the side and asked cautiously.
“Resolved, and it’s even smoother than I imagined!”
Sima Zhao smiled and nodded.
“This fellow named Yang Fan is really...”
Speaking of here, he suddenly stopped.
“Really what?”
Sima Yurao instantly became interested and curiously pursued the question.
“Quite shameless.”
Sima Zhao couldn’t help laughing.
“To actually be able to tell me with a straight face that Ma Huainan’s death has nothing to do with him.”
“This kind of skill to tell barefaced lies with open eyes is truly rare.”
Hearing this, Sima Yurao was also somewhat speechless.
“Brother, what did that Yang Fan give you?”
“Just like Ma Huainan, he came from a small place. I reckon it’s not anything good either.”
Sima Zhao waved his hand indifferently.
“However, what the item is doesn’t matter; as long as relations can be eased, that’s enough.”
As he spoke, he extended his right hand.
The next moment, that pale golden metal box appeared out of thin air in his palm.
This metal box looked small, but in reality, it was a high-tech product of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.
It possessed an extremely massive storage space inside, capable of accommodating a large amount of supplies.
Sima Zhao casually opened the metal box, and his Mental Strength probed into it.
However, just in an instant, the smile on his face froze, and the entire person stayed stunned in place.
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 495: Reasonable Relaxation
paragraphs: “What’s wrong, Brother?” Seeing this, Sima Yurao quickly asked.
“Nothing...”
Sima Zhao was silent for a moment before slowly speaking.
“I just didn’t expect Yang Fan to make such a grand gesture.”
“Inside this... it’s all Enlightenment Tea!”
Speaking of this, even Sima Zhao could not help lowering his voice a bit.
“Its value is probably at least five trillion Divinity Points!”
“F... Five trillion Divinity Points?!” Sima Yurao couldn’t help but gasp, her eyes widening.
She never expected that a gift Yang Fan casually gave out would be of such great value.
The return gift even exceeded the value of Dwarf King Star.
Sima Zhao also wore a complicated expression.
“Five trillion Divinity Points...”
He repeated it in a low voice.
“It seems this person genuinely wants to be on good terms with me. We can interact more in the future.”
Saying this, a flash of sharp light crossed Sima Zhao’s eyes.
Sima Yurao, however, had completely fallen into shock.
Giving away five trillion Divinity Points as a casual gift, how extravagant is that?
At this moment, Sima Yurao suddenly thought of Ma Huainan.
That man who went on a date with her on a Vacation Planet and made her pay the bill after a meal.
Both were Peerless Prodigies, and both came from small places.
Yet why could their mindsets differ by so much?
“No wonder he was able to win the favor of both Gu Le and Lu Wan at the same time.”
“This Yang Fan is truly someone remarkable.”
“A grand vision.”
Sima Zhao was full of admiration.
On the other side, in front of the floor-to-ceiling window.
Yang Fan still stood quietly there, and only chuckled softly after that airship completely vanished at the edge of his vision.
“In this way, my suspicion when invading your sister’s Divine Kingdom in the future should be reduced quite a bit, right?”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth ticked slightly upward.
Although he was not afraid of Sima Zhao, the other party was no ordinary figure.
Sima Zhao’s status in the Sima Family was similar to Sima Tianci’s, but after all, the other party had lived for several centuries longer.
Whether it was his own strength, experience, or his network and influence throughout the entire Human Federation, he was far beyond what Sima Tianci could compare to.
Yang Fan was not afraid of trouble, but there was no need to actively provoke trouble.
At least on the surface, the relationship between both sides still needed to be maintained well.
As for the future... things that needed to be done still had to be done!
Yang Fan turned and left the window, the smile on his face gradually fading.
Ever since Lu Wan became pregnant, Yang Fan had received a stern warning from his mother-in-law, Lu Yanran.
Especially in the very first few months, in order to ensure the safety of the child, certain things had to be restrained.
Facing a mother-in-law with powerful strength and a deep background, Yang Fan could only choose to compromise.
Therefore, during this period of time, Yang Fan could only occasionally head to Heavenly Fragrance Club to find some ways of relaxation to soothe his “wounded” soul.
Of course, with his current strength, this type of consumption was long no longer relaxation in the ordinary sense.
At this moment, inside a top-tier private room in Heavenly Fragrance Club of the Virtual World.
Yang Fan comfortably lay on a special massage chair, wearing a virtual helmet, the corners of his mouth couldn’t help but curve into an arc.
A woman with a bewitching figure knelt in front of Yang Fan.
She looked to be only in her early twenties, but the aura emanating from her had unexpectedly reached the divine level.
At this moment, she lowered her head slightly, wearing a respectful smile on her face.
“Young Master Yang, this humble woman possesses mere willow-like beauty, how could I be worth you spending so lavishly?”
Yang Fan waved his hand casually.
“It’s just some Earth Core Spirit Milk.”
“Next time, remember to help me introduce a few more attendants of the divine Realm.”
For the current Yang Fan, Divinity Points had long been just a number.
The prices for divine-level service personnel at Heavenly Fragrance Club were ridiculously high.
Half a set cost two thousand Divinity Points, and a full set was as high as ten thousand.
Ordinary gods might need to budget carefully for a long time before they could bear to consume occasionally.
But for Yang Fan, it didn’t amount to anything at all.
Even after each session ended, he would additionally give out some tips.
For a time, Yang Fan’s name even spread within the small circles of Heavenly Fragrance Club.
Many female gods knew that this Young Master Yang was extremely generous with his spending.
If those male gods who also came to consume found out, they would probably be unable to help cursing him for driving up the prices.
One night passed.
Yang Fan stretched, took off the virtual helmet, and looked refreshed all over.
“Alright, you may all withdraw. You’ve been massaging all night.”
He waved his hand.
The massage robot in the room immediately bowed in salute and left in an orderly manner.
Yang Fan leaned back in the chair and muttered to himself.
“This shouldn’t count as cheating, right?”
“It’s just a reasonable relaxation.”
“After all, being in a high-pressure state for a long time is bad for one’s mental state.”
“Maintaining a good mental state allows one to handle Divine Kingdom and company affairs more efficiently and create more wealth.”
Thinking of this, the more Yang Fan thought about it, the more reasonable it felt.
“That’s right, everything is to provide Wan’er and the children with a better life.”
Yang Fan straightened his clothes and then came over to sit by the window.
The next moment, he closed his eyes, and his consciousness instantly entered the Divine Kingdom.
During this period of time, because Lu Wan was pregnant and Yang Fan had been ordered to abstain, he had indeed indulged himself a bit rarely.
He hadn’t even paid as much attention to his own Divine Kingdom as before.
Entering the Divine Kingdom once more, he immediately focused his attention on the Black Armored Beetle Race Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
At this moment, above the battlefield.
Martial Artists, Cultivators, intelligent lifeform, Elven Warriors, and the zombie army commanded by Yang Eleven were all thrown into battle.
Powers from different systems coordinated with each other on this Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
The war advanced at an extremely fast speed, almost presenting a one-sided trend.
In less than ten days in the Real World, Yang Fan’s army had already broken through the entire periphery of the Black Armored Beetle Race’s Divine Kingdom.
According to the current speed, in at most a month, there would be a chance to completely breach the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core area.
“Master, you are here.”
Yang Da appeared before Yang Fan immediately and bowed respectfully.
“Report on the current war situation.” Yang Fan spoke indifferently.
“Reporting to Master.”
Yang Da immediately replied.
“In this war, because the opponent is only a First-Order God, the main Divine Kingdom has not invested too much power—less than one-thirtieth of the total force.”
“Among them, apart from some Smart Weapons and war weapons, the main source of troops comes from the believers in the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms.”
“Up to now, the number of lost believers is about twenty billion.”
“However, basically all of the lost ones are low-tier believers.”
“After this war’s consumption, the quality of believers in the five Secret Realms can be further optimized.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded.
Afterwards, utilizing the believers’ vision, he looked toward the battlefield.
Soon, he discovered that these Black Armored Beetle Race were completely different from the ones he encountered back in the demigod stage.
Their bodies presented an extreme deep black color, and their shells were as hard as metal tempered countless times.
On top of that pitch-black carapace, special patterns were densely covered, resembling naturally formed energy circuits that constantly enhanced their defensive capabilities.
These Black Armored Beetle Race were not only huge in number, but also naturally possessed the ability to fly.
The overwhelming swarm of insects surged over like a black tide, making one’s scalp tingle.

chapters.title: Chapter 496: Optimizing Believer Quality
paragraphs: Without deploying S-grade weapons of war, even Yang Fan’s army of believers fell into a certain degree of bitter struggle.
Especially the Elven Warriors, whose arrows were better suited for precision kills against powerful individuals.
Faced with such a terrifyingly populous race, no matter how high the kill efficiency was, it was difficult for them to play a significant role.
In this war, the most eye-catching performance unexpectedly came from the zombie army commanded by Yang Eleven.
Relying on a special zombie virus, a large number of low-tier Black Armored Beetle Race members were infected.
Afterwards, these infected individuals turned around and attacked their own clan.
It could be said that the battle results of the zombie legion in this battle even exceeded the sum of all other legions.
Watching this scene, Yang Fan could not help but say with satisfaction,
“It seems that multi-route development is indeed correct.”
“Facing the previous Angel Race, the Zombie System was clearly suppressed.”
“Yet in this zerg war, the zombie legion was able to play an unexpected role.”
“I really was wise back then to choose comprehensive development.”
If other gods were to see Yang Fan’s confident appearance at this moment, they would probably all want to curse out loud.
Who didn’t know that multi-route development was good?
The problem was...
Where did the Resources come from?
Where did the Divinity Points come from?
Ordinary gods were already stretched thin just cultivating a single system; how could they be like Yang Fan, capable of simultaneously supporting armies of so many routes?
Through the vision of his believers, Yang Fan quietly watched the figures falling in large swaths across the battlefield.
Fresh blood dyed the earth red, and severed limbs were scattered all around.
Yet at this moment, there wasn’t much fluctuation in his heart.
Nowadays, the believer population within his Main Divine Kingdom was approaching a trillion.
And the main force truly committed to the war reached as high as five hundred billion.
Besides that, there were also five Xuan-grade Secret Realms continuously providing troops.
To the current Yang Fan, these believers were increasingly looking like strings of massive numbers.
This did not mean Yang Fan thought they weren’t human.
In fact, these believers similarly possessed their own thoughts and soul.
They would laugh, grieve, feel fear, and fight desperately for their families.
It was just that...
When a person stood high enough and had witnessed too much war and death, how could they possibly continue to equate every believer in front of them with those vibrant people in the Real World?
This wasn’t because the gods were malicious, but rather human nature.
True, good, and beautiful were human nature.
Apathy, cruelty, and even ruthlessness were equally human nature.
The Yang Fan of the past might have felt it a pity when facing the death of believers.
But now, when the deaths of billions, tens of billions, or even hundreds of billions of believers were laid out before him, his emotions had become increasingly detached.
In the eyes of others, this perhaps meant Yang Fan was losing his humanity, becoming more and more like a high and mighty god.

Yet if Yang Fan were to return to the Real World and face his parents, wife, and future children, he would still cherish them, protect them, and do his utmost to provide them with the best life possible.
Because for Yang Fan, those were the people truly closely related to him.
This world was inherently like this.
People standing in high places were destined to be unable to care about the interests of people at the bottom.
People, after all, had to live for themselves first.
Yet in this world, there were always people who liked to drape reality in a cloak of justice, causing people at the bottom to harbor some unrealistic fantasies.
If only the Federal executive officer were a good person!
If only the master of the planet were a good person and could collect a little less tax!
If only an upright and honest official could appear in the Federal Government to drastically lower taxes!
If only a wise Family head could appear among the Five Great Families, one who was truly willing to consider the interests of ordinary people!
But how could the world know...
The so-called superiors inherently served the interest groups behind them.
When a person’s position was high enough, many matters were long no longer simple rights and wrongs, but rather interests.
How could a so-called Sage possibly appear out of thin air?
Applied to the believers of the Divine Kingdom, this principle was even simpler.
Because from the very beginning of their birth, believers possessed an almost instinctive loyalty to their own god.
Just like genetic programming, deep down inside they always believed that gods were good!
Under this circumstance, how could the gods possibly consider them!

And the reason Yang Fan was able to let these believers have their current life was, when all was said and done, because his Evolution Talent was heaven-defying enough, and the Divine Kingdom did not lack Resources.
If it were replaced by ordinary gods, the believers’ lives would probably be even more difficult.
“Yang Da, why not deploy S-grade weapons of war?”
“If the God-Slaying Tower and Immortal Army Soul Stele joined the battlefield, the losses of believers should be able to decrease quite a bit.”
Yang Fan looked toward Yang Da and asked.
“Reporting to Master.”
Yang Da immediately replied.
“After this period of development, the population of the Main Divine Kingdom has gradually tended toward saturation.”
“At the same time, the believers in the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms have also begun large-scale reproduction.”

“After consulting with Yang Yi, we unanimously believe that eliminating a batch of believers with poorer performance through war is instead even more beneficial to the development of the entire Divine Kingdom.”
“In this way, more living space can be freed up, which can further optimize the overall quality of believers.”
While speaking, Yang Da extended his right hand, and a curtain of light suddenly emerged.
“Master, please look.”

“Currently, the average lifespan of the believers in the Main Divine Kingdom has reached around one thousand years, among which believers in the Nascent Soul Realm have even broken through a lifespan of ten thousand years.”
“Viewed as a whole, the population age structure of the Main Divine Kingdom is very healthy.”
“On the contrary, for the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms, because the living environment is relatively harsh, the believers’ willingness to reproduce is not considered high.”
“The reason the current population structure is within a safe range relies mainly on the Main Divine Kingdom continuously supplementing population to the five Secret Realms.”
Yang Da paused for a moment and continued:
“Therefore, I am prepared to solve the problem of population aging in the Secret Realm through war.”
Speaking up to here, Yang Da’s expression even held a trace of regret.
“Master, please forgive this subordinate for speaking bluntly.”
“The strength of this Black Armored Beetle Race is still a bit too weak.”
“According to the current war intensity, the consumption of low-end believers has yet to reach my expectations.”
Although the Black Armored Beetle Race was merely a First-Order God, due to a longer development time, its overall strength was stronger than Ma Huainan, who had broken through to a god not long ago.
Yet the problem was that the opponent was ultimately just an ordinary god.
Behind them, there was no powerful Tier 3 God from the Sima Family acting as external aid.
In today’s war, Yang Da hadn’t even used one-time war supplies, and was already on the verge of winning.
Yang Da even started to consider whether there was fundamentally no need to equip the armies on the frontline with so many Smart Weapons.
After all... the current casualties seemed a bit too low still.
Watching Yang Da’s appearance of deep thought, Yang Fan remained silent for a moment and slowly let out a breath.
“Regarding the development matters of the Divine Kingdom, you all are the professionals, so I won’t interfere too much.”
“However, the ideological work of the believers must be done well. Do you understand my meaning?”
(That’s a Wrap!)

chapters.title: Chapter 497: An Attempt at the Ghost Cultivation Route
paragraphs: “Rest assured, Master!” Yang Da immediately patted his chest, looking completely confident.
“For the believers, the Divine Kingdom War is inherently an absolutely righteous cause, and the protest incident that happened back in the Zombie Kingdom will never occur again!”
“Furthermore, the Divine Kingdom’s Resources are abundant nowadays, and the pension work has always been personally overseen by Yang Yi.”
“Subsequent publicity arrangements such as the Glory Emblems, Merit Badges, and Martyr Families have long been fully implemented.”
“Educational concepts such as “Everything for the Gods” and “Core Values of Believers” have been simultaneously promoted to all major Divine Kingdom schools.”
Yang Da spoke with absolute confidence.
In the present Divine Kingdom, there was simply no need to worry about believers lying flat.
For the deity, the loyalty of the believers itself did not need to be worried about.

Coupled with the fact that Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom’s Resources were rich to the extreme, as long as the believers were willing to work hard to Cultivate, they could basically obtain abundant material conditions and Cultivation Resources.
Under such circumstances, combined with a complete education system, the faith would naturally become increasingly solid, and ideological education would naturally be effortless.
As for those believers who died in battle for the Divine Kingdom War...
Dealing with them turned out to be even simpler in terms of cost.
A stone, engraved with a name, and then selecting a special commemorative day.
Then tell everyone that they sacrificed themselves for the gods, for the Divine Kingdom, and for everyone.
In this way, everything had meaning.
War gained glory, and death possessed value.
Even those who were alive would proactively pass down this glory.
“Very well, this matter is entirely handed over to you to handle.”
Yang Fan nodded, and then continued:
“In addition, remember to notify Li Tianheng’s intelligent lifeform and let him continue to recruit more Subordinate Gods.”
“Nowadays, the coordinates of Foreign Deitys are still too few.”
“Since we already possess sufficient strength, there is naturally no need to stop the expansion of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Yes, the Master is wise!” Yang Da immediately responded respectfully.
Just at this moment, Yang Fan’s gaze suddenly cast towards an area on the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom.
That place was shrouded by a dense layer of black fog, appearing exceptionally mysterious.
As a deity, Yang Fan saw through the situation within the black fog with just a single glance, and hundreds of thousands of believers were actually living inside.
However, these believers were completely different from the living beings in other parts of the Divine Kingdom.
They had no physical bodies, only faint, lingering black figures drifting within the black fog.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan instantly understood.
This was the so-called ghost cultivation.
These believers had long since abandoned their Physical Bodies, existing in the form of soul bodies, and what they Cultivated was also the path of the soul.
As for their feedback to Yang Fan’s true body in the Real World, it was mainly reflected in the aspect of Mental Strength.
However, the number of these ghost cultivation believers was far too few, and their overall strength was also pitifully weak.
Compared to the Divine Kingdom’s current massive Mechanical Civilization, they were completely not on the same order of magnitude.
Even until now, Yang Fan had not noticed that such a batch of special believers had appeared within his Divine Kingdom.
When all was said and done, it was still because his current strength was far too formidable.
The slight increase in Mental Strength brought by hundreds of thousands of weak ghost cultivators was truly negligible to the present Yang Fan.
Feeling Yang Fan’s gaze, Yang Da immediately stepped forward to explain:
“Reporting to Master.”

“After all, the Divine Kingdom now possesses the Soul Seed Talent. After death, the souls of some believers above the Qi Refining Stage and Martial Apprentice Realm will not dissipate immediately, and there is a certain probability of transforming into ghost cultivators.”
“Although in the database of the Human Federation, no deity has ever truly walked this path to success.”

“But considering that the Divine Kingdom’s Resources are extremely abundant nowadays, I bought them related Cultivation Methods and specially designated an area to plant some special Spirit Plants capable of nourishing the soul.”
“Perhaps in future Divine Kingdom Wars, this batch of ghost cultivators can play some special roles.”
“How is the strength of these ghost cultivators?” Yang Fan asked with some curiosity.
Hearing this, Yang Da’s expression suddenly became somewhat awkward.
“Very weak. Since they are currently in a soul-body state without a Physical Body as a support, they will die when subjected to various energy attacks.”
“A ghost cultivator in the Qi Refining Realm might not even be a match for ordinary Tiered Being under normal circumstances.”
“So weak?” Yang Fan’s face couldn’t help but twitch.
At this moment, he finally understood somewhat why none of the Human race’s deities had truly walked this path to success.
To put it bluntly...
Without seeing any output, who would be willing to invest?
Investing a large amount of Resources, the thing cultivated in the end is still not as good as an ordinary ranked being.
Normal deities would probably have abandoned this route long ago.
“Currently, I have already let Yang Yi conduct related research through various channels.”
Yang Da continued:
“If there is any breakthrough progress, I will definitely report it to the Master at the first instance.”

If it were not for the fact that the Divine Kingdom’s Resources were now so abundant as to be nearly inexhaustible, Yang Da, the highest intelligent lifeform of the Divine Kingdom, would have long since abandoned this batch of ghost cultivation believers without hesitation.
After all, one of the reasons for his existence was to maximize the interests of the Divine Kingdom.
However, since the Divine Kingdom’s Resources were too endless to use up anyway, taking out a small amount of Resources to research ghost cultivation couldn’t be considered any loss at all.
In the remote case that some special ability was truly researched out, that would be a massive profit.
Even if nothing was researched in the end...
This bit of investment was merely a drop in the bucket for the current Divine Kingdom.
“Fine, do as you see fit.” Yang Fan waved his hand indifferently.
His thoughts were similar to Yang Da’s.
If it fails, give up anyway; if it truly succeeds, continue investing.
This was just like investing in a startup company.
A normal person investing would naturally have to consider risks.
But if one’s own capital was sufficiently robust, one could completely cast a wide net.
Losing a few projects didn’t matter at all.
As long as one of them truly grew up, it would be enough to earn back all previous losses completely.
For the present Yang Fan, it was the exact same reasoning.
In fact, he wished that Yang Da could continue to pull off some fancy tricks and invest more Divinity Points into the Divine Kingdom.
After all... the Divine Kingdom’s current income was simply terrifying.
Having instructed everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.
The days that followed returned to peace once again.
Life at the frontline did not have too many ripples.
The war against the Black Armored Beetle Race’s Divine Kingdom was still steadily advancing, and Yang Fan himself no longer paid excessive attention to the battlefield details.
For him now, he would not worry about the big and small matters of the Divine Kingdom; he only cared about the macro-direction development of the Divine Kingdom.
Under the effect of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the believers were also continuously growing according to the established trajectory.
Time slowly passed.
One month’s time quickly passed.
As for the Divine Kingdom, a full three thousand years had passed once again.
The proportion of high-order believers among various factions in the Divine Kingdom was getting higher and higher.
Especially the path of Martial Arts, after thousands of years of development, the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court had already begun to show a trend of surpassing the Immortal Alliance.
A large number of newborn believers displayed extremely high Martial Arts talent at the time of birth.
Among them, there was no lack of those who awakened the Myriad Martial Saint Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 498: Realm Classifications of Believers
paragraphs: In three thousand years, the number of Martial Emperor Realm powerhouses in Myriad Phenomena Martial Court had already exceeded ten million!
This was the terrifying aspect of the S-rank Talent Myriad Martial Saint Body; the growth speed of believers walking the martial path was more than twice as fast.
The development of Myriad Phenomena Martial Court brought a pleasant surprise to Yang Fan.
This Myriad Martial Saint Body was the first S-rank Talent he possessed so far that was directly related to the Cultivation of believers.
Whether it was his SSS-rank Evolution Talent or his current S-rank Talent Growth of All Things, their greatest purpose was ultimately divine kingdom investment, not believer growth.
Only now did Yang Fan finally understand why the Federal Government directly evaluated students with S-rank Divine Kingdom Talents as ‘Human race Prodigies’.
Given the same resource investment and growth time, believers with S-rank Cultivation talents grew infinitely faster!
Back then, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom had the advantage of hundred-fold Time Evolution, yet in that spar against Ma Huainan at Primordial Academy, it was still an exceptionally difficult fight.
Now, just one Myriad Martial Saint Body had brought such a noticeable boost to the believers’ Cultivation speed.
If it were replaced with the SS-rank Martial God Body, its effect would likely be even more terrifying.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel emotional.
“The number of high-order believers is growing faster and faster.”
“Unfortunately, still no believer has been able to break through to the next Realm.”
Yang Fan sighed, sipping tea while asking in his mind.
“Yang Da, isn’t the restriction of the divine kingdom rules a bit too ridiculous?”
“Forget about believers on the Cultivation Path or Martial Route.”
“As for the Mechanical Path, there are already over five hundred million tier-four intelligent lifeform forms now, so why hasn’t a single one broken through?”
Whenever a believer broke through to a brand-new Realm, the rules of the divine kingdom would be further perfected.
And as the god, Yang Fan’s Physical Body and soul in reality would also receive a massive feedback.
Therefore, Yang Fan was greatly looking forward to believers breaking through to higher Realms.
He originally thought that the birth of the first tier-five intelligent lifeform form wasn’t far off.
But several months had passed, and there was still no movement whatsoever.
Yang Da’s voice soon sounded in his mind.
“Master, you are currently only a First-Order God.”
“Taking the Cultivation Path as an example, a normal First-Order God’s high-order believers in their divine kingdom should be in the Foundation Establishment Realm.”
“As for believers in the Core Formation Realm, in the divine kingdoms of most First-Order Gods, they already belong to the level of legion generals.”
“Yet in Master’s current Immortal Alliance, the number of Nascent Soul Realm believers has already exceeded ten million.”
Speaking up to this point, Yang Da’s tone also carried a hint of emotional sigh.
“That Master’s divine kingdom could achieve its current development speed, besides the hundred-fold time flow, the more important factor is the environment of the divine kingdom itself.”
“A divine kingdom is actually like a small world that grows continuously. The smaller the divine kingdom, the less complete its internal rules, making breakthroughs harder.”
“And the environment of the divine kingdom can help believers Cultivate, increasing the probability of breaking through the rules of heaven and earth.”
“Some gods’ divine kingdoms are merely mortal domains with sparse Spiritual Qi, while others are Cultivation dao arenas abundant in Spiritual Qi.”
“Whereas Master’s divine kingdom...”
Yang Da paused for a moment.
“...is more like a top-tier blessed sanctuary.”
“It is precisely because of this that Master, as a First-Order God, can possess such a number of high-order believers.”
Yang Da then gave an even more vivid metaphor.
“If we compare the growth of believers to a road leading from the starting point to the destination,”
“then the environment of the divine kingdom is the vehicle. The better the vehicle, the faster the believers naturally travel.”
“Meanwhile, the rules of the divine kingdom are more like the road itself.”
“If the road ahead is broken, then no matter how good the vehicle is, it is of no use.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan sank into thought.
“In other words, no matter how hard they try right now, it’s impossible to produce a believer in the Spirit Severing Realm?”
“Not necessarily,” Yang Da answered immediately.
“Back when Master was still at the Demigod stage, believers in the Core Formation Realm had already been born in your divine kingdom.”
“It’s just that the probability of that happening at the time was extremely low.”
“Although the overall rules of the divine kingdom are much more complete now than before, the difficulty of giving birth to a believer in the Spirit Severing Realm will only be greater.”
At this point, Yang Da’s voice came through again.
“Additionally, Master may have some misunderstandings regarding the believer combat strength possessed by gods of different tiers.”
“Gods are divided into tiers one through nine based on the area of their divine kingdom.”

“As for the believer Realms of the Cultivation Path, they are Qi Refining, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, Spirit Severing, Void Refinement, Body Integration, Grand Ascension, and Transcending Tribulation.”
“The Martial Route consists of Martial Apprentice, Martial Master, Martial King, Martial Emperor, Martial God, Martial Saint, Divine Martial, God King, and God Emperor.”
“The Mechanical Path corresponds to tier-one through tier-nine intelligent lifeform forms.”
“These are the believer classifications for the three most common development routes among all human gods currently.”
“And for a normal First-Order God, the core combat power of their divine kingdom should typically be believers in the Qi Refining Realm.”
As Yang Da finished speaking,
in the Real World, Yang Fan couldn’t help himself and coughed twice.
The tea in his hand spilled directly onto the tabletop because of this.
“Are you kidding me?”
“To break through to a Demigod, one already needs to have believers in the Qi Refining Realm, right?”
“They’ve become First-Order Gods, yet their core combat power is still just Qi Refining?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
What Yang Da said sounded far too ridiculous to him.
“This subordinate is referring to the core combat power of the divine kingdom, not high-order believers,”
Yang Da explained patiently.

“According to statistics in the federal database, whether human or foreign race, among First-Order Gods, divine kingdoms with Qi Refining Realm believers as their core combat power account for as high as seventy percent.”

“As for a small number of Foundation Establishment or even Core Formation Realm believers, for a Divine Kingdom War involving tens of billions of believers at every turn, it is difficult for them to decide the final outcome.”

“Back when Han Jue and I went to reclaim the Earth-grade Secret Realm, their believers’ combat power wasn’t weak at all; they were mostly in the Foundation Establishment Realm, and many had already reached Core Formation!”
Yang Fan couldn’t help saying, remembering his past experience.
“Master, you come from Primordial Academy, and people like Han Jue and Qin Zheng not only possess SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talents, but are also core geniuses of the Five Great Families.”
Yang Da explained patiently,
“They were never ordinary gods to begin with.”
“Furthermore, Secret Realm reclamation is different from a Divine Kingdom War.”

“According to my deduction, when they participated in the reclamation back then, what they mobilized was likely the top tier of combat power in their respective divine kingdoms, not the average level of the entire divine kingdom.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully.
He then set his teacup down on the table.

“Then the Nascent Soul and Martial Emperor Realm believers in my divine kingdom have already exceeded ten million, and tier-four intelligent lifeform forms are as high as five hundred million—does this count as core combat power?”
“Yes, it counts.”
(That’s a Wrap!)
