chapters.title: Chapter 499: Sudden Attack
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s eyes lit up slightly.
“According to what you said, isn’t my current true combat strength already comparable to a Tier 4 God?”
“There is indeed still some deficiency in terms of population scale.”
Yang Da was silent for a moment, then gave his judgment.
“However, according to my evaluation, Master’s current divine kingdom combat strength is completely sufficient to fight an ordinary Tier 4 God head-on.”
“If we also equip the disposable wartime Resources of the current divine kingdom, even when facing a fifth-order or even sixth-order god, we can at least remain undefeated.”
“Ahem...”
Yang Fan couldn’t help letting out a couple of dry coughs, his face full of strangeness.
“Aren’t you getting a bit inflated? This is simply too exaggerated!”
“Master, you can understand it from another perspective.”
Yang Da, however, was very calm.

“Like Han Jue, a core prodigy of the Five Great Families, even if he breaks through to a Mid-tier God a hundred or even a thousand years later, his divine kingdom will most likely not be as wealthy as Master’s is now.”
“Five hundred thousand S-grade resource-type buildings.”
“This scale of wealth, even among Mid-tier Gods, can only be possessed by a very few top-tier existences.”
Speaking up to this point, Yang Da’s tone paused.
“I ask Master to correctly recognize his own strength, and suggest browsing the God Forum more often in ordinary times.”
“You must know that there are quite a few First-Order Gods who are living rather frugally, and are even still operating B-grade or even C-grade Spirit Plant businesses nowadays.”
This time, Yang Fan even heard a trace of faint speechlessness from Yang Da’s tone.
Clearly, in Yang Da’s view, Yang Fan’s perception of his own wealth and strength had somewhat of a deviation.
Actually, this couldn’t be blamed on Yang Fan either.
Ever since leaving Yang County, he quickly met Sima Bang at the Primordial Academy.
Right after that, he made a startling debut in the God-Sealing Tournament of Prodigies, catching the eye of the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Families.
In just a few short years, he stepped from an ordinary person into the most core position of the younger generation of the Human Federation in one step.
This huge disparity in status was simply too fast.
What’s more, Yang Fan’s own personality tended towards caution. When encountering things, he would lay low if possible, subconsciously always liking to overestimate his enemies.
Under such circumstances, it was not surprising that he produced some misjudgments about his own true strength.
“Understood.”
Yang Fan nodded gently, then felt somewhat helpless.
“I naturally know that the most important thing right now is to continuously expand the area of the divine kingdom.”
“But this deduction of divine coordinates is simply too metaphysical.”
“The Black Armored Beetle Race is almost about to be resolved, and yet we still haven’t found the coordinates of a new Foreign Deity?”
Speaking up to this point, Yang Fan couldn’t help sighing.
Right now, besides this Black Armored Beetle Race, he also held the divine kingdom coordinates of four human gods in his hands.
It was just that these four coordinates could not be moved temporarily.
The reason was very simple.
Once believers of the three major systems of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical invade these people’s divine kingdoms, they would inevitably leave behind a large number of clues.
Yang Fan certainly didn’t dare to look down on the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
Ever since Awakening his divine kingdom, he had participated in quite a few Divine Kingdom Simulation Battles and ranking matches.
After entering the Primordial Academy, he had experienced a massive amount of slaughter on the Primordial Battlefield even more.
The growth of believers had always been systematic.
The Cultivation Methods they practiced, the Formations they used, the Martial Techniques they mastered, and the equipment on their bodies were all traceable.
Once the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence carried out reverse deduction, it might not be impossible for it to lock onto him.
This was also the fundamental reason why Yang Fan hadn’t touched those four coordinates.
As for sending zombies to invade, that wouldn’t work either.
How long had it passed since Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom was destroyed?

Sending out the zombie legion to invade other people’s divine kingdoms at this time—let alone Sima Yurao, even if the other three gods with somewhat ordinary identities suddenly encountered this situation, the outside world would probably make associations at the very first moment.
Dealing with Ma Huainan back then could still be understood in the eyes of other gods.
Because Ma Huainan took the initiative to investigate his divine kingdom information, the two sides were mortal enemies to begin with.
As long as there was no evidence on the surface, even the Sima Family could only game at the level of the divine kingdom.
If they lost, everyone would acknowledge it. Who told Ma Huainan to court death by himself!
Putting oneself in another’s shoes, if Ma Huainan went to investigate Sima Zhao’s divine kingdom information, the other party would probably also find an opportunity to resolve him.
But if Yang Fan chose to invade someone else at this moment, then the Sima Family probably wouldn’t let the matter rest.
Not invading Foreign Deitys, but infighting every day.
By that time, I’m afraid even Lu Mingshi might not be able to withstand the pressure from all sides anymore.
Yang Fan was certainly unwilling to become the target of public criticism for just a few Divine Kingdom Cores.
Therefore, the only thing he could do right now was to wait.
Wait ten or twenty years.
Wait until the storm brought by Ma Huainan’s death completely subsided, and then figure out a way to deal with the divine kingdoms of the other three; it would be much safer.
As for Sima Yurao...
Yang Fan had to be even more cautious.
Although a Divine Kingdom Core was precious, one still had to see whether the risks and benefits matched.
The coordinates being deduced only represented that he possessed the qualification to choose.
As for whether or not to invade, one still had to consider all kinds of influences in the Real World.
The safest method was either to destroy the other party’s Physical Body in the Real World in advance, making her completely lose contact with the outside world.
Or else, one must possess 100% certainty to ensure that the Sima Family could never pin their suspicions on him no matter what.
Otherwise... to risk exposing his huge risks for a Divine Kingdom Core was truly unnecessary.
Yang Fan didn’t lack patience.
For him nowadays, what was truly important wasn’t short-term huge benefits.
As long as he behaved himself and lived long enough, his advantages would naturally become larger and larger.
“Yang Da, how much longer does the divine kingdom of the Black Armored Beetle Race need?”
Yang Fan asked suddenly.
“Reporting to Master, within a year, we will definitely be able to bring back its Divine Kingdom Core.”
“A year?”
Yang Fan nodded, then asked again: “Are there any other gods supporting them?”
“None.” Yang Da shook his head.
Hearing this, a trace of regret couldn’t help but appear on Yang Fan’s face.
He originally thought he could scavenge a few more Divine Kingdom Cores, but he didn’t expect that there were actually no other reinforcements behind this Black Armored Beetle Race.
“Fine then.” Yang Fan waved his hand, too lazy to continue paying attention.
Anyway, this war was already a nailed-down matter.
The next moment, he lay back down and closed his eyes, continuing to enjoy this rare moment of leisure in the afternoon.
Yet right at this moment, the wristwatch on his wrist suddenly vibrated.
Beep beep!
Yang Fan’s brow slightly twitched, and he raised his wrist to take a look.
The next moment, his entire person abruptly sat up from the massage chair.
“Damn! What a sudden attack!”
Seen on the wristwatch, it was impressively a Feixun message from Gu Le.
[Cheng Ye and I have arrived, ‘Daddy’ come pick us up.]
Seeing these words, Yang Fan immediately remembered.
A few days ago in the Virtual World, Gu Le had already reminded him that she had officially graduated and was about to come to the frontline soon.
It was just that Yang Fan had been playing too high these past few days, and actually threw this matter to the back of his mind.

“There is indeed still some deficiency in terms of population scale.”
Yang Da was silent for a moment, then gave his judgment.

“Ahem...”
Yang Fan couldn’t help letting out a couple of dry coughs, his face full of strangeness.
“Aren’t you getting a bit inflated?
This is simply too exaggerated!”
“Master, you can understand it from another perspective.”
Yang Da, however, was very calm.

“Five hundred thousand S-grade resource-type buildings.”
“This scale of wealth, even among Mid-tier Gods, can only be possessed by a very few top-tier existences.”
Speaking up to this point, Yang Da’s tone paused.
“I ask Master to correctly recognize his own strength, and suggest browsing the God Forum more often in ordinary times.”
“You must know that there are quite a few First-Order Gods who are living rather frugally, and are even still operating B-grade or even C-grade Spirit Plant businesses nowadays.”
This time, Yang Fan even heard a trace of faint speechlessness from Yang Da’s tone.
Clearly, in Yang Da’s view, Yang Fan’s perception of his own wealth and strength had somewhat of a deviation.
Actually, this couldn’t be blamed on Yang Fan either.
Ever since leaving Yang County, he quickly met Sima Bang at the Primordial Academy.
Right after that, he made a startling debut in the God-Sealing Tournament of Prodigies, catching the eye of the Gu Family, one of the Five Great Families.
In just a few short years, he stepped from an ordinary person into the most core position of the younger generation of the Human Federation in one step.
This huge disparity in status was simply too fast.
What’s more, Yang Fan’s own personality tended towards caution.
When encountering things, he would lay low if possible, subconsciously always liking to overestimate his enemies.
Under such circumstances, it was not surprising that he produced some misjudgments about his own true strength.
“Understood.”
Yang Fan nodded gently, then felt somewhat helpless.
“I naturally know that the most important thing right now is to continuously expand the area of the divine kingdom.”
“But this deduction of divine coordinates is simply too metaphysical.”

Speaking up to this point, Yang Fan couldn’t help sighing.
Right now, besides this Black Armored Beetle Race, he also held the divine kingdom coordinates of four human gods in his hands.

Once believers of the three major systems of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical invade these people’s divine kingdoms, they would inevitably leave behind a large number of clues.

Ever since Awakening his divine kingdom, he had participated in quite a few Divine Kingdom Simulation Battles and ranking matches.
After entering the Primordial Academy, he had experienced a massive amount of slaughter on the Primordial Battlefield even more.
The growth of believers had always been systematic.
The Cultivation Methods they practiced, the Formations they used, the Martial Techniques they mastered, and the equipment on their bodies were all traceable.
Once the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence carried out reverse deduction, it might not be impossible for it to lock onto him.

chapters.title: Chapter 500: A Harmonious Family
paragraphs: After boarding the flying ship, Yang Fan directly turned the power up to maximum and sped all the way according to the navigation.
Soon, the flying ship arrived at the spaceship docking area of the frontline.
Yang Fan walked down from the flying ship and looked around.
“Not here yet!”
Seeing this, he suddenly let out a soft sigh of relief. “Good thing I’m not late.”
Gu Le is not as magnanimous as Lu Wan.
This girl usually looks carefree, but in reality, she is very meticulous. Occasionally, she would throw minor tempers at him and get a little jealous.
Now that she had just arrived at the frontline, if he left her hanging here... Just thinking about it gave Yang Fan a headache.
Anyway, there is nothing particularly important right now, so he still needs to take good care of his wife’s emotions.
After all... a harmonious family brings prosperity to everything.
“Brother-in-law, quite punctual!”
Right at this moment, a familiar voice suddenly came from behind Yang Fan.
He turned around and sure enough, he saw Gu Jiuheng.
“Cousin.” Yang Fan greeted politely.
“I am also here to pick up Cousin Gu Le.”
Gu Jiuheng smiled.
“The Third Elder has already arranged a residence for her in advance. Brother-in-law must spend more time accompanying my cousin in the future.”
Speaking of this, his expression suddenly turned serious.
“Spread the favors evenly, understand?”
“Rest assured, cousin!”
Yang Fan quickly patted his chest.
“I know my limits!”
If it were when he first met Lu Wan, Yang Fan might still worry about the bad relationship between the two women.
But by now, Yang Fan had long been completely at ease.
There was no truly irreconcilable conflict between Gu Le and Lu Wan.
What was even more crucial... his own Wan’er was simply too easy to talk to, so he didn’t need to worry about anything at all.
“That’s good.”
Gu Jiuheng obviously breathed a sigh of relief.
Afterwards, as if remembering something, he quietly leaned close to Yang Fan and lowered his voice to ask:
“Brother-in-law, is there any experience you can impart?”
“I am currently in the Ninth Legion, earning military merits by waging war against alien races. The pressure is simply too great.”
“As for you, brother-in-law, I truly envy you from the bottom of my heart!”
Yang Fan was slightly startled.
“Ah? What does cousin mean?”
Gu Jiuheng immediately wore a serious face.
“It’s just that I want to know...”
“If I also want to find a wife like President Lu and rely on a wife to live off her, is there still a chance?”
“My requirements aren’t high.”
“I don’t need a young one, anyone under one hundred thousand years old is fine!”
“...” The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
Just when Yang Fan didn’t know how to answer, a low roaring sound suddenly came from afar.
The the void seemed to tremble slightly as a huge streamlined spaceship slowly drove into the docking area.
As the spaceship entered the designated airspace, energy scans quickly swept across the spaceship without triggering any alarms.
Immediately following that, faint ripples appeared in the space around the spaceship, and several spatial stabilization devices activated simultaneously, completely fixing the surrounding the void.
Without any violent shaking, the entire spaceship landed steadily in the designated position like a feather.
The cabin door slowly opened, and Yang Fan, who did not know how to respond to Gu Jiuheng’s words just now, immediately shifted his attention over.
“They’re here.” He walked up to welcome them with quick steps.
Sure enough, the first person to walk out of the cabin door was Gu Le.
And behind her... a small figure was lying inside a specially made rubber bed.
Gu Chengye was sleeping incomparably peacefully at this moment, not even noticing that the spaceship had arrived.
However, what surprised Yang Fan a little was that a middle-aged woman was also standing beside Gu Le.
With just a glance, Yang Fan sensed the powerful aura on the other party — a Mid-tier God!
Moreover, the aura was steady and lingering, obviously not the kind of Mid-tier God who had just made a breakthrough.
“Young Miss, the place has been reached, so I will head back first.”
The middle-aged woman slightly bowed and said respectfully.
Gu Le nodded.
“Take care on your way back, Aunt Li. Thank you for your trouble all the way.”
“You are too polite, Young Miss.”
The middle-aged woman responded with a smile.
Afterwards, she nodded slightly to signal Yang Fan before turning around to return to the spaceship.
At this moment, Gu Le was holding the deeply sleeping Gu Chengye and jogged over to Yang Fan’s front.
“Husband, I’ve missed you so much!” Gu Le said with a face full of excitement.
“Didn’t we meet often in the Virtual World?”
“That’s different!” Gu Le pouted her lips.
Right at this time, Gu Jiuheng on the side couldn’t help speaking: “Cousin, let me take you to the Gu Family villa.”
“No need.”
Gu Le refused directly without even thinking.
“I have already agreed with Cousin Lu Wan, I am staying at her place!”
“Ah?”
Gu Jiuheng was directly stunned.
He had heard that the relationship between his cousin and Lu Wan was not very good.
Originally, he had already prepared to watch a show of “two women fighting over a husband.”
But now... not only did he not see the drama of vying for favor, but the two women had actually agreed to live together?
What kind of development is this?
Gu Le couldn’t be bothered to pay attention to the dazed Gu Jiuheng, and directly pulled Yang Fan’s hand, walking towards the flying ship.
“Husband, have you been waiting for me for a long time? Are you tired?”
Gu Le turned her face to the side and asked with a concerned expression.
“Not bad.”
Yang Fan said with a smile.
“I came over early in the morning, but thinking that we can meet every day from now on, I don’t feel tired at all.”
As he spoke, he raised his right hand and gently patted Gu Le’s forehead.
Gu Le instantly revealed a sweet smile.
Meanwhile, Gu Jiuheng, standing behind them, was completely in disarray.
He had watched with his own eyes when Yang Fan came over!
He clearly rushed over by timing it precisely.
How did it become “I came over early in the morning” in his mouth?
And he said it with such righteous confidence.
This thick skin... how on earth was it practiced?
Gu Jiuheng looked at the backs of the two and fell into deep thought.
Could this be the gap between him and his brother-in-law?
If he had learned this skill earlier, maybe he could have suffered a little less.
Soon, Yang Fan and Gu Le brought Gu Chengye on the flying ship to Lu Wan’s villa.
At this time, Lu Wan was already waiting in the living room.
Seeing Gu Le enter the door, a gentle smile instantly appeared on her face.
“Cousin Gu Le, congratulations on your breakthrough to become a god and officially graduating. It is truly a joyful occasion.”
“I was stuck at the very last moment, defeating a demigod in the tier-2 area of the Alien Divine Realm Zone before successfully achieving a breakthrough.”
Gu Le said with a smile, “Compared to Cousin, it is still a bit slower.”
“Alright, let’s not talk about this for now.”
Lu Wan smiled.
“I have already prepared the food and dishes. In the future here at the frontline, our family will work hard together.”
“Okay.” Gu Le nodded vigorously.
The atmosphere between the two was even more harmonious than Yang Fan had imagined.
At this time, Lu Wan’s gaze fell on Gu Chengye.
“There is the latest model of nanny robot here, hand Chengye over to it.”
“Then I’ll have to trouble Cousin for the arrangement.”
Gu Le wasn’t polite either, and directly handed Gu Chengye in her arms to the robot nanny.
“You and I are both the husband’s people now, so don’t call each other cousin anymore in the future.”
Lu Wan said with a smile.
“However, do you want me to call you Elder sister or younger sister?”
Gu Le blinked.
“Although I entered the door first, I’m already used to calling you Elder sister. You should still be the older one in the future.”
After saying that, she waved her hand nonchalantly.
“Alright.”
Looking at the harmonious atmosphere between the two, Yang Fan, who was following alongside, couldn’t help but quietly breathe a sigh of relief.
Good thing his wives were both sensible and understanding.
There were no scenes of jealousy or a Shura field.
This is what a harmonious family should be like!
(That’s a Wrap!)
